# Are Amex points from Rakuten worth more than the cash?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-amex-points-worth-more-than-cash/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Only when you redeem each point for more than 1 cent. Rakuten gives 1 Membership Rewards point per cent of cash back, so $100 becomes 10,000 points; those points beat $100 through airline transfers and a few card-specific options, and fall short as statement credits, shopping or most gift cards.

This page is information, not financial advice. The steps for switching are on a separate page: [how to get Amex points from Rakuten instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/).

## The break-even is 1 cent

Every $1 of Rakuten cash back can be $1 or 100 points. So 1 cent per point is the line. Above it, points win. Below it, cash wins.

## What 10,000 points are worth, by use

The table starts from $100 of Rakuten cash back. The cents-per-point figures are from The Points Guy's guide dated April 2026, Upgraded Points (October 2026) and One Mile at a Time.

| How the points are used | Cents per point | 10,000 points come to | Against $100 cash |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cover charges on your card statement | 0.6 | $60 | $40 less |
| Pay with points at Amazon and similar stores | 0.7 | $70 | $30 less |
| Most hotels, cars and rentals through Amex Travel | About 0.7 | About $70 | About $30 less |
| Gift cards | 0.5 to 1 | $50 to $100 | $0 to $50 less |
| Flights through Amex Travel | 1 | $100 | Even |
| Fine Hotels + Resorts with a Platinum Card | 1 | $100 | Even |
| Schwab Platinum "Invest with Rewards" | 1.1 | $110 | $10 more |
| Flights with a Business Platinum 35% points rebate | About 1.54 | About $154 | About $54 more |
| Transfers to airline and hotel programs | 1.7 to 2, by two travel sites' estimates | $170 to $200 | $70 to $100 more |

- The Schwab figure applies only to holders of the Platinum Card for Schwab, on the first 1 million points a year. After that it drops to 0.8 cents.
- The Business Platinum figure is arithmetic: 35% of the points come back on eligible airfare booked with points, so each point nets about 1.54 cents.
- The transfer figures are estimates, not fixed prices. One Mile at a Time uses 1.7 cents and The Points Guy uses 2 cents. A third site puts it near 2.2.

Amex's own guide could not be opened to check these numbers directly. Amex can change redemption values, so confirm them in your Membership Rewards account before relying on a figure.

## When the switch pays

- You already move Amex points to airline programs and book award flights. Each $100 of Rakuten cash back adds 10,000 points to a balance you would use anyway.
- You hold the Schwab or Business Platinum card. The gain is smaller but fixed.

## When it does not

- You would spend the points on statement credits, Amazon or most gift cards. At 0.6 to 0.7 cents, $100 of cash back turns into $60 to $70.
- You book flights through Amex Travel with points. That is 1 cent: no gain over cash.
- You have no planned use. A point is worth nothing until redeemed, and programs can raise award prices.

The higher rows are worth that much only if you would have paid cash for those flights. An award seat you would never have bought at full price is not a saving of its full price.

## Costs the table leaves out

- **Taxes and fees on awards.** These reduce the cents-per-point figure.
- **The card.** You need an Amex card in the Membership Rewards program. Rakuten points alone do not cover an annual fee. See [what the Platinum credits are really worth](/amex-platinum-credits-real-value/).
- **Reversing.** Whether you can switch back to cash later is not confirmed. Sources disagree, and Rakuten's help pages do not say.
- **Other offers.** Rakuten's terms say offers tied to other card issuers may not be available once you choose points.

## Who should skip it

- You have never transferred points to an airline and do not plan to learn.
- You redeem points for statement credits or shopping.
- You do not hold a Membership Rewards card. The comparison does not apply.

## Quick answers

**What is the break-even value?**
1 cent per point. Rakuten gives 100 points per $1 of cash back.

**Are the points worth more as a statement credit?**
No. At about 0.6 cents per point, $100 of cash back becomes about $60.

**How much more are transfers worth?**
By two travel sites' estimates, 1.7 to 2 cents per point, if you find and book award seats.

## Sources

- [The Points Guy: What Amex points are worth](https://thepointsguy.com/loyalty-programs/amex-points-value/)
- [Upgraded Points: Platinum Card for Schwab review](https://upgradedpoints.com/credit-cards/reviews/american-express-platinum-card-for-schwab/)
- [One Mile at a Time: Earning Amex points with Rakuten](https://onemileatatime.com/guides/amex-points-rakuten/)
- [Rakuten: Membership Rewards points FAQ](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/american-express-membership-rewards-points-faq-360017609253)
- [Rakuten: Membership Rewards points terms](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/american-express-membership-rewards-points-at-rakuten-terms-360017609913)
- [American Express: How much are Membership Rewards points worth?](https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/credit-cards/credit-intel/american-express-points-value/)

# Rakuten app or browser extension: which tracks purchases more reliably?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-app-vs-browser-extension/
Facts checked: 2026-11-21
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

No source gives tracking figures for one against the other, so a measured answer is not confirmed. Rakuten's own guidance is to use the extension on a computer and the app on a phone, and each one fails in different, known situations.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## What each one is

| | Browser extension | App |
|---|---|---|
| Where it runs | Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Samsung Internet on a computer; Safari on iPhone | iPhone and Android |
| Android phones | Not available | Yes |
| How a purchase is tracked | It alerts you on the store's site and you activate | You pick the store in the app and it opens the store from there |
| Extras | Coupon search at checkout, price comparisons | Restaurant offers, in-store offers, price-drop alerts |

A Rakuten blog post from January 30, 2026 calls the extension on desktop plus the app on mobile the "most reliable setup". That is Rakuten's recommendation, not a test result.

Both do the same job: each starts a shopping trip, Rakuten's record that you reached the store through it. No trip, no cash back.

## When the extension fails

- **You did not activate.** Rakuten's help article says the extension notifies you and you activate, on every visit. A second order at the same store needs a new activation. (Rakuten's blog says the extension activates automatically; its help article says otherwise. The safer habit is to look for the confirmation.)
- **Another extension took the credit.** A click from a different coupon or rewards extension after activating turns Rakuten's cash back off.
- **A blocker is running.** Ad blockers, VPNs, cookie-blocking security software and private or incognito windows can stop activation.
- **Safari at some stores.** Rakuten says Safari's tracking prevention can block cash back at stores that have not adjusted their sites. Its advice on a computer is to switch to Chrome.
- **The store is not offered through the extension.** If no activate button appears, the store may not be available that way.
- **Items were in the cart first.** Some stores will not link an order if items were added before activating.

The toolbar icon tells you where you stand on a computer:

| Icon color | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Purple | The store offers no cash back |
| Red | Cash back is available but not activated |
| Blue | Cash back is activated |

## When the app fails

- **You leave the window the app opened.** Rakuten says the window you buy in must have come from a Rakuten link. Finishing the order in a different browser tab breaks that.
- **The store's own app.** What happens if the order is completed in the retailer's own app is not covered in the Rakuten articles read. It is not confirmed, so the cautious path is to finish checkout in the page the Rakuten app opened.
- **A coupon from elsewhere.** Codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back, in the app as on a computer.

## The iPhone middle path

On an iPhone there is a third option: the Safari extension, which comes inside the Rakuten iOS app. It needs the latest app and the latest iOS Safari, has to be switched on under Manage Extensions, and needs "Always Allow" on every website.

It fails if content blockers are on. Rakuten's fix is to shop in the app instead, or to turn content blockers off in Settings while shopping.

## Which to use where

| Situation | What Rakuten's pages point to |
|---|---|
| Shopping on a computer | Extension, in Chrome if Safari is blocked at that store |
| Android phone | App (no extension exists) |
| iPhone with content blockers | App |
| iPhone, shopping in Safari | Safari extension, with blockers off |
| Restaurants and in-store offers | App only |

Whichever you use, the check is the same: look for the activation confirmation before you pay, then look for a pending amount within a day or two. If it is missing, see [what to do about missing cash back](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- **Skip the extension** if you do not want a tool that reads the pages you visit. It collects browsing data whether or not you interact with it; see [extension privacy](/rakuten-browser-extension-safe-privacy/). You can start from Rakuten's website instead.
- **Skip the app** if you do all your shopping on a computer and never use in-store or restaurant offers.

## Quick answers

**Is the Rakuten app more reliable than the extension?**
Not confirmed. No published figures compare them. Rakuten suggests the extension on a computer and the app on a phone.

**Is there a Rakuten extension for Android?**
No. Rakuten's help pages say Android users should use the app.

**How do you know cash back is active?**
On a computer the toolbar icon turns blue. In any case, look for the activation confirmation before paying.

# Rakuten Apple cash back: is Apple on Rakuten, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-apple-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Apple is on Rakuten: 2% cash back on November 26, 2026, the day before Black Friday, and only for accessories, Apple Refurbished products, AppleCare+ and Beats. A new iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch or AirPods earns nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check Apple's page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## What earns and what does not

Rakuten's terms for Apple say: "Cash Back is only available on Accessories, Apple Refurbished products, AppleCare+ and Beats."

| Earned 2% on November 26, 2026 | Earned nothing |
|---|---|
| Apple Certified Refurbished | iPhone |
| AirTag | Mac and MacBooks |
| Cases and protection | iPad |
| Apple Watch bands | Apple Watch |
| Mice and keyboards | AirPods |
| Other accessories | HomePod, HomePod mini and Apple TV |
| Beats by Dre | Apple Vision Pro |
| AppleCare+ | Gift cards and gift wrap |

Also excluded: Apple displays (Pro Display XDR and Studio Display), Apple Vision Pro accessories, redeeming a gift card, Apple Developer Programs, AppleCare+ and AppleCare One paid as a monthly subscription, resale orders, and orders through Apple's employee purchase, government or veterans and military stores.

## The rate, by date

| Date read | Rate shown on Rakuten's Apple page |
|---|---|
| November 24, 2026 | 2% |
| November 25, 2026 | 2% |
| November 26, 2026 | 2% |

No "was" rate was shown on November 26, so 2% looked like the ordinary rate, not a raised one. That held the day before Black Friday, when Rakuten's pages for Macy's and Ulta each showed 12% against a usual 2%. Rakuten's Black Friday page names Apple, and the exclusions above still apply. Whether the rate changes on Black Friday itself or on Cyber Monday is not confirmed; see [Rakuten on Black Friday](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/) and [Rakuten on Cyber Monday](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/).

The one deal listed on the page that day was a link to Apple refurbished products with a one-year warranty, not a code.

## The sums

| Purchase | At 2% |
|---|---|
| $50 case | $1.00 |
| $100 of accessories | $2.00 |
| $200 Beats headphones | $4.00 |
| $1,000 new Mac | $0 |

A mixed cart is where it gets less obvious. Buy a new Mac with a $100 keyboard and only the keyboard counts, so the order earns about $2.

## Refurbished products

Refurbished is the one route to cash back on a larger Apple purchase. The terms include Apple Refurbished products and show Apple Certified Refurbished at 2%. On a $900 refurbished item that is $18.

One caution. New Macs, iPads and iPhones are on the excluded list, and the terms as read do not spell out how the two rules meet for a refurbished Mac or iPad. The plain reading is that refurbished products qualify. It is not confirmed beyond that wording, so check the pending amount after the order.

## Limits and timing

- **Unit limits.** The terms set lifetime limits: 6 units per model for iPhone, Mac, iPad, Watch, Vision, Apple TV and HomePod; 32 each of the AirTag 1-pack and AirTag accessories; 8 AirTag 4-packs; and 10 each of AirPods and other eligible accessories. The limits count purchases on Apple's website and in its app, and no reward is paid past the limit for a product.
- **Posting.** Apple's listing says cash back is added to the Rakuten account the same day. It still has to move from pending to confirmed before it is paid; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).
- **Gift cards.** Buying an Apple gift card earns nothing. More on that in [gift cards and Rakuten](/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/).
- **Other stores.** Apple products sold elsewhere follow that store's terms. The Rakuten listings for [Best Buy](/rakuten-best-buy-cash-back-how-it-works/), [Target](/rakuten-target-cash-back-how-it-works/) and [Kohl's](/rakuten-kohls-cash-back-how-it-works/) each exclude Apple products.
- **Other phone and laptop makers.** Their own stores have different rules; see [Rakuten at Samsung](/rakuten-samsung-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## How this fits with other savings

Rakuten cash back comes on top of whatever the credit card earns on the purchase; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/). Whether Apple's education pricing or a trade-in changes eligibility is not stated in the terms read, so it is not confirmed.

If an eligible order shows nothing after two days, see [what to do about missing cash back](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You are buying a new iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch or AirPods and nothing else. The order earns nothing.
- You pay for AppleCare+ monthly. The subscription form is excluded.
- You buy through an employee, government or veterans store. Those orders are excluded.
- You are buying a gift card.

## Quick answers

**Is Apple on Rakuten?**
Yes. Apple was listed at 2% on November 26, 2026, for accessories, Apple Refurbished products, AppleCare+ and Beats only.

**Does a new iPhone earn Rakuten cash back at Apple?**
No. iPhone was on the excluded list on November 26, 2026.

**When is Apple cash back added?**
The listing says the same day. It is paid on Rakuten's next quarterly date after it is confirmed.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two; [how the sign-up and referral bonuses work](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/) sets out both offers.

# Rakuten AT&T cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-att-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, but only for home internet and only for new subscribers. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's AT&T Internet page showed up to $150 cash back, raised from $50, as a flat dollar amount and not a percentage. It is limited to one per member and is earned only after the service has been active for at least 60 days.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## Amounts seen on November 25, 2026

| Service, as listed | Cash back shown |
|---|---|
| AT&T Fiber Internet | $150 |
| "AIA" | $150 |
| AT&T Copper Internet | $5 |
| Headline | Up to $150, "was $50" |

The rate list does not spell out "AIA". Elsewhere the page mentions a 5G home internet service called Internet Air. Whether "AIA" means that service is not confirmed.

The "was $50" label means the amount was raised above the base that day. Nothing on the page says how long it lasts.

## What is excluded

The page at this address is for AT&T Internet. Its terms say:

- AT&T Voice earns nothing.
- AT&T Wireless, AT&T Business and DIRECTV plans earn nothing here. The terms say those orders must be placed through their own store pages on Rakuten.
- Cash back is only for new subscribers.
- One per member.
- Free trials earn nothing.
- The cash back cannot be more than the amount actually paid for the subscription.

The terms have no store-specific rule on coupon codes. Rakuten's general help page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.

## The 60-day condition

The terms say a member is eligible only after the merchant confirms that internet service has been activated for at least 60 days and payment has been processed.

The page does not fully agree with itself here. Its posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account within one week. The special terms require 60 days of active service first. The terms are the stricter reading.

| Situation | Earns? |
|---|---|
| New fiber internet subscriber, service active 60 days, bill paid | Yes, $150 that day |
| New copper internet subscriber | Yes, $5 that day |
| Existing internet subscriber changing plans | No; new subscribers only |
| Second order by the same member | No; one per member |
| Service canceled before 60 days | No |
| Wireless phone plan ordered from this page | No |
| Voice | No |

## What the page does not settle

- **Who counts as new.** The terms do not define "new subscribers". Whether a former customer, or a wireless customer adding home internet, counts is not confirmed.
- **Orders by phone or in a store.** Rakuten's general help page says orders completed by chat, phone or customer service do not qualify. No in-store offer was shown on the page.
- **Bundles.** One deal on the page describes pairing fiber with wireless. Whether the wireless part of a bundle earns anything is not confirmed; the terms point wireless orders to a separate Rakuten page.
- **Reward cards.** The page listed a deal for a $100 reward card from the provider. Whether that offer and the cash back can both be had on one order is not confirmed.

## When you get the money

After the 60 days and the confirmed payment, the cash back becomes payable on the next of Rakuten's four dates a year; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If nothing appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You already have this provider's home internet. The offer is for new subscribers.
- You want a wireless plan, voice or DIRECTV. This page's offer does not cover them.
- You have already earned this offer once.
- You may cancel within 60 days.
- You plan to order by phone or in a store.
- Only copper service reaches your address. The amount shown was $5.

## Quick answers

**How much does Rakuten pay for AT&T Internet?**
Up to $150 on November 25, 2026, for fiber; $5 for copper. Amounts change.

**Do existing customers qualify?**
No. The terms say cash back is only available for new subscribers.

**When is it earned?**
After the service has been active at least 60 days and payment is processed.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-avis-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Avis page showed 2.5% cash back, with no raised rate. Rentals picked up in Alaska, rentals outside the U.S. and Canada and rentals that use the Avis Worldwide Discount earn nothing, and cash back posts only after the travel is completed.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

The page showed 2.5% with no "was" label and no rate by category or car class. With no "was" label, 2.5% is the plain rate. Nothing on the page promises a higher rate on Black Friday (November 27, 2026) or after.

The page does not say which part of a rental bill the 2.5% is counted on. Whether it covers only the base rate, or also extras such as added drivers, fuel or insurance, is not confirmed. Rakuten's general help page says taxes never earn cash back.

## What earns and what does not

| Rental | Earns cash back? |

| Picked up in Canada | Yes |
| Picked up in Alaska | No |
| Picked up outside the U.S. and Canada | No |

The terms do not define the "Avis Worldwide Discount". Which discount codes fall under it is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes

The terms say coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back, and to stick to codes Rakuten provides. On November 25, 2026, the page listed one offer with a code, for 25% off, next to several sale links.

Under the terms, a membership or coupon code that is not listed on Rakuten puts the 2.5% at risk.

## Pay now or pay later

Rakuten's page describes lower rates for paying at booking. The cash back terms do not separate prepaid rentals from rentals paid at the counter. Whether both earn is not confirmed.

## App, loyalty program and counter

- **App.** Rakuten's page says the Avis app can make, change and cancel reservations. The terms do not mention the app. A booking earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension. Whether a booking made or changed in the Avis app tracks is not confirmed.
- **Avis Preferred.** The terms do not mention the loyalty program. Whether a rental paid with points earns is not confirmed.
- **At the counter.** The page showed an online rate only. Avis did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

# Rakuten Best Buy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Best Buy: up to 6% on Black Friday, November 27, 2026, set by category and brand, with most general categories at 1%. The headline is the same as the two days before and lower than the up to 8% read on November 24. Apple products, video game consoles, gift cards, services and warranties are excluded.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

Whether the list changes for Cyber Monday, November 30, is not confirmed; see [Rakuten on Black Friday](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/) and [Rakuten on Cyber Monday](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/).

- **App.** The terms say nothing about the store's app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.

# Rakuten payout: check or PayPal, and what are the dates and minimum?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-big-fat-check-vs-paypal/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

A check and a PayPal payment are for the same amount, on the same four dates (February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15), with the same minimum of about $5 confirmed. The difference is handling: a paper check comes by mail and is good for 180 days, while PayPal needs a valid PayPal email address in your Rakuten account.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## Side by side

| | Check ("Big Fat Check") | PayPal |
|---|---|---|
| Payment dates | February 15, May 15, August 15, November 15 | Same |
| Minimum | About $5 confirmed | Same |
| Where it goes | The name and mailing address in Account Settings | The PayPal account tied to the email in Account Settings |
| Mailing address needed | Yes | Yes; Rakuten says it is used to verify identity |
| Time limit | Valid 90 days, plus a 90-day grace period | None stated |
| If it goes wrong | Rakuten reissues a missing, lost, destroyed or expired check | Not stated on Rakuten's pages |
| Time to arrive after the payment date | Not confirmed | Not confirmed |
| Fee from Rakuten | None mentioned | None mentioned |

Rakuten's help pages do not say how many days a check takes in the mail or how fast a PayPal payment lands. They also do not give a deadline for changing your method before a payment date.

## The dates and the minimum

Only cash back the store has confirmed before a payment date is included. Anything under the minimum carries over. Rakuten's help page says $5 or more; its terms say $5.01. The next date after today is February 15, 2027.

The waits before a purchase counts are covered in [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## How a check works

- It is made out to the name on the account and mailed to the address on file. A wrong or old address is the usual reason a check goes missing.
- It is valid for 90 days. Rakuten adds a 90-day grace period, so it can be deposited for 180 days from the issue date.
- Many banks accept it by mobile deposit. Rakuten's instructions are to detach the top part, endorse the check, and photograph the front and back in your bank's app.
- If the check is lost, destroyed or expired, Rakuten says it will issue a replacement. You contact Member Services.

Rakuten's terms add a caution. If a check expires or is returned uncashed, the amount goes back into your Rakuten account. There it may be subject to the inactivity maintenance fee or to state unclaimed property law.

## How PayPal works

- Rakuten's terms say you must provide a valid PayPal email address.
- You set or change it in Account Settings on the website. In the app it is under Account, then Choose How You Get Paid.
- The payment goes to the PayPal account tied to that email, so the email in Rakuten should match one on your PayPal account.

## How to choose or change

1. Sign in to Rakuten and open Account Settings.
2. Find the section on how you are paid.
3. Pick check or PayPal, and add a mailing address if none is on file.

## Other ways to be paid

Rakuten also offers Bilt points, Samsung Cash, a gift card redeemed on request from a $5 confirmed balance, and American Express Membership Rewards points. For the points option, see [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/).

## Which fits whom

| Situation | Fits |
|---|---|
| You move often or your mail is unreliable | PayPal |
| You do not have or want a PayPal account | Check |
| You tend to leave checks in a drawer | PayPal |
| You want the money directly at your bank with no middle account | Check, by mobile deposit |

## Who should skip it

- Skip the check if your address on file may be out of date. Update it first.
- Skip PayPal if the email on your Rakuten account is not one linked to your PayPal account.
- Skip both if you want the money sooner than the next quarterly date. Rakuten's gift card option is the only one it describes as arriving within minutes.

## Quick answers

**How long is a Rakuten check valid?**
90 days, plus a 90-day grace period: 180 days from the issue date.

**What if my Rakuten check never arrives?**
Rakuten says it will issue a replacement. Contact Member Services and check the address on file.

**Is the minimum different for check and PayPal?**
No. Both need about $5 in confirmed cash back.

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Choosing how you get paid](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/choosing-how-you-get-paid-360002100828)
- [Rakuten: When will I get paid?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/when-will-i-get-paid-360002117667)
- [Rakuten: Missing, lost or expired checks](https://rakuten.com/help/article/missing-lost-or-expired-checks-360002101268)
- [Rakuten: Mobile deposit of your Big Fat Check](https://rakuten.com/help/article/mobile-deposit-of-your-big-fat-check-360048175773)
- [Rakuten: Terms and conditions](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/terms-conditions)

Yes, Rakuten has Black Friday deals in 2026, and they are live. Its home page advertises one event from Black Friday to Cyber Monday, but no Rakuten page says how long any store's rate will last.

This page is information, not financial advice. ## Exclusions

Each store sets its own. Common ones in Rakuten's help center:

- Gift cards, at most stores.
- Taxes and shipping.
- Certain items, categories or brands, or a lower rate for them.
- Orders placed by phone, chat or customer service.
- Orders using a coupon code not listed on Rakuten.

A store's list is under "Terms & Exclusions" on its Rakuten page. The Apple listing pays only on accessories, refurbished products, AppleCare+ and Beats, not on iPhones, Macs or iPads. Macy's pays 1.5% on furniture and mattresses and excludes brands such as Apple and Birkenstock.

Rakuten's Black Friday page says many coupon codes can be used together with cash back, while its help center says codes not listed on Rakuten may void it. See [stacking with coupons and card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Tracking on a busy day

Rakuten lists these reasons an order fails to track:

- Activating after items are already in the cart.
- An ad blocker, VPN or cookie blocker, or declined cookies.
- Another rewards or coupon site or extension taking over the click.
- A long idle session, or checking out in a different tab.

For a Black Friday order that means: empty the cart, activate, add the items, and check out in one sitting.

Rakuten says an order typically shows in the account within 24 to 48 hours. Its terms give 90 days from the purchase to report missing cash back. For a November 27 order that is February 25, 2027. A store can set a shorter limit; Best Buy's listing says 30 days. See [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

In-store rates need a linked card and an offer added first; see [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/). Macy's in-store offer on November 27 was a flat $10 on a purchase of $100 or more, valid through December 13, 2026.

## Returns

Rakuten's help center says returned or canceled orders do not earn cash back, and a partial return is adjusted.

## When the money arrives

Rakuten's payment page says online orders typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed; its status page says 3 to 17 weeks. It pays on fixed dates.

| Order on November 27, 2026 | Confirmed about | Paid |
|---|---|---|
| Confirmed in 3 weeks | December 18, 2026 | February 15, 2027 |
| Confirmed in 14 weeks | March 5, 2027 | May 15, 2027 |
| Confirmed in 17 weeks | March 26, 2027 | May 15, 2027 |

These dates are worked out from Rakuten's typical range. More in [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). The Monday after has its own page: [Rakuten on Cyber Monday 2026](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/).

## Who should skip it

- The store's sale price is lower somewhere that Rakuten does not cover. A lower price today is worth more than a rebate in February.
- You have a coupon from another site that is worth more than the cash back.
- You would buy more because the rate looks high. Twelve percent back still leaves 88% spent.

## Quick answers

**Will Rakuten have Black Friday deals in 2026?**
Yes. On Black Friday, November 27, 2026, its Black Friday page showed 12% cash back at more than 600 stores.

**Are Rakuten rates higher on Black Friday?**
On November 27, 14 of 77 tracked stores rose from the day before and none fell. Rates can change daily.

**When will Black Friday cash back be paid?**
On February 15 or May 15, 2027, depending on when the store confirms the order.

A "was" label means the rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. Here the usual rate is 2%, so the raised rate is six times that. The page does not say when 12% ends. Nothing on the page promises the rate for Black Friday (November 27, 2026) or Cyber Monday (November 30, 2026).

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Bloomingdale's list these as earning nothing:

| Earns nothing | Note |
|---|---|
| Gift cards | Buying them |
| "Adjustments" | The terms do not define the word |
| Employee orders | Orders by store employees or with an employee discount |
| Phone orders | Also orders through a style advisor or customer service |
| Five or more of the same item | Counted per order |
| Reselling | Orders the store deems to be for resale |

The terms name no excluded brands or departments. Whether every brand sold on the site earns the full rate is not confirmed beyond that.

Rakuten's page says the store offers price adjustments within 10 days of an order. The terms exclude "adjustments" from cash back. Whether a price adjustment lowers the amount that earns, or removes the cash back, is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes

The Bloomingdale's terms have no line about coupon codes. Rakuten's general help page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. Rakuten's page describes a 10% off code for signing up for the store's emails or texts. That code comes from the store, not from Rakuten, so whether it is safe to use with cash back is not confirmed.

## Loyallist points

Rakuten's page describes Loyallist, the store's rewards program: one point per $1 spent, and $25 for every 5,000 points. Members get free shipping with no minimum; others need $150 or more.

The cash back terms do not mention Loyallist. Whether the part of an order paid with a Loyallist reward earns cash back is not confirmed.

## Pickup, outlets and stores

- **Pickup.** The page describes buy online, pick up in store for eligible items. The cash back terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **Outlets.** The page mentions Bloomingdale's outlets as a place to earn Loyallist points. It does not say outlet purchases earn cash back. Not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The page showed an online rate only. No in-store offer was shown on it. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).
- **Returns.** Rakuten's general help page says returned or canceled orders do not earn cash back.

## What it comes to

Prices are those shown on Rakuten's Bloomingdale's page on November 25, 2026.

| Purchase | Price shown | At 12% | At the 2% "was" rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| La Mer The Daily Rituals Collection Gift Set | $42.50 | $5.10 | $0.85 |
| Dyson Airsmooth Styling Brush | $249.99 | $30.00 | $5.00 |
| Lola Blankets Original Ruched Faux Fur Blanket | $325.00 | $39.00 | $6.50 |
| Gift card | Any | $0 | $0 |

Taxes and shipping do not count. Card rewards are separate; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account within one week. Payment follows every three months; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If nothing appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You order by phone or through a style advisor. Those orders are excluded.
- You are buying gift cards.
- You are buying five or more of the same item in one order.
- You shop with an employee discount.
- You are counting on 12% next week. The usual rate shown is 2%, and no end date is given for the raised one.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Bloomingdale's?**
12% on November 25, 2026, shown as raised from 2%. Rates change daily.

**Do phone orders earn cash back?**
No. Phone orders and orders through a style advisor or customer service are excluded.

**Do Loyallist points and Rakuten cash back stack?**
The terms do not mention Loyallist. Whether an order paid partly with a reward earns is not confirmed.

# Is the Rakuten browser extension safe, and what data does it collect?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-browser-extension-safe-privacy/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

The extension is published by Rakuten itself and listed in the official Chrome and Firefox stores. It collects the addresses of pages you visit, whether or not you are using it at that moment, plus shopping details such as searches, cart items and order totals. Uninstalling it stops that collection.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## Who publishes it

| Fact, seen November 20, 2026 | Detail |
|---|---|
| Name in the Chrome Web Store | Rakuten: Get Cash Back For Shopping |
| Offered by | Ebates Performance Marketing Inc., doing business as Rakuten Rewards |
| Users | 3,000,000 |
| Rating | 4.7 out of 5, from about 43,600 ratings |
| Last updated | November 17, 2026 |

That company is the same legal entity behind the Rakuten site; see [who owns Rakuten and how it makes money](/is-rakuten-legit-how-it-makes-money/).

No independent security audit of the extension was found, so that part of "safe" is not confirmed. What can be checked is what Rakuten says the extension does.

## What it collects

Rakuten's privacy notice for the extension was updated on March 13, 2026. It says the extension collects information on the pages you visit "whether you are interacting with it or not." The notice lists:

- URLs of the pages you visit and general information about those pages.
- Product searches and search results.
- Items you add to a cart.
- Products, coupons and offers you view or click.
- Date and time of use, browser type and version, and device type.
- On order confirmation pages at certain stores: what you ordered and the order total.

It also covers some web-based generative AI apps. There the extension looks for the names or domains of Rakuten's partner stores in the AI's answer, so it can show an offer. The notice says Rakuten does not collect or store your chat history.

## What the browser stores show

In the Chrome Web Store, the developer declares that the extension handles three kinds of data: web history, user activity and website content. It also declares that the data is not sold to third parties outside approved use cases, is not used for purposes unrelated to the extension's core function, and is not used to judge creditworthiness.

The Firefox listing shows the permissions asked for: access to browser tabs, access to browser activity during navigation, and access to your data for all websites. Notifications are optional. This was seen in a search summary of the listing.

## What Rakuten uses it for

- Showing offers, including by email.
- Confirming cash back faster. Rakuten calls this Instant Cash Back and says it is not available at every store.
- Reminders about items left in a cart, and coupon suggestions at checkout.
- Internal testing based on shopping behavior.

When you activate an offer, a cookie is set through an affiliate network so the store can credit the order to Rakuten. The notice and Rakuten's terms both say this can overwrite affiliate cookies from other companies.

For who else receives data, the notice points to Rakuten's main privacy policy, which names affiliate networks, stores, advertising providers and other Rakuten Group companies. How long extension data is kept is not stated in the notice.

## What you can turn off

| Control | Where | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Order confirmations | Extension Settings | Stops the reading of order details |
| Offers in AI app answers | Extension Settings | Stops offers shown in generative AI output |
| Uninstall or disable | Your browser | Stops all collection by the extension |
| Sale and sharing opt-out | Privacy Preference Center on rakuten.com | Limits certain disclosures under state privacy laws |

You do not need the extension to earn. Starting each purchase from the Rakuten website or app also tracks it. The extension mainly saves that step.

## Who should skip it

- You do not want any company to hold a record of the pages you visit. Use the website for each purchase instead.
- You already run another rewards or coupon extension. Rakuten says a competing extension can stop its tracking, and asks members to disable or uninstall others.
- You share a browser profile with other people. Their browsing would be collected under your account.

## Quick answers

**Does the Rakuten extension track all the sites I visit?**
Rakuten's notice says it collects information on the pages you visit, including URLs, even when idle.

**Does Rakuten read my AI chats?**
Its notice says it looks for partner store names in the AI's answer and does not collect or store chat history.

**How do I stop the collection?**
Uninstall or disable the extension. You can still earn by starting at the Rakuten website.

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Browser extension privacy notice](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/rakuten-cash-back-button-privacy-notice-360052819794)
- [Chrome Web Store: Rakuten: Get Cash Back For Shopping](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rakuten-get-cash-back-for/chhjbpecpncaggjpdakmflnfcopglcmi)
- [Firefox Add-ons: Rakuten: Get Cash Back For Shopping](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ebates/)
- [Rakuten: Privacy policy](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/privacy-policy)
- [Rakuten: Terms and conditions](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/terms-conditions)
- [Rakuten: Using the extension with other similar browser extensions](https://rakuten.com/help/article/using-the-cash-back-button-with-other-similar-browser-extensions-360001446948)

# Rakuten Carter's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-carters-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Carter's. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Carter's page showed 8% cash back, marked "was 2%". Buying or redeeming gift cards earns nothing, the offer covers the Carter's US site only, and the terms say a coupon code not listed on Rakuten will void cash back.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 25, 2026 | 8% | Was 2% |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. Here it points to 2% as the usual figure. The page does not say when the 8% ends. No category table appears; every product and offer shown carried the same 8%.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| Orders on the Carter's US site | Yes, 8% on the day checked |
| OshKosh B'gosh items sold by Carter's | Shown on the page with the 8% rate |
| Buying a gift card | No |
| The part of an order paid by redeeming a gift card | No |
| Orders on a Carter's site outside the US | No |
| An order using a code not listed on Rakuten | No; the terms say it will void cash back |

The exclusions list is short. No product category is named as excluded.

## Coupon codes: the firm wording

Many store pages say outside codes "may void" cash back. The Carter's terms say using codes not listed on Rakuten "will void" it.

That matters here, because the same page describes several Carter's coupons that come from the store, not from Rakuten:

- 20% off a first purchase for joining the email list
- 25% off for referring a friend
- A Friends and Family sale at 25% off

The page does not say whether these arrive as codes typed at checkout. If they do, the terms count them as codes not listed on Rakuten. On November 25, 2026, the offers on Rakuten's Carter's page were sale links, with no code shown: a Black Friday sale of 60% to 70% off almost everything, pajamas from $6 and free shipping on all orders.

## Rewarding Moments

Rakuten's page describes the store's loyalty program: one point per dollar, and $10 in rewards at 100 points. The cash back terms do not mention it. Whether the part of an order paid with those rewards earns is not confirmed.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **Pickup.** Not mentioned in the terms. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The page says to check the Carter's mobile app for coupons. The terms do not mention the app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension, and a coupon from the store's app may be a code not listed on Rakuten.
- **In stores.** The Carter's page showed an online rate only. Carter's did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).
- **Shipping.** The page gives the store's free shipping threshold as $50 in one place and $35 in another. Whether shipping and taxes count toward cash back is not stated in the Carter's terms.
- **Price adjustments.** The page says Carter's refunds the difference if an item goes on sale within 14 days. How a price adjustment changes cash back is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

Prices are those shown on Rakuten's Carter's page on November 25, 2026.

| Purchase | Price | At 8% | At the 2% "was" rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Girls cotton stretch leggings | $6.00 | $0.48 | $0.12 |
| Baby 4-pack long-sleeve bodysuits | $12.00 | $0.96 | $0.24 |
| OshKosh B'gosh toddler jeans | $30.00 | $2.40 | $0.60 |
| A $60 order of eligible items | $60.00 | $4.80 | $1.20 |
| Gift card | Any | $0 | $0 |

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "today". Rakuten's help page says online cash back typically takes 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, and that a full or partial return can void it. Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If a purchase never appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a Carter's coupon code from an email, the app or a referral that takes more off than the cash back gives. Using it voids the cash back.
- You are buying or paying with a gift card.
- You are ordering from outside the US site.
- You shop in a Carter's store. No in-store offer was seen.
- You are counting on 8% later. The page marks 2% as the earlier rate and promises nothing.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Carter's?**
8% on November 25, 2026, marked "was 2%". Rates change daily.

**Can you use a Carter's coupon code and still get cash back?**
Only a code listed on Rakuten. The terms say other codes will void cash back.

**Do Carter's gift cards earn cash back?**
No. The terms exclude both buying and redeeming gift cards.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

A store can drop to no cash back for a day or a season and come back later. A store that is missing from the table either has no page on Rakuten or its page could not be read today; that is not confirmed either way.

## How to read an "up to" rate

The headline is the ceiling, not the typical rate. A store page on Rakuten lists the rate for each category, and the exclusions sit in the terms below that list. Three things decide what a purchase earns:

- **The category.** Electronics, gift cards and sale items are often set lower than the headline, or at nothing.
- **The exclusions.** Many stores exclude gift cards, some brands, and orders paid with certain coupons.
- **The order of steps.** Cash back is tied to activating first, through a Rakuten link, the app or the browser extension, then buying in the same session.

A worked example: at a store with "up to 10%" where the item's category is set at 2%, a $200 order earns $4.00, not $20.00. Taxes and shipping do not count.

For the full steps, see [how Rakuten works, step by step](/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/). For the days around Thanksgiving, see [Rakuten on Black Friday](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/) and [Rakuten on Cyber Monday](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/). Card rewards come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## When the money arrives

A purchase usually shows as pending within days, then is confirmed after the store's return window. Rakuten pays four times a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and, if an order never shows, [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You are buying from a store showing "None" today. There is nothing to earn there until the rate returns.
- The item is in an excluded category. The store's Rakuten page lists these.
- Another discount beats the rate. A coupon code not listed on Rakuten can void the cash back, so compare the two before choosing.
- You expect to return the item. Returned orders lose their cash back.

## Quick answers

**Which store has the highest Rakuten rate today?**
Among the stores read on November 27, 2026, the highest headline rates were Petco (25%), Ray-Ban (up to 25%), PetSmart (20%), Bloomingdale's (15%), Carter's (15%). These are ceilings; most items earn less.

**How often do Rakuten rates change?**
Daily, and sometimes during the day. This page is read once each morning, so check the store's Rakuten page before buying.

**Why does a store show no cash back?**
Stores set their own rates and can pause them. Today these showed none: DoorDash, Hertz, Hilton, Home Depot, Lululemon, Nordstrom, Pottery Barn, Walmart, Wayfair, Williams Sonoma.

# Rakuten Chewy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-chewy-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-22
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 22, 2026, Rakuten's Chewy page showed 4% cash back, raised from a usual 2%. Pet prescriptions, flea and tick products, Chewy+ subscriptions, gift cards and every Autoship order after the first are excluded.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate, and how it moves

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 22, 2026 | 4% | 2% |

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the store's usual rate. No category table appears, so the one rate covers all eligible items.

Black Friday is November 27, 2026. Rates often move that week, in either direction, and nothing on the page promises what the rate will be.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Chewy list these as earning nothing:

- Pet prescriptions
- Flea and tick products
- Chewy+ subscriptions
- The purchase or redemption of gift cards
- Autoship orders after the initial order

The terms do not define "flea and tick products". Whether that covers only treatments, or also collars, shampoos and sprays, is not confirmed. Whether an excluded item affects the rest of an order is not stated either.

## Autoship is the term that matters

Autoship is Chewy's repeat-delivery program. Rakuten's page is clear on it: the first Autoship order earns cash back, and the page's FAQ says "subsequent Autoship orders do not qualify for Cash Back."

The page says later Autoship orders get the store's own 5% discount. That is a store discount, described on Rakuten's page on November 22, 2026, and it can change.

That leaves a sum for regular buyers. A one-time order placed through Rakuten earns the day's rate. A repeat Autoship order earns no cash back but gets the store's Autoship discount.

| $80 food order | Store discount | Rakuten cash back | Total back |
|---|---|---|---|
| One-time, at 2% | $0 | $1.60 | $1.60 |
| One-time, at 4% | $0 | $3.20 | $3.20 |
| Repeat Autoship, 5% off | $4.00 | $0 | $4.00 |

At these figures the repeat Autoship discount is worth more than either rate, and it arrives as a lower price rather than weeks later. Taxes and shipping do not count toward cash back. Whether canceling Autoship and starting a new one counts as a new "initial order" is not confirmed.

## Other terms

- **Coupon codes.** The Chewy terms list no code rule. Rakuten's general page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.
- **App.** The page's FAQ says to reach Chewy through Rakuten's site or the Rakuten app. The terms do not mention orders placed directly in the Chewy app. Not confirmed; a purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.
- **Returns.** No store rule is listed. Rakuten's general help page says returned and canceled items lose their cash back.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | At 2% | At 4% |
|---|---|---|---|
| Toys and treats | $50 | $1.00 | $2.00 |
| Crate and bed | $180 | $3.60 | $7.20 |
| Prescription or flea treatment | Any | $0 | $0 |

## In stores

Chewy sells online. It did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 22, 2026. The list was cut off after 21 stores. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When you get the money

The page says cash back is added to the Rakuten account the same day, as pending. Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- Your orders are repeat Autoship deliveries. Only the first one earns.
- You mainly buy prescriptions or flea and tick products.
- You are buying or spending gift cards.
- You order directly in the Chewy app and do not want to start from Rakuten.
- You are paying for a Chewy+ subscription.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Chewy?**
4% on November 22, 2026, against a usual 2%. Rates change daily.

**Do Autoship orders earn cash back?**
The first Autoship order does. Later Autoship orders do not.

**Do pet medications earn cash back?**
Pet prescriptions and flea and tick products are excluded.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two. [Welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus](/rakuten-welcome-bonus-vs-referral-bonus/) compares the two offers as read on November 26, 2026.

# Rakuten Costco cash back: does it work, and what works instead?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-costco-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-24
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

No. On November 24, 2026, Rakuten's Costco page was labeled "Coupons Only" and showed no cash back rate. What still pays at Costco is Costco's own annual 2% Reward for Executive Members and the rewards on the card you pay with.

This page is information, not financial advice. Store listings change, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rates at stores that do pay, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## What Rakuten's Costco page showed on November 24, 2026

| Point | What the page showed |
|---|---|
| Cash back rate | None |
| Label in place of a rate | "Coupons Only" |
| Rate tiers | None listed |
| Terms and exclusions section | None on the page |
| Coupons or deals listed | None appeared in the page as loaded |

Rakuten's page says it plainly: "Costco doesn't offer Cash Back on Rakuten." Two Rakuten addresses for the store led to the same page.

Rakuten's Black Friday page names Costco in its list of top Black Friday stores. Rakuten's Costco Black Friday page, read the same day, also showed "Coupons Only" and listed other stores with their rates under "similar stores". A rate seen next to the Costco name on those pages belongs to another store.

Whether Costco paid cash back through Rakuten in the past, and whether it will, is not confirmed.

## In stores and with the extension

Costco did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 24, 2026. The list did not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

What the Rakuten browser extension shows on Costco.com is not confirmed. With no rate on the store page, there is no cash back for it to activate.

## What works instead: Costco's own 2% Reward

Costco's Executive Membership pays an annual 2% Reward on qualified purchases at Costco warehouses, on Costco.com and with Costco Travel. These are the terms on Costco's page on November 24, 2026:

| Term | What Costco's page says |
|---|---|
| Reward | About 2% of pre-tax purchases, less refunds |
| Cap | $1,250 in any 12-month period |
| Cost of upgrading | $65 a year on top of a Gold Star or Business membership |
| Total at renewal | $130 a year |
| When it is issued | About three months before the renewal date, with the renewal statement |
| Not counted | Tobacco, gasoline, Costco Shop Cards, postage stamps, alcohol in certain states, and other items the terms list |

Costco states that the Reward may come to less than the upgrade fee. The sum is simple: $65 divided by 2% is $3,250. Below $3,250 a year in qualified purchases, the Reward is less than the extra fee. Purchases made before upgrading do not count.

## What works instead: card rewards

Card rewards do not depend on Rakuten, so they are earned at Costco either way. See [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/) for how the two normally combine.

Costco's own card is the Costco Anywhere Visa Card by Citi. Citi's page on November 24, 2026 listed:

| Purchase | Rate |
|---|---|
| Gas at Costco | 5% |
| Other eligible gas and EV charging | 4% |
| Restaurants and eligible travel, including Costco Travel | 3% |
| Other Costco and Costco.com purchases | 2% |
| Everything else | 1% |

The 5% and 4% rates apply to the first $7,000 a year in combined gas and EV charging, then 1%. There is no annual fee with a paid Costco membership. The cash back comes once a year as a certificate after the February statement closes, to be redeemed at a U.S. Costco warehouse by December 31. Card offers vary by applicant and change.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Rakuten | Executive 2% Reward | Costco card at 2% |
|---|---|---|---|
| $400 grocery and household run | $0 | $8.00 | $8.00 |
| $2,000 television on Costco.com | $0 | $40.00 | $40.00 |
| $3,250 over a year | $0 | $65.00 | $65.00 |
| $62,500 over a year | $0 | $1,250 (the cap) | $1,250 |

The two right-hand columns can both apply to one purchase. Both are paid once a year, not after each order.

## The other warehouse club

Rakuten lists Sam's Club with cash back, with its own tiers and a long exclusion list. See [Rakuten at Sam's Club](/rakuten-sams-club-cash-back-how-it-works/). Walmart is a third case: see [Rakuten at Walmart](/rakuten-walmart-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- Anyone starting a Costco order from Rakuten for cash back. There is none to earn.
- Members who spend under $3,250 a year on qualified purchases, if the 2% Reward is the only reason to upgrade.
- Members who mostly buy gasoline, tobacco or Shop Cards. Those do not count toward the 2% Reward.
- Anyone who would carry a balance on a card. Interest costs more than 2%.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten give cash back at Costco?**
No. On November 24, 2026, Rakuten's Costco page showed "Coupons Only" and no cash back rate.

**Why does a rate appear on Rakuten's Costco Black Friday page?**
The rates there are for other stores listed as similar to Costco. The Costco entry itself showed coupons only.

**What pays cash back at Costco instead?**
Costco's annual 2% Reward for Executive Members, up to $1,250 a year, and the rewards on the card used to pay.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two. [Welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus](/rakuten-welcome-bonus-vs-referral-bonus/) compares the two offers as read on November 26, 2026.

# Rakuten Crocs cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-crocs-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Crocs. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Crocs page showed 9% cash back, marked "was 3%". The offer covers the crocs.com US site only, and orders judged to be for reselling, along with anything paid for by redeeming a gift card, earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 25, 2026 | 9% | Was 3% |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. Here it points to 3% as the usual figure. The page does not say when the 9% ends. No category table appears; every product and offer on the page carried the same 9%.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| Orders on the crocs.com US site | Yes, 9% on the day checked |
| Buying a Crocs gift card | Yes, according to the terms |
| The part of an order paid by redeeming a gift card | No |
| Orders on Crocs international sites | No |
| Orders deemed for reselling purposes | No |

Two points stand out.

**Gift cards.** Many Rakuten store pages exclude gift cards outright. The Crocs terms say cash back is available on the purchase of gift cards, but not on their redemption. So the card earns when bought and the later order paid with it does not. For how this compares, see [Rakuten and gift cards](/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/).

**Reselling.** The terms do not say how an order is deemed to be for reselling, or what quantity triggers it. Not confirmed.

## Coupon codes

The Crocs terms say use of coupon or promotional codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's page listed these Crocs offers alongside the 9% rate:

- An extra 20% off sitewide
- $20 off orders of $100
- $15 off orders of $75
- Up to 60% off plus doorbusters
- 30% off the Pokemon collection
- 25% off the NFL collection with free shipping

The page also describes a Crocs Club sign-up coupon and a student discount through Student Beans. Neither is named in the cash back terms. Whether using one of them voids cash back is not confirmed.

## Where the page disagrees with itself

These are the store's own offers, not cash back rules, but the figures on Rakuten's page do not match each other:

- Free shipping is given as orders over $44.99 in one place, $24.99 in another and $49.99 in a third.
- The Crocs Club coupon is described as 20% off in one section and 15% off in another.

The Crocs site on the day of purchase is the place to look.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **Pickup.** Not mentioned on the page.
- **App.** The terms do not mention a Crocs app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.
- **In stores.** The Crocs page showed an online rate only. Crocs did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).
- **Taxes and shipping.** The Crocs terms do not mention them. Not confirmed for this store.

## What it comes to

Prices are those shown on Rakuten's Crocs page on November 25, 2026.

| Purchase | Price | At 9% | At the 3% "was" rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pokemon Character 5 Pack of charms | $7.00 | $0.63 | $0.21 |
| A $75 order of eligible items | $75.00 | $6.75 | $2.25 |
| A $100 order of eligible items | $100.00 | $9.00 | $3.00 |
| An order paid in full with a gift card | Any | $0 | $0 |

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "today". Rakuten's help page says online cash back typically takes 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, and that returns reduce or void it. Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If a purchase never appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You are ordering from a Crocs site outside the US.
- You are buying in quantity to resell.
- You are paying with a Crocs gift card.
- You have a code from outside Rakuten that takes more off than the cash back gives.
- You are counting on 9% later in the season. The page marks 3% as the earlier rate and promises nothing.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Crocs?**
9% on November 25, 2026, marked "was 3%". Rates change daily.

**Do Crocs gift cards earn cash back?**
Buying one does, according to the terms. Paying with one does not.

**Does Rakuten work on Crocs sites outside the US?**
No. The terms limit cash back to orders on the crocs.com US site.

# Rakuten CVS cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-cvs-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back on online orders at CVS. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's CVS page showed 3% cash back on all non-excluded items, with no raised rate. Prescriptions, orders placed through the CVS mobile app, gift cards and the part of an order paid with ExtraBucks earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

| Rate | Category on Rakuten's list |
|---|---|
| 3% | All CVS non-excluded items |
| 0% | Excluded items and orders (see below) |

No "was" label appeared. That label marks a rate raised above the store's base rate, so 3% is the plain rate. Nothing on the page promises a higher rate on Black Friday (November 27, 2026).

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| Non-excluded items ordered on the CVS website after a Rakuten click | Yes, 3% |
| Prescriptions | No |
| CarePass membership signups | No |
| OTC Health Solutions orders | No |
| COVID-19 tests | No |
| Gift cards, bought or redeemed | No |
| The part of an order paid with ExtraBucks | No |
| Orders placed through the CVS mobile app | No |
| Orders CVS deems to be for reselling | No |

## The reselling limits

The terms put numbers on reselling. An order CVS deems to be for reselling does not earn if it is over $200, or if it includes more than 8 of the same item (the terms say "SKU"). The wording ties both limits to orders CVS judges to be for resale. Whether every order over $200 loses cash back is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes and ExtraBucks

The CVS terms say that using coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back, and to keep to codes Rakuten provides.

Rakuten's page describes the ExtraCare card as paying 2% back in ExtraBucks Rewards on qualifying purchases. Spending ExtraBucks is different: the part of an order paid with them earns no cash back. The page's question-and-answer section says CVS allows up to three coupons on an order, plus manufacturer coupons and ExtraBucks offers. That is the store's rule. Whether clipped ExtraCare coupons count as "codes not listed on Rakuten" is not confirmed.

## CVS Photo is listed separately

The terms say CVSPhoto.com purchases earn the rate on the CVSPhoto.com store page, not the CVS rate. That rate was not read for this page.

| $40 order placed in the CVS app | $0 | $0 |
| Prescription refill | $0 | $0 |

Taxes and shipping are not mentioned in the CVS terms. The page says CVS ships free on orders of $35 or more.

## Pickup, delivery and stores

- **Pickup.** The terms do not mention store pickup of online orders. Not confirmed.
- **Instacart.** Rakuten's page describes one-hour CVS delivery through Instacart. That is an order with a different company; the CVS terms do not cover it. Not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The CVS page showed an online rate only. CVS did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "tomorrow". Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Card rewards are separate; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You are filling a prescription. It earns nothing.
- You order in the CVS mobile app. App orders are excluded.
- You shop in a CVS store. The rate is for online orders.
- You are paying mostly with ExtraBucks.
- You are relying on a coupon code that is not on Rakuten.

## Quick answers

3% on November 25, 2026, on all non-excluded items, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

No. Prescriptions are first on the excluded list, along with COVID-19 tests and CarePass signups.

**Does the CVS app count?**

# Rakuten Cyber Monday cash back 2026: what Rakuten shows now, and how it differs from Black Friday

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/
Facts checked: 2026-11-27
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

For Cyber Monday (November 30, 2026), Rakuten is running one event: on November 27 its home page advertised Black Friday to Cyber Monday shopping with hundreds of brands at up to 15% cash back. Its Cyber Monday page showed raised rates that day, such as 12% at Dell and 15% at kate spade new york, but no Rakuten page promises that the rates listed now will hold on Monday; that is not confirmed.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so the rate on the store's Rakuten page when you buy is the one that counts. The table lower on this page shows each tracked store's rate day by day, and [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/) has this morning's readings. New to Rakuten? See [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/), [how to sign up](/how-to-sign-up-for-rakuten/) and [what the sign-up bonus asks you to spend](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

## What Rakuten's pages say on November 27, 2026

- The date: Monday, November 30, 2026.
- The home page headline covers Black Friday to Cyber Monday, at up to 15%.
- Earning on the day works the same as on any other day.
- Most Cyber Monday sales start on November 30. Some stores start on Black Friday or earlier.
- Some deals last one day only. Others run several days or through Cyber Week, and it varies by store.
- Limited-time offers can end early, and items can sell out.

**Not confirmed:** any store's rate for November 30, whether the 12% rate shown at more than 600 stores on Black Friday continues through Monday or Cyber Week, and an end date for the event. None of these is stated on Rakuten's Cyber Monday page, Black Friday page or home page.

## Rates on the Cyber Monday page three days ahead

Read on Rakuten's Cyber Monday page on November 27, 2026, signed out. "Was" is Rakuten's label for the usual rate.

- 24 featured stores were listed, and 18 of them showed 12% or up to 12%.
- Examples: Dell Technologies 12% (was 2%), Banana Republic 12% (was 2%), Canon 12% (was 2.5%), Keurig 12% (was 2%), kate spade new york 15% (was 2%), FramesDirect 17% (was 3%), Ray-Ban and Oakley up to 25% (was 4%).
- Not every featured store was at 12%. Abt Electronics showed 4% (was 2%).
- Several sale banners on the page carried labels saying they end today or tomorrow. Those labels belong to the store's sale, and the page does not say whether the cash back rate ends with it.

Compared with this page's reading of November 23:

| Store | Seen November 23 | Seen November 27 |
|---|---|---|
| Macy's | 10% | 15% |
| Dyson | 10% | 15% |
| Lenovo | 10% | 12% |
| Nike | 10% | 10% |
| kate spade new york | 15% | 15% |
| Kohl's | 2% | 2% |

These are snapshots, not a forecast. Nike showed 6% from November 24 to 26 and was back at 10% on November 27. Sephora showed 6% on November 25, 2% on November 26 and 8% on November 27.

## How it differs from Black Friday

| | Black Friday | Cyber Monday |
|---|---|---|
| Date in 2026 | Friday, November 27 | Monday, November 30 |
| Origin, per Rakuten | In-store doorbusters | An online-only shopping day |
| How Rakuten cash back is earned | Activate, then buy | The same |
| Rates published in advance | None found | None found |

Rakuten's Cyber Monday page says the two events now overlap, with many stores running sales through the whole weekend. Its Black Friday page says many retailers offer similar deals on both days. No Rakuten page says cash back rates are higher on one day than the other. Whether a given store pays more on Friday or on Monday is not confirmed until the day.

One practical difference follows from the origin. Rakuten says some stores add in-store promotions or pickup options on Cyber Monday, but it is mostly an online day. Online orders are where Rakuten's click-through tracking applies; purchases in a physical store earn a different way, covered in [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

The mechanics that apply to both days (exclusions, tracking and returns) are in [how cash back works on Black Friday](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/), and the general sequence is in [how Rakuten works, step by step](/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/).

These are dated reports, not a guide to 2026.

The 2023 report came out four days before Cyber Monday, so the offer was not limited to the Monday. No dated report of Rakuten's rates on Cyber Monday itself in 2024 or 2025 was found; those are not confirmed.

## When a November 30 order is paid

Rakuten says shopping orders typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then pays on fixed dates.

| Order on November 30, 2026 | Confirmed about | Paid |
|---|---|---|
| Confirmed in 3 weeks | December 21, 2026 | February 15, 2027 |
| Confirmed in 14 weeks | March 8, 2027 | May 15, 2027 |

These dates are worked out from Rakuten's typical range. Rakuten's terms give 90 days from the purchase to report missing cash back, which for a November 30 order is February 28, 2027. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- The item costs less at a store Rakuten does not cover. A lower price now is worth more than a rebate paid in February or May.
- You are waiting for Monday only because of a rate. No Monday rate has been published, and the item may sell out first.
- You have a coupon code from another site worth more than the cash back. Codes not listed on Rakuten can void it.
- You would add to the order because the rate looks high. Twelve percent back still leaves 88% spent.

## Quick answers

**When is Cyber Monday 2026?**
Monday, November 30, 2026, three days after Black Friday on November 27.

**Are Rakuten rates higher on Cyber Monday than on Black Friday?**
Not confirmed. As of November 27, Rakuten has not published Monday's rates, and rates change daily.

**Do Cyber Monday rates last all week?**
Rakuten says some offers run through Cyber Week and some last one day only. It varies by store.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

The header says "No Cash Back". Further down, the page's shopping tips still say a DoorDash order through Rakuten earns cash back on top of a coupon. # Rakuten DSW cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
