Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's DSW page showed 2% cash back, with no raised rate two days before Black Friday. The part of an order paid with rewards, gift cards and purchases made with gift cards, and five named luxury brands earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

The page showed 2% with no "was" label, so 2% is the plain rate. No category table appears. The Black Friday deals listed on the page that day carried the same 2%.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for DSW list these as earning nothing:

- Orders deemed to be for reselling
- The portion of an order paid for with rewards
- Gift cards
- Purchases made with gift cards
- Products from five brands: Gucci, Bottega Veneta, Ferragamo, Off-White and Versace

The gift card rule is wider than at many stores. It covers both buying a gift card and paying with one.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns? |
|---|---|
| Shoes or a handbag from a brand not on the excluded list | Yes, 2% that day |
| A pair from one of the five excluded brands | No |
| The part of an order paid with a VIP reward | No |
| An order paid with a gift card | No |
| A gift card | No |

In dollars: an $80 pair at 2% comes to $1.60, and a $150 pair to $3.00. These are worked examples. Rakuten's general help page says taxes and shipping fees are never eligible.

## VIP rewards and the 2%

The page describes DSW VIP, the store's rewards program: one point per $1, and a $5 reward for every 100 points. It also describes a $5 birthday reward.

Earning points is not mentioned in the cash back terms. Spending a reward is: the portion paid for with rewards earns nothing. On an $80 order with a $5 reward applied, $75 would be the amount that counts, which is $1.50 at 2%. Whether points are still earned on an order that also earns cash back is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes

The terms on this page have no line about coupon codes. Rakuten's general help page says using codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. On November 25, 2026, the page listed sale offers, including 30% off a purchase for Black Friday, with the same 2%.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **Pickup.** The page describes buying online and picking up in a store. The cash back terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **Pay over time.** The page says Afterpay can be chosen at checkout. Whether an order paid that way tracks is not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The store page showed an online rate only. The store did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "today". It stays pending until the store confirms it; Rakuten's help page gives 3 to 14 weeks as typical. Payment follows on four dates a year; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You are paying with a gift card. The purchase earns nothing.
- You are paying most of the order with VIP rewards.
- You want one of the five excluded brands.
- You have a code from outside Rakuten that saves more than 2%.
- You often send shoes back. Rakuten's help page says returned orders do not earn.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at DSW?**
2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Does an order paid with a gift card earn cash back?**
No. The terms exclude gift cards and purchases made with gift cards.

**Which brands are excluded?**
Gucci, Bottega Veneta, Ferragamo, Off-White and Versace products earn nothing.

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

# Rakuten eBay cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-ebay-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-21
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, in select departments. On November 21, 2026, Rakuten's eBay page showed 1% cash back, capped at $50 on any single purchase. Electronics, phones, computers, video games, gift cards and purchases made by sending the seller an offer are excluded.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## Which departments earn

Rakuten's terms say cash back is only available for select departments.

| Listed under the 1% rate (November 21, 2026) | Listed as earning nothing |
|---|---|
| Clothing, shoes and accessories | Electronics |
| Home and garden | Cell phones and accessories |
| Jewelry and watches | Computers and tablets |
| Health and beauty | Cameras and photo |
| Collectibles, antiques, art | Video games and consoles |
| Sporting goods | Coins and paper money |
| Sports memorabilia, cards and fan shop | Books and magazines, movies and TV, music |
| Toys and hobbies | Musical instruments and gear |
| Auto parts and accessories, eBay Motors | Baby essentials, pet supplies |
| Crafts, stamps, pottery and glass | Travel, tickets and experiences, specialty services |
| Dolls and bears, entertainment memorabilia | Gift cards and coupons |

Some departments are on neither list. Whether those earn is not confirmed.

## How you buy matters

The terms set rules on the type of sale, not only the item.

- **Auctions and Buy It Now.** Cash back is paid on winning bids and Buy It Now purchases.
- **Offers to the seller.** Rakuten's terms say cash back is not available on purchases made through the site's make-an-offer feature. If a seller accepts your offer, the purchase earns nothing.
- **Bidding services.** Using a third-party bidding service voids cash back.
- **Unpaid items.** Nothing is earned on an item that goes unpaid.
- **The cap.** The terms say: "A maximum of $50 Cash Back may be earned on any single purchase."

How an auction is tracked when the bid is placed days before the auction ends is not explained on the page. Rakuten's general rule is that a purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension. Whether the click must come before the bid or before payment is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | At 1% |
|---|---|---|
| Used golf bag | $120 | $1.20 |
| Watch | $800 | $8.00 |
| Car parts | $2,500 | $25.00 |
| Vehicle or high-value collectible | $5,000 or more | $50.00 (the cap) |
| Laptop | Any | $0 |

At 1%, the cap is reached at $5,000. Taxes and shipping do not count.

On a negotiable listing, the choice is between making an offer and earning cash back. An accepted offer that takes $20 off a $300 item saves more than the $3.00 that Buy It Now would earn.

## How the rate moves

The page showed no usual-rate label on November 21, 2026, which Rakuten adds when a rate has been raised. That suggests 1% was the standard rate that day. Rates change daily, and Rakuten's terms say they can vary by member and category.

The page also showed an offer for holders of Rakuten's own credit card: an extra 4% when paying with that card through PayPal. That is a card benefit, separate from the store rate, and its terms were not read for this page.

## App, coupon codes and gift cards

- **App.** The terms do not mention the marketplace's own app. An order started directly in that app is not expected to track.
- **Coupon codes.** No store-specific rule appears. Rakuten's general page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.
- **Gift cards.** The gift cards and coupons department is excluded. Whether paying with a gift card affects cash back is not confirmed.
- **Local pickup.** Not mentioned; not confirmed either way.

## When you get the money

Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You buy electronics, phones, computers or video games. Those departments are excluded.
- You negotiate by sending sellers an offer. Those purchases earn nothing.
- You use a sniping or bidding service.
- You buy mostly in the marketplace's own app.
- Your purchases are small. At 1%, $500 of eligible spending is needed to reach the roughly $5 that a payment requires.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at eBay?**
1% in select departments on November 21, 2026. Rates change daily.

**Do electronics earn cash back?**
No. Electronics, cell phones, computers, cameras and video games are on the excluded list.

**Is there a limit per purchase?**
Yes. The terms cap cash back at $50 on any single purchase.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

# Does Rakuten give cash back on Expedia and Booking.com, and when does it pay out?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-expedia-booking-com-cash-back/
Facts checked: 2026-11-21
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, both are listed. On November 21, 2026 Rakuten showed Expedia at up to 3% and Booking.com at up to 8%, with flights at a flat $1 to $1.25. The cash back is added only after the trip is over: within a week at Expedia, within three months at Booking.com.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check each store's page on Rakuten on the day you book.

For the wider picture across hotel chains and other booking sites, see [Rakuten on hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/). This page goes deeper on these two.

## Rates seen on November 21, 2026

| What you book | Expedia | Booking.com |
|---|---|---|
| Hotels and other stays | 3% | 8% (Rakuten lists the usual rate as 4%) |
| Flights | $1.25 flat | $1 flat |
| Packages | 2% | Stays or flights in a package are eligible |
| Rental cars | 1% | 3% prepaid, 2% pay at pickup |
| Activities | 3% | 2% (attractions) |
| Airport taxis | Not listed | 2% |
| Cruises | Excluded | Not listed |

## How fast the rate moves

Expedia is a clear example. One day earlier, on November 20, 2026, the same Rakuten page showed Expedia hotels at 10%. On November 21 it showed 3%.

| $800 hotel stay | Cash back |
|---|---|
| At 10% (Expedia, November 20) | $80 |
| At 8% (Booking.com, November 21) | $64 |
| At 3% (Expedia, November 21) | $24 |

The rate that matters is the one shown when you start the booking. A rate seen last week says little about today.

## When it pays out

| Stage | Expedia | Booking.com |
|---|---|---|
| Shows as pending | Within 5 days of reserving | May not show until travel is complete |
| Added to the account | Within a week after travel | Within 3 months after travel |
| Paid to you | Next quarterly date | Next quarterly date |

Rakuten pays on February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15. A worked example for a stay that ends on March 20, 2027:

- **Expedia:** added by about March 27, which points to the May 15 payment.
- **Booking.com:** added by about June 20 at the latest. If it lands after the cut-off for May, it is paid August 15.

The exact cut-off before each payment date is not confirmed here. Rakuten's general travel guidance is wider still, at 6 to 17 weeks after the trip. The full schedule is in [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Rules specific to each site

**Expedia**

- Only orders completed through Expedia.com count. Bookings through the travel agent portal do not.
- Event tickets and cruises are excluded.
- Coupon codes: the page is not consistent. One line excludes any booking made with a coupon code. Another says only codes not listed on Rakuten void cash back. The cautious reading is to use no code.
- The page says Rakuten cash back can be combined with One Key member prices and OneKeyCash on eligible bookings.

**Booking.com**

- Only bookings on the U.S. Booking.com site count.
- Booking.com for Business and bookings with Partner Offers are excluded.
- The terms say: "Cash Back will be paid out only for completed bookings." A canceled stay or a no-show earns nothing.

**Both**

Rakuten's travel rules say any change to a reservation voids cash back, including dates, room type and flight times. To change plans, cancel and rebook through Rakuten.

## Not confirmed

- Whether a booking finished in the Expedia or Booking.com phone app counts. Neither Rakuten page says. Expedia's terms refer to orders completed through Expedia.com.
- Whether pay-at-the-property stays are treated differently from prepaid ones.
- Whether a Booking.com Genius discount affects eligibility.

## Who should skip it

- Your plans may change. An edited booking loses the cash back.
- You want hotel points or elite credit from a chain. Third-party bookings usually earn neither.
- You are booking only a flight. $1 to $1.25 is the whole reward.
- You have a coupon code for Expedia that you would rather use.
- You need the money soon. A stay months away can mean a wait of half a year or more.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten work with Expedia?**
Yes. On November 21, 2026 it showed 3% on hotels and homes, 2% on packages, 1% on cars and $1.25 on flights.

**Does Rakuten work with Booking.com?**
Yes. On November 21, 2026 it showed 8% on accommodations and $1 on flights, on the U.S. site only.

**When is travel cash back paid?**
After the trip. Expedia adds it within a week of travel, Booking.com within three months, then it goes out on the next quarterly payment date.

# Forgot to activate Rakuten before buying: can you still get the cash back?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-forgot-to-activate-cash-back/
Facts checked: 2026-11-24
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Usually not. Rakuten's help page says purchases earn cash back "only if you start a Shopping Trip with Rakuten", and no Rakuten help page describes adding cash back to an order placed without one. What can earn is a new order that starts from a Rakuten link.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## Why the order cannot be matched afterward

A shopping trip is Rakuten's name for the click from Rakuten to a store, made on the site, in the app or with the extension's button. Each trip gets a unique number, and a tracking cookie in the browser links the purchase to the account.

Rakuten's help page explains what happens without that click: Rakuten has no way of showing the store that the buyer is a Rakuten member. The store pays Rakuten a commission only for shoppers it can see Rakuten sent. With no click, the store has no record to pay on. The steps are on [how Rakuten works, step by step](/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/).

## Where you are decides what you can do

| Where you are | What Rakuten's pages say | What you can do |
|---|---|---|
| Items in the cart, not paid yet | Activate before adding items; some stores cannot link a purchase if items were in the cart first | Empty the cart, activate, add the items again, pay in that tab |
| Order placed, no click through Rakuten | Purchases earn only with a shopping trip | Nothing for that order; a new order through Rakuten can earn |
| Order placed, and you may have clicked | Trips are kept in the account for up to three months | Check your shopping trips for that date |
| Bought in a physical store | In-store offers must be added before the purchase | Nothing for that purchase |

## Not paid yet: you still have time

Rakuten's help page says that with the extension, cash back can be activated before shopping starts or before checkout. So activating late is allowed, up to the point of paying.

There is a catch. The same page says to activate before adding anything to the cart, because some stores do not let Rakuten link a purchase when items were already in the cart. Which stores those are is not listed. Emptying the cart, activating, and adding the items again covers both cases. Then check out in the tab that opened from Rakuten, and look for the pop-up saying cash back is active.

## Already paid: check for a trip first

People sometimes click through and forget they did, or the extension was activated earlier in the session. Rakuten keeps a shopping trip in the account for up to three months, even when nothing was bought. If a trip to that store shows on the order date, this is a tracking question, not a forgotten activation, and the claim steps on [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/) apply. Give the order 48 hours to appear first.

## What the Missing Cash Back form covers

Rakuten separates two cases. A missing shopping trip means it has no record of the click. Missing cash back means the trip was recorded but the order shows $0 or ineligible.

The help page points to the form for members who have gone through its checklist and still believe they should have earned. The first question on that checklist is whether cash back was activated before items went in the cart. Rakuten's terms set the deadline: contact Member Services within 90 days of the transaction. The terms also say that whether a purchase qualifies is at Rakuten's sole discretion.

The form sits behind sign-in. Whether it accepts an order with no shopping trip, and whether Rakuten ever credits one as a courtesy, is not confirmed. Nothing in the help pages says it does.

## Canceling and ordering again

No Rakuten help page covers this for a forgotten activation. Two pages cover close cases:

- For exchanges, Rakuten's page says a shopper can return the item and place an entirely new order, starting with Rakuten.
- For travel, Rakuten says to cancel and rebook through Rakuten when plans change.

Both rest on the same rule: a new order that starts from a Rakuten link is a new shopping trip. The canceled order earns nothing, and the new one is treated like any other.

Whether you can cancel is the store's decision, not Rakuten's. Before doing it, check four things at the store:

- Its cancellation or return policy, and any return shipping or restocking cost.
- That the item is still in stock.
- That the price and any coupon you used are still available.
- The store's exclusions on Rakuten, so the new order is one that earns.

## Is it worth the trouble?

| Order | Rate | Cash back at stake |
|---|---|---|
| $40 | 2% | $0.80 |
| $150 | 4% | $6.00 |
| $400 | 10% | $40.00 |

Taxes and shipping do not count. Rates are examples; each store's rate is on [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/). If the price rose or a coupon expired since the first order, the reorder can cost more than the cash back returns.

## Not forgetting next time

Rakuten's extension shows an alert at stores with an offer, so there is no need to visit Rakuten first; it still has to be clicked. On a phone, the trip starts from the Rakuten app. The two are compared on [the app and the extension](/rakuten-app-vs-browser-extension/). A new trip is needed for every purchase, including a second order at the same store.

## Who should skip it

- The cash back at stake is a dollar or two. Canceling and reordering is not worth the risk.
- The item was a limited release or is low in stock.
- The first order used a sale price or code that has ended.
- The item is excluded at that store. A new order would earn nothing as well.

## Quick answers

**Can Rakuten add cash back after a purchase made without activating?**
Rakuten's help pages say a purchase earns only if it started from a Rakuten link. No retroactive credit is described.

**Can you activate Rakuten after adding items to the cart?**
Yes, before checkout. Some stores cannot link the purchase, so empty the cart and add the items again.

**How long do you have to report missing cash back?**
Rakuten's terms say within 90 days of the transaction. That applies where a shopping trip was started.

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Why didn't I earn cash back?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/why-didnt-i-earn-cash-back-360036367393)
- [Rakuten: How can I tell if I'm earning cash back?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/how-can-i-tell-if-im-earning-cash-back-360002100668)

# Do gift card purchases earn Rakuten cash back?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/
Facts checked: 2026-11-21
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Mostly no. Rakuten says most gift cards are excluded, and every store listing read for this page excluded them. The exception is a gift card seller with its own Rakuten listing: Giftcards.com showed 3% and CardCash 1% on November 21, 2026.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the seller's page on Rakuten on the day you buy.

## The general rule

Rakuten's help page puts it in one line: "Most gift cards are excluded from Cash Back." It then adds that cash back is offered on select gift cards.

In practice that splits into two cases.

| Where you buy the gift card | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| From the store itself (for example, an Apple card at Apple) | Usually no |
| From a gift card seller listed on Rakuten | Yes, at that seller's rate and terms |

## Stores that exclude gift cards

Each of these listings, read on November 21, 2026, excluded gift card purchases:

| Store | Gift card rule in its Rakuten terms |
|---|---|
| [Apple](/rakuten-apple-cash-back-how-it-works/) | Gift cards excluded |
| [Kohl's](/rakuten-kohls-cash-back-how-it-works/) | Gift cards excluded |
| Ulta Beauty | Any gift card, including e-gift cards |
| HP | Gift card purchases excluded |
| Dell | Gift cards excluded |
| Amazon | Buying and redeeming gift cards or vouchers excluded |

Assume a store excludes gift cards unless its terms say otherwise.

## Gift card sellers that did pay

| Seller | Rate seen November 21, 2026 | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Giftcards.com | 3% (usual rate listed as 1%) | Store-brand cards and Visa gift cards from $20 to $100 |
| CardCash | 1% | Sells cards below face value; a $50 Kohl's card was listed at $48.50 |

Giftcards.com's terms on Rakuten exclude:

- Mastercard gift cards and Mastercard eGift cards
- Giant Eagle and Foot Locker cards
- The portion paid for with rewards
- Purchases over $2,000
- Orders using a coupon code not listed on Rakuten (may void cash back)

The terms as read also carry a line excluding the Giftcards.com eGift card. Its scope is unclear, because Visa eGift cards were shown at 3% on another Rakuten page the same day. That point is not confirmed. A physical card is the safer assumption until the pending amount shows.

Cash back at Giftcards.com is added the next day, per its listing.

## The sums

Rakuten's listing gave 1% as the usual rate, so 3% looked like a raised one.

| Purchase at Giftcards.com | At 3% | At 1% |
|---|---|---|
| $50 store gift card | $1.50 | $0.50 |
| $100 Visa gift card | $3.00 | $1.00 |

Prepaid Visa gift cards commonly carry a purchase fee. The fee is not shown on Rakuten's page, so it is not confirmed here. Compare it with the cash back before buying: a fee of a few dollars can exceed 3% of a $100 card.

## Paying with a gift card

Paying is a separate rule from buying. Rakuten says some stores exclude a purchase, or the part of it, paid for with a gift card. Its gift card FAQ names Best Buy, CVS, Lowe's and Old Navy as stores that do not pay on the portion bought with a gift card, and says in-store purchases paid with a gift card do not earn.

| $100 order at a store that excludes gift card payment | Earns on |
|---|---|
| Paid fully by card | $100 |
| $40 gift card plus $60 by card | $60 |
| Paid fully with a gift card | $0 |

Other stores are silent on it. Titleist's listing, read a day earlier, excludes purchases made with gift cards. Read the store's terms before planning a two-step purchase.

## Not the same thing: taking your cash back as a gift card

Rakuten also lets some members redeem confirmed cash back for a gift card. That is a way to be paid, not a way to earn.

- Select members only, based on shopping history and balance
- At least $5 in confirmed cash back
- Members who earn American Express points are not eligible
- A request cannot be canceled once made

The other ways to be paid are in [check versus PayPal](/rakuten-big-fat-check-vs-paypal/).

## Who should skip it

- You want cash back for buying a store's own gift card at that store. It is almost always excluded.
- You are buying a Mastercard gift card. Giftcards.com's terms exclude it.
- You plan to pay with the gift card at a store that excludes gift card payment.

## Quick answers

**Do gift cards earn Rakuten cash back?**
Usually not at the store itself. Gift card sellers listed on Rakuten paid 1% to 3% on November 21, 2026.

**Do Visa gift cards earn cash back?**
Giftcards.com showed Visa gift cards at 3% that day. Mastercard gift cards were excluded.

**Does paying with a gift card void cash back?**
At some stores, for the part paid with the card. Rakuten names Best Buy, CVS, Lowe's and Old Navy.

# Can you get Rakuten cash back on golf clubs and gear?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-golf-gear-cash-back/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. Several golf retailers and club makers are on Rakuten, and most paid 2% to 3% cash back when checked on November 20, 2026. One retailer, PGA TOUR Superstore, showed a raised rate of 10% that day against a usual 2%.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy.

## Rates seen on November 20, 2026

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the store's usual rate.

| Store | Rate seen | Exclusions listed on Rakuten's page |
|---|---|---|
| PGA TOUR Superstore | 10% (was 2%) | Not confirmed; the terms did not load |
| Callaway Golf | 3% | Redeeming gift cards; coupon codes not found on Rakuten |
| Golf Galaxy | 2% | Gift cards; orders judged to be for resale (over 15 items); US customers only |
| TaylorMade Golf | 2% | Coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void it |
| Titleist | 2% | Gift cards and purchases made with gift cards |
| Callaway Golf Preowned | 2% | Not shown in the part of the page read |
| Rock Bottom Golf | 2% | Buying or redeeming gift cards |
| Dick's Sporting Goods | 2% | Warranties, services, gift cards, 15 or more of one item, the part paid with rewards |

Not confirmed today: GlobalGolf (its page did not load) and smaller shops such as Carl's Golfland, Fairway Golf and Golf Avenue. No Rakuten page for PING was found.

Sources also differ on PGA TOUR Superstore. An older Rakuten page showed 4%, while the two pages read on November 20 showed 10%. Rates move, which is why the date matters.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | At 2% | At 3% | At 10% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Golf shoes | $150 | $3.00 | $4.50 | $15.00 |
| Driver | $600 | $12.00 | $18.00 | $60.00 |
| Iron set | $1,400 | $28.00 | $42.00 | $140.00 |

Cash back is figured on the price of the goods. Rakuten says taxes and shipping never count.

On clubs, a raised rate can be real money, but only if that store's price is as low as you would pay elsewhere. A 2% rebate does not make up for a club that is $50 cheaper at another shop.

## Exclusions that matter for golf

- **Gift cards.** Most golf stores on Rakuten exclude buying gift cards, redeeming them, or both. Paying for a driver with a store gift card can mean no cash back.
- **Coupon codes.** Several listings say a code not shown on Rakuten may void the cash back. If a brand's email code saves more than the rebate, use the code and skip the rebate.
- **Services.** Dick's listing excludes services and extended warranties. Whether lessons, fittings or club repair earn at any golf store is not confirmed.
- **Trade-in credit.** How it is treated at golf stores is not confirmed.
- **Phone and chat orders.** Rakuten says orders placed by phone, chat or customer service do not qualify. A custom club order taken by phone falls here.
- **Returns and exchanges.** Returned items lose their cash back. Clubs are often exchanged after a few rounds, so wait for the order to show as confirmed before counting on it.

## Online only, as far as could be seen

These rates are for online orders that start at Rakuten. No golf retailer appeared in the part of Rakuten's in-store list that loaded on November 20, 2026, so in-store golf offers are not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When you get the money

Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You buy clubs in a shop after a fitting. The online rate does not apply to that purchase.
- You already have a coupon code, a member discount or a price match that beats 2% to 3%.
- You pay with store gift cards or trade-in credit.
- You buy golf gear once every few years and shop nowhere else through Rakuten. A payment needs about $5 confirmed.

## Quick answers

**Which golf stores are on Rakuten?**
On November 20, 2026: PGA TOUR Superstore, Golf Galaxy, Callaway, TaylorMade, Titleist, Rock Bottom Golf and Dick's Sporting Goods, among others.

**What rate do golf stores pay?**
Mostly 2% to 3% that day. PGA TOUR Superstore showed 10%, up from a usual 2%.

**Do gift card purchases earn cash back?**
Usually not. Most golf listings exclude gift cards.

# Rakuten Hilton cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-hilton-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

No (as of November 26, 2026), and here is what works instead. Rakuten's Hilton page read "No Cash Back" that day, with no rate list, no terms and no posting time. A separate listing pays 1.25% on buying Hilton points, and the Marriott and IHG pages on Rakuten paid cash back on room bookings the same day.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you book. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## What the Hilton page showed on November 26, 2026

| Item | What the page showed |
|---|---|
| Headline | "No Cash Back" |
| "Was" label | None |
| Rate list by brand | None |
| Terms and exclusions | None |
| Posting time | None |
| Member reviews | 149, average 4.0 |

The page still exists and still describes the hotel group, so the address works. It simply carries no offer. Some of the member reviews on it mention earning at Hilton in the past. When the rate was removed, and whether it will return, is not confirmed.

Because there are no terms, the usual hotel questions have no answer here. Completed stays, prepaid or pay-at-hotel rates, award nights, taxes and resort fees: none of them earn, because nothing does. A stay booked on Hilton's site still follows Hilton's own rules for Hilton Honors points and elite credit. Starting at Rakuten adds nothing and, as far as the page shows, takes nothing away. Hilton's terms page refused the fetch on November 26, 2026, so its wording on points is not confirmed.

## The one Hilton listing that pays

Rakuten has a second page named "Hilton – Points". On November 26, 2026, it showed 1.25% cash back with no "was" label. Its terms are two sentences: cash back is only available on the purchase of points, and it is not available on hotel bookings. The posting line says cash back is added "tomorrow".

| Points purchase | At 1.25% |
|---|---|
| $100 | $1.25 |
| $400 | $5.00 |
| $1,000 | $12.50 |

These are sums on round figures, not Hilton's prices for points. The price per point is set on Hilton's side and was not read for this page. Hilton Grand Vacations has its own Rakuten page as well, and it also read "No Cash Back".

## What paid on other hotel listings the same day

The Hilton page links to other travel stores. These are the headline rates shown next to each on November 26, 2026.

| Listing | Rate shown | "Was" label |
|---|---|---|
| Marriott.com | 3% | None |
| IHG Hotels & Resorts | 12% | Was 3% |
| Hotels.com | Up to 12% | Was 1% |
| Expedia | Up to 12% | Was 3% |
| Booking.com | Up to 6% | Was 4% |
| Priceline | Up to 4% | None |

"Up to" means the top figure applies to some bookings only. Whether a Hilton hotel booked at one of the travel agencies gets the top figure is not confirmed.

Take a $600 room rate. Booked on Hilton's site from Rakuten, it earned $0 on the day checked. The same $600 at a listing paying 3% comes to $18.00, and at 12% to $72.00. That second sum only matters if the hotel is not a Hilton, or if the booking moves to a travel agency. A booking at a travel agency is a third-party booking, and hotel chains usually treat those differently for points and status. [Rakuten for hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/) lays out that trade, and the pages on [Marriott](/rakuten-marriott-cash-back-how-it-works/) and [IHG](/rakuten-ihg-cash-back-how-it-works/) give each chain's exclusions.

## Amex points instead of cash

Rakuten members with an eligible American Express card can take Membership Rewards points in place of cash; see [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/). That choice changes the form of the payout, not the rate. On a Hilton room booking, 0% in cash is 0 points. On a $400 points purchase, $5.00 becomes 500 points at 1 point per cent.

## Who should skip it

- You are booking a Hilton room and expect cash back from Rakuten. On November 26, 2026, there was none.
- You were only buying Hilton points for the cash back. At 1.25%, a $400 purchase returns $5.00.
- You want Hilton Honors points and elite credit and are thinking of a travel agency listing for the higher rate. Read the chain's rules on third-party bookings first.
- You are counting on the rate coming back by a certain date. Nothing on the page says it will.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten pay cash back at Hilton?**
Not on November 26, 2026. The Hilton page read "No Cash Back" and showed no terms.

**Does buying Hilton points earn cash back?**
Yes. The "Hilton – Points" page showed 1.25% that day, on points purchases only.

**Do Hilton award nights earn through Rakuten?**
No. No Hilton room booking earned on the day checked, paid or award.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

# Rakuten H&M cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-hm-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, on full-price items. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's H&M page showed 2% cash back, with no raised rate two days before Black Friday. The biggest exclusion is sale items, which earn nothing; shipping, gift cards and Rabanne items are excluded too.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

The page showed 2% with no "was" label, so 2% is the plain rate. No category table appears.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for H&M list these as earning nothing:

- Sale items
- Shipping
- The purchase or redemption of gift cards
- Rabanne items
- Orders on any site other than the US site
- Orders the store determines are shipping to Mexico, South Korea, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Greece, Croatia, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia or Slovakia

## The sale-item rule during a sale week

This matters most in late November. On November 25, 2026, the same Rakuten page listed two store promotions: up to 40% off sitewide, and Black Friday deals of up to 50% off. Both were shown with 2%.

The terms do not define "sale items". Two readings are possible:

- Only items in the store's sale section are excluded.
- Any item with a reduced price, including during a sitewide promotion, is excluded.

Which one the store applies is not confirmed. If the wider reading holds, little in a sitewide promotion would earn. The exclusions on the activation page on the day of purchase are the place to look.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns? |
|---|---|
| Full-price clothing or home goods on the US site | Yes, 2% that day |
| Item from the sale section | No |
| Item discounted in a sitewide promotion | Not confirmed |
| Rabanne item | No |
| Gift card, or an order paid with one | No |
| Shipping charge | No |
| Order shipping to one of the listed countries | No |

In dollars: $60 of full-price items at 2% comes to $1.20. This is a worked example.

## Coupon codes and member offers

The terms on this page have no line about coupon codes. Rakuten's general help page says using codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.

The page describes several discounts that come from the store, not from Rakuten: 25% off one item for joining the email list, a birthday coupon for members and a student discount. Whether using one of them affects the 2% is not confirmed. Whether an item bought with such a discount then counts as a sale item is also not confirmed.

## App, pickup and stores

- **App.** The page says the store has an app with occasional app-only discounts. The terms do not mention the app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension; whether an order finished in the store's app tracks is not confirmed.
- **Pickup.** Neither the page nor the terms mention store pickup. Not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The store page showed an online rate only. The store did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When it shows up

The page says cash back is added to the Rakuten account within one week. Payment follows on Rakuten's four dates a year; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If an order does not appear, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You mostly buy from the sale section. Those items earn nothing.
- You are shopping a sitewide promotion and need certainty. Whether those items earn is not confirmed.
- You are buying Rabanne items or a gift card.
- You shop on a site other than the US one.
- You have a member or student code that saves more than 2%.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at H&M?**
2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Do sale items earn cash back?**
No. Sale items are on the excluded list. The terms do not define the phrase.

**Does shipping count?**
No. Shipping is excluded, as is the purchase or redemption of gift cards.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

| Hotel bookings | 3% |
| Cars | 1% |
| Headline | Up to 3%, "was 1%" |

The "was 1%" label means the rate was raised above the store's base rate that day. Nothing on the page says how long the raised rate lasts.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Hotels.com list these limits:

- **Coupon codes.** Cash back is not available when a coupon code is used in a purchase. The terms make no exception for codes listed on Rakuten.
- **Airfare.** Flights earn nothing.
- **Bookings made through a travel agent.**
- **Gift cards.** Neither buying one nor paying with one earns.
- **Location.** Only customers located in the United States or Canada are eligible.
- **Stays that do not happen.** Cash back is credited only for completed, eligible hotel stays.

The rate list names hotel bookings and cars. Whether vacation rentals booked on the site count as hotel bookings is not confirmed.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns? |
|---|---|
| Hotel booking, stay completed, no coupon code | Yes, 3% that day |
| Car booking | Yes, 1% that day |
| Hotel booking with a coupon code | No |
| Airfare | No |
| Canceled booking or no-show | No; the stay must be completed |
| Gift card purchase or redemption | No |

As an example, a completed $400 stay at 3% comes to $12.00. Rakuten's general help page says taxes are never eligible.

## One Key, the app and pay-later bookings

- **One Key.** Rakuten's page describes One Key, the rewards program shared with Expedia and Vrbo. The terms do not mention it. Whether paying part of a stay with OneKeyCash reduces the cash back is not confirmed.
- **The page is not consistent.** One section describes One Key; the question-and-answer section still describes collecting 10 stamps for a free night.
- **App.** The page says the Hotels.com app can show mobile-only prices. The terms do not mention the app. A booking earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension; whether a booking finished in the Hotels.com app tracks is not confirmed.
- **Pay now or pay at the hotel.** The terms do not separate the two. Not confirmed.

## When it shows up

The page says cash back is added to the Rakuten account within 3 months after travel has been completed. That is longer than for shopping. A stay booked now for next summer would not be credited until after that stay. Payment then follows Rakuten's four dates a year; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). How this store compares with other booking sites is in [Rakuten for hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/) and [Rakuten at Expedia and Booking.com](/rakuten-expedia-booking-com-cash-back/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a coupon code that saves more than 3%. Using it ends the cash back.
- You are booking a flight.
- You may cancel. A canceled stay earns nothing.
- You are located outside the United States and Canada.
- You need the money soon. It can take up to 3 months after the stay to be added.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Hotels.com?**
Up to 3% on November 25, 2026: 3% on hotel bookings and 1% on cars. Rates change daily.

**Can you use a coupon code and still get cash back?**
No. The terms say cash back is not available when a coupon code is used.

**When is the cash back added?**
Within 3 months after travel is completed, according to the store page.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

- [Rakuten: Hotels.com store page](https://www.rakuten.com/shop/hotels)
- [Rakuten: Why didn't I earn cash back?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/why-didnt-i-earn-cash-back-360036367393)

# Does Rakuten give cash back on hotels and flights?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes for hotels: booking sites such as Expedia, Booking.com and Priceline paid up to 8% to 10% through Rakuten when checked on November 20, 2026. Flights earn very little, usually a flat $1 to $2 per booking, and travel cash back is confirmed only after the trip is over.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you book.

## Rates seen on November 20, 2026

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the store's usual rate.

| Store | Hotels | Flights | Other |
|---|---|---|---|
| Expedia | 10% (headline: up to 10%, was 3%) | $1.25 flat | Packages 2%, cars 1%, activities 3% |
| Booking.com | 8% (was 4%) | $1 flat | Prepaid rental cars 3% |
| Priceline | 8% (was 4%) | $2 flat | Rental cars 4%, cruises 2% |
| Hotels.com | Up to 10% (was 1%) | Not applicable | Terms not confirmed |
| Vrbo | Up to 10% (was 1%) | Not applicable | Vacation rentals |
| IHG Hotels & Resorts (the chain's own site) | 10% (was 3%) | Not applicable | Room rate only |

Several stores had raised rates that day. The "was" figures of 1% to 4% are closer to an ordinary day.

A few airlines had their own listings, at about 1% to 1.5%.

The Hilton and Marriott listings seen that day were for buying points, not booking rooms. No Hyatt listing was seen. On November 26, 2026, a separate Rakuten page for Marriott.com bookings showed 3% with its own exclusions, while Hilton's page showed no cash back; see [Rakuten at Marriott](/rakuten-marriott-cash-back-how-it-works/) and [Rakuten at Hilton](/rakuten-hilton-cash-back-how-it-works/).

Priceline's terms say taxes, insurance and resort fees earn nothing. Expect the rate to apply to the room price, not the full bill: 8% on a $1,000 room is $80, and 4% on an ordinary day is $40.

## The wait is longer than for shopping

| Stage | Shopping | Travel |
|---|---|---|
| Shows as pending | 24 to 48 hours | Sometimes not until the trip is over (Expedia: within 5 days of booking) |
| Confirmed | Typically 3 to 14 weeks | Typically 6 to 17 weeks after the trip ends (Expedia: within a week after) |

Rakuten's pages do not fully agree here. Its travel article says 6 to 17 weeks after the trip is complete. Its payment page says 45 to 120 days after booking. Booking.com, Priceline and IHG each say cash back is added within 3 months after travel.

So a room booked in November for a March stay may be paid on May 15 or August 15. The full schedule is in [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## What voids travel cash back

- Changing the booking. Rakuten's travel article says: "Any changes made to your reservation or booking will void Cash Back." That covers dates, room type and flight times.
- Canceling.
- Using a coupon code that Rakuten did not list. On Priceline, any coupon code voids it.
- Booking by phone or through a business version of the store.
- Paying with points. IHG's listing excludes stays paid with points and corporate or group rates.

If plans change, Rakuten's advice is to cancel and rebook through Rakuten.

## What you give up by not booking direct

For a chain hotel, booking through a third-party site usually means no hotel points and no credit toward elite status. The Points Guy's guide to Expedia puts it this way: in most cases you will not earn hotel points or elite credit, and the hotel does not have to honor your status, though some do. Its Marriott guide says third-party bookings are non-qualifying rates that earn no points or tier benefits.

Whether a third-party Marriott stay still counts as an elite night is not confirmed; sources disagree. Each chain's own terms are the final word.

A chain that lists its own site on Rakuten, as IHG did that day, is the middle path. Whether such a booking also earns the chain's points is not confirmed on Rakuten's page.

## Who should skip it

- You hold hotel elite status or are working toward it. The points and perks can be worth more than a few percent.
- Your plans may change. An edited booking loses the cash back.
- You mostly book flights. A dollar or two is not worth altering how you book.
- You pay with hotel points or use a corporate rate.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten pay cash back on flights?**
Yes, but little. Expedia, Booking.com and Priceline paid a flat $1 to $2 per flight booking on November 20, 2026.

**When is hotel cash back confirmed?**
Typically 6 to 17 weeks after the stay ends, then it goes out on the next payment date.

**Do you still earn hotel points?**
Usually not when you book a chain hotel through a third-party site.

# How long does a Rakuten purchase take to show up in your account?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-how-long-until-purchase-shows-up/
Facts checked: 2026-11-23
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Rakuten says a new order is typically "processing" for 24 to 48 hours and then shows as pending cash back in your account. Travel bookings can take until after the trip, and Rakuten's terms give you 90 days from the purchase to report cash back that never appeared.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## What Rakuten says, by type of purchase

| Type of purchase | When it should show in your account | Rakuten page |
|---|---|---|
| Online order | Typically 24 to 48 hours | Checking the status of your cash back |
| Online order, second wording | A few hours to several days, depending on the store | How can I tell if I'm earning cash back? |
| In a physical store with a linked card | Pending within a few days | In-store cash back FAQ |
| Restaurant with a linked card | Within 10 days of the meal, per the program terms | Card linked offers terms |
| Travel booked at Expedia | Pending within 5 days of the reservation | How cash back on travel works |
| Other travel | May not show until the trip is complete | How cash back on travel works |

Rakuten's two pages on online orders do not use the same figure. One says 24 to 48 hours. The other says the store's notice can take "from a few hours to several days." The speed depends on the store.

## Two different things can be missing

Your account keeps two records, and they appear at different times.

**The shopping trip.** This is the click from Rakuten to the store. Rakuten records it when you click and gives it a number. A trip with no purchase stays in your account for up to three months. How quickly a new trip appears in the list is not confirmed; the help pages give no time.

**The cash back.** This appears only after the store reports the order. It is the part that takes 24 to 48 hours or longer.

So a trip with no cash back yet, a day after the order, is normal. No trip at all means Rakuten has no record of the click. The causes of each are set out in [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

To look, sign in at Rakuten.com and open Cash Back Activity.

## Stores that take longer

Travel is the main case. For travel outside Expedia, Rakuten says you may not see a pending amount until after your travel is complete. Some store pages on Rakuten give their own timing.

| Store | Timing on its Rakuten page |
|---|---|
| Expedia | Within a week after travel |
| Booking.com | Within 3 months after travel |
| Priceline | Within 3 months after travel |
| IHG Hotels & Resorts | Within 3 months after travel |

These were read on November 20, 2026 and can change. More in [cash back on hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/) and [Expedia and Booking.com](/rakuten-expedia-booking-com-cash-back/).

## Showing up is not the same as being paid

Once the order shows, it is pending, not payable. Rakuten says pending cash back is typically confirmed in 3 to 14 weeks for online and in-store shopping and 6 to 17 weeks after a trip ends for travel. Confirmed cash back is then paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## When to file a missing cash back request

Rakuten's help article gives no set number of days to wait. It says to run through its list of causes and then fill out the Missing Cash Back form. A practical reading of Rakuten's own figures:

- Online order: after the 24 to 48 hours have passed with nothing showing.
- In-store purchase: after several days. Restaurant: after 10 days.
- Expedia booking: after 5 days.
- Other travel: before 90 days from the booking, even if the trip has not happened.

The last line matters because of the deadline. Rakuten's terms say you must contact Member Services within 90 days of the transaction if cash back was not credited correctly. A trip booked four months ahead can pass that mark before the pending amount would normally appear.

Rakuten's help articles state no deadline; the 90 days is in its terms. How soon the form will accept a request is not confirmed, because it sits behind sign-in. The steps are in [the missing cash back guide](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- The order was placed in the last two days. Rakuten's stated processing time has not passed.
- The item is listed under the store's exclusions, or the order was returned or canceled. A request will not change that.
- The trip has not happened and the booking is recent. Waiting is the expected course, as long as the 90 days are not close.

## Quick answers

**How long before a Rakuten order appears?**
Typically 24 to 48 hours, Rakuten says. Another of its pages says a few hours to several days.

**Why is my hotel booking not showing?**
Outside Expedia, Rakuten says travel may not show as pending until the trip is complete.

**What is the deadline to report missing cash back?**
Rakuten's terms say within 90 days of the transaction.

# How do you switch Rakuten from cash back to Amex points, and can you switch back?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-how-to-switch-to-amex-points/
Facts checked: 2026-11-23
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

You switch in Rakuten's Account Settings: change the payment method to Membership Rewards points, then sign in to your American Express Membership Rewards account to link it. Whether you can switch back to cash is not settled; Rakuten's help pages do not say, one large travel site says no, and two others report that it works.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## Before you start

You need a US American Express card enrolled in Membership Rewards. Rakuten names the Gold, Green and Platinum cards as examples. The card must be open and not past due. Corporate cards and the Rakuten American Express Card are not eligible.

On whether points suit you, see [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/) and [whether the points are worth more than the cash](/rakuten-amex-points-worth-more-than-cash/).

## The steps

Rakuten's own FAQ gives three steps. Two travel sites that walked through the screens add detail, shown in the right-hand column. The screens may have changed since they wrote.

| Step | Rakuten's FAQ | Detail reported by travel sites |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Go to Account Settings | On the website it is in the menu under your name |
| 2 | Update your payment method to Membership Rewards points | Look in the section on how you are paid. One site says to select PayPal or check first, then use the link in the American Express section |
| 3 | Enter your Membership Rewards username and password to connect the accounts | A confirmation pop-up may appear, and Rakuten may email a six-digit code |

Store pages still say "cash back". The rate is 1 point per cent, so $1 of cash back becomes 100 points.

## How to check that it worked

- After a transfer date, your Amex account lists the points as "Rakuten Additional MR Points" under points activity.
- Transfers happen on February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15, once you have at least 501 confirmed points. The next one is February 15, 2027.

## What happens to cash back you already have

Sources disagree.

- Rakuten's FAQ says confirmed cash back earned before the switch is converted to points and sent by the next transfer date. Its points terms say the same of cash back "accrued but not disbursed" before linking.
- The Points Guy says an existing cash balance stays cash and is paid by check or PayPal.

If you want an existing balance as cash, the cautious order is to wait until a payment date has passed and the cash has been sent, then switch.

## Can you switch back?

| Source | What it says | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Rakuten help pages | Nothing on leaving Amex points. A general line says you can update your payment method any time in Account Settings | Read November 23, 2026 |
| The Points Guy | The choice is irreversible | Article bylined August 2025 |
| Miles to Memories | Switching back and forth works | May 2025 |
| Doctor of Credit | Members could change payout type and change back after a payment | Updated May 2026 |

Miles to Memories quotes a warning Rakuten shows on screen when a member moves to cash: points earned before the switch are converted to cash back and sent by check on the next payment date. That suggests the route back existed when the article was written.

Rakuten does not confirm it in writing, so treat a switch back as likely possible but not guaranteed. Whatever balance is unpaid at the moment of any switch may be converted.

## Keeping the link working

- If you close or replace the linked Amex card, or change your Membership Rewards login, relink. Rakuten's path is Account Settings, then Edit below Membership Rewards points.
- The card account must stay open and in good standing until points are transferred.
- Rakuten's terms say promotions tied to other card issuers will not be available while you are set to Amex points.

## Who should skip it

- You redeem Amex points for statement credits or gift cards. That is 1 cent a point or less, so cash is equal or more.
- You may close your only Membership Rewards card soon. The link needs an open, eligible card.
- You need certainty that you can return to cash. Rakuten does not state it.

## Quick answers

**Where is the setting to switch Rakuten to Amex points?**
In Account Settings, under how you are paid. You then sign in to Membership Rewards to link.

**Can I switch Rakuten back from points to cash?**
Not confirmed. Rakuten's pages are silent; one site says no, two report that it works.

**Does my existing cash back turn into points?**
Rakuten's FAQ says confirmed cash back is converted. One travel site says it stays cash.

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Membership Rewards points FAQ](https://rakuten.com/help/article/american-express-membership-rewards-points-faq-360017609253)
- [Rakuten: Membership Rewards points terms](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/american-express-membership-rewards-points-at-rakuten-terms-360017609913)
- [Rakuten: Choosing how you get paid](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/choosing-how-you-get-paid-360002100828)
- [The Points Guy: Earn Amex points with Rakuten](https://thepointsguy.com/loyalty-programs/earn-amex-points-with-rakuten/)
- [Miles to Memories: How to switch your Rakuten rewards option](https://milestomemories.com/?p=152585)
- [Doctor of Credit: Rakuten rewards as Bilt points](https://www.doctorofcredit.com/rakuten-cashback-can-now-be-earned-as-bilt-points-temporarily-11-conversion/)

# Rakuten IHG cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-ihg-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's IHG Hotels & Resorts page showed 9% cash back, raised from a base of 3%, across 18 listed brands. Rooms paid for with points, corporate, group and friends-and-family rates earn nothing, and a change made to the reservation at the hotel voids the cash back.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

The page listed the same 9% for every brand in its rate list, each with a "was 3%" label.

| Rate | Brands listed |
|---|---|
| 9% (was 3%) | Atwell Suites, Candlewood Suites, Crowne Plaza, EVEN Hotels, Garner Hotels, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Hotel Indigo, Iberostar Beachfront Resorts, InterContinental, Kimpton, Regent, Ruby, Six Senses, Staybridge Suites, Vignette, avid hotels, voco |

The "About" text on the page also names HUALUXE, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Holiday Inn Resort and Holiday Inn – the niu. They are not in the rate list. Whether they earn is not confirmed.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for IHG list these as earning nothing:

- Bookings with IHG Army Hotels in the US and Canada
- Six Senses and Kimpton hotels that are not on the page's named lists (see below)
- Specialty negotiated rates, including friends and family, corporate and group rates
- Rooms booked and paid for with points
- The purchase of points
- The Ambassador certificate program, including Ambassador reward nights and the Royal Ambassador rate
- Bookings by travel agents who have their own partnership with the hotel group

Two things void cash back after booking: changes made to the reservation at the hotel, and coupon codes not listed on Rakuten. The wording for both is "will void".

## Six Senses and Kimpton: only named hotels

For these two brands the terms give a list, and only hotels on it earn.

| Brand | Hotels that earn |
|---|---|
| Six Senses | Seven: Crans Montana, Douro Valley, Kyoto, La Sagesse, London, Rome, Zil Pasyon |
| Kimpton | A named list of about 65 properties, from Al Rowda Doha to Vividora Hotel |

A Kimpton or Six Senses hotel that is not named earns nothing, even though both brands show 9% in the rate list. The list is long, so the store page is the place to look up a given hotel.

## What the 9% is paid on

The terms say rewards are based on the room rate alone. No other costs or charges tied to the stay count. Iberostar Beachfront Resorts is the exception: there the base is the all-inclusive rate, meaning the room with its meal plan.

As an example, a $600 room rate at 9% comes to $54.00. At the 3% base it would be $18.00. Rakuten's general help page says taxes are never eligible.

## Points, app and timing

- **Earning hotel points.** The page describes IHG One Rewards. The terms cover stays paid with points, not points earned. Whether a stay booked through Rakuten still earns hotel points is not confirmed.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the hotel group's app. A booking earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.
- **Timing.** The page says cash back is added within 3 months after travel has been completed. Payment then follows Rakuten's four dates a year; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/). Other booking options are compared in [Rakuten for hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/).

## Who should skip it

- You are paying with points or using an Ambassador certificate.
- You book a corporate, group or friends-and-family rate.
- You expect to change dates or room type at the front desk. That voids the cash back.
- Your Kimpton or Six Senses hotel is not on the named list.
- You have a code from outside Rakuten that saves more than the cash back.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at IHG?**
9% on November 25, 2026, with a "was 3%" label. Rates change daily.

**Do award nights earn cash back?**
No. Rooms booked and paid for with points are not eligible.

**Does every Kimpton earn?**
No. Only the Kimpton properties named in Rakuten's terms earn.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

# Can you use Rakuten in store? Yes, with a linked card: how in-store cash back works

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, you can use Rakuten in store; it is not only for online shopping. You link a payment card to your Rakuten account, add a store's in-store offer before you shop, and pay at the register with that card. Rakuten says you can link most Visa and Mastercard credit and debit cards and most American Express cards.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the offer in the Rakuten app on the day you shop. New to Rakuten? [How Rakuten works, step by step](/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/) covers the online side.

## The steps

1. In your Rakuten account, link an eligible card.
2. On the Rakuten site or in the app, open the In-Store tab and add the offer for the store you plan to visit.
3. Pay in the physical store with the linked card.
4. Keep the receipt until the cash back is confirmed.

Rakuten's FAQ says the purchase is tracked automatically: "you don't need to upload receipts." There is nothing to show or scan at the register. A newly linked card can take about 24 hours to start reporting, according to the program terms.

## Which cards you can link

| Card | Can it be linked? |
|---|---|
| Most Visa credit and debit cards | Yes |
| Most Mastercard credit and debit cards | Yes |
| Most American Express cards | Yes |
| Discover, Diners Club, Wells Fargo Mastercards | No |
| American Express debit cards, Macy's American Express | No |
| Apple Card and other virtual cards with a new number each time | No |
| Corporate, purchasing, HSA, FSA and prepaid government or insurance cards | No |

The linking steps, screen by screen, are on [how to link a card for in-store cash back](/rakuten-link-card-for-in-store-cash-back/).

You can link more than one card. Rakuten's in-store page mentions credit cards only, while its help FAQ adds Visa and Mastercard debit cards.

**Debit cards.** Run the card as credit and sign if asked. Rakuten says debit purchases made with a PIN may not qualify.

**Phone wallets.** Rakuten's pages do not agree. The FAQ recommends the physical card and says Apple Pay, Google Wallet and Samsung Pay may not always track. The program terms say Apple Pay and Samsung Wallet are eligible. Which one holds at a given store is not confirmed; the physical card avoids the question.

## Rules for offers

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| When to add the offer | Before you pay. An offer added after the purchase does not count. |
| How long it lasts | Most expire 75 days after you add them, or once used. Some are shorter: Macy's offer said 45 days. |
| Using it again | Add the offer again after each purchase |
| Where it works | Physical stores only, at a store register. Online and phone orders do not qualify. |
| Exclusions | Some stores do not pay on gift cards or on departments such as pharmacy or automotive |

## Rates seen on November 26, 2026

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the usual rate. These were on Rakuten's in-store page, read while signed out on the day before Black Friday.

| Store | In-store rate seen November 26 | Seen November 25 |
|---|---|---|
| kate spade new york | 15% (was 2%) | 6% |
| kate spade outlet | 15% (was 2%) | Not read |
| Total Wireless | 12% (was 7.5%) | 22.5% |
| The Paper Store | 12% (was 4%) | 12% |
| Carhartt | 12% (was 3%) | 9% |
| ASICS | 12% (was 3%) | 9% |
| Tommy Hilfiger | 12% (was 2.5%) | 5% |
| Pandora Jewelry, Sally Beauty, Bluemercury, L'AGENCE | 12% (was 2%) | Not read |
| Macy's | $10 on $100 or more | Not seen |
| Famous Footwear | 2% | 2% |
| At Home | 1% | 1% |

Thirteen stores showed a raised in-store rate. Macy's was listed as new to in-store cash back: its offer terms give $10 on a minimum spend of $100, through December 13, 2026, and are separate from the 12% [Macy's](/rakuten-macys-cash-back-how-it-works/) showed online. Ordinary in-store rates in the part of the list that loaded ran from 1% to 4.5%, and most were 2%. Whether Mattress Firm and CVS, seen on November 20, still have offers is not confirmed; neither was in the part that loaded. [Kohl's](/rakuten-kohls-cash-back-how-it-works/) and [Ulta](/rakuten-ulta-cash-back-how-it-works/) were not seen in it either. For online rates this week, see [Rakuten on Black Friday 2026](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/).

Restaurants are a separate linked-card program. Rakuten's home page says 5% at more than 22,000 participating restaurants, once a card is linked.

## When the cash back shows up

Rakuten's FAQ says pending cash back appears within a few days and is typically confirmed 3 to 14 weeks after the purchase. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

If nothing shows, the FAQ gives three usual causes: the offer was not added before the purchase, the card was not linked, or a debit card was not run as credit. See [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

The card's own rewards are separate. Rakuten's home page says cash back comes on top of credit card rewards; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## What you agree to when you link a card

The program terms say that by enrolling a card, you agree the card network or processor may monitor transactions on that card at participating stores. Merchant name, location, date and amount are shared so the purchase can be matched. You can remove a card at any time in account settings. Rakuten keeps the past transaction data.

## Who should skip it

- You do not want a card network reporting your purchases at participating stores to Rakuten.
- Your main card is on the "No" list: Discover, Apple Card, a Wells Fargo Mastercard, or a store card with no Visa, Mastercard or Amex logo.
- You pay by phone tap or debit PIN and do not want to change.
- You will not add the offer before each visit. Without that step nothing is earned.

## Quick answers

**Can you use Rakuten in store?**
Yes. Link an eligible card, add the store's in-store offer, then pay in the physical store with that card.

**Which credit card can you link for in-store Rakuten?**
Most Visa, Mastercard and American Express cards. Discover, Apple Card and Wells Fargo Mastercards cannot be linked.

**Do you need to scan a receipt?**
No. Tracking is automatic. Keep the receipt in case of a problem.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two. [How the sign-up and referral bonuses work](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/) sets out both offers as read on November 26, 2026.

# Rakuten Instacart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-instacart-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, but not in the Instacart app. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Instacart page showed 1% cash back, with no raised rate. The biggest exclusion is how the order is placed: purchases made directly through the Instacart mobile app earn nothing, and alcohol, gift cards, taxes, delivery fees and tips are excluded too.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

The page showed 1% with no "was" label, so 1% is the plain rate. No category table appears. Nothing in the terms limits the offer to new customers.

## Where the order must be placed

This is the rule most likely to cost a shopper the cash back. The terms say cash back is only available on orders placed:

- on Instacart.com, or
- through the Rakuten app, when it sends the shopper to Instacart's mobile web site.

Two kinds of order are named as not eligible:

- Purchases made directly through the Instacart mobile app.
- Orders placed through stores that are powered by Instacart. That means a grocer's own site or app that runs on Instacart.

The same Rakuten page describes the Instacart service as built for its mobile app. Under the cash back terms, an order placed there earns nothing.

## What earns and what does not

| Part of the order | Earns? |
|---|---|
| Groceries ordered on Instacart.com after a Rakuten click | Yes, 1% that day |
| The same order placed in the Instacart mobile app | No |
| Order on a grocer's own site powered by Instacart | No |
| Alcohol | No |
| Gift cards | No |
| Taxes, delivery fees and tips | No |
| Rewards or points earned from a retailer | No |
| Instacart+ monthly or annual membership | No |

The terms name delivery fees. They do not name service fees. Whether the service fee counts toward the 1% is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

| Grocery subtotal | At 1% |
|---|---|
| $50 | $0.50 |
| $100 | $1.00 |
| $200 | $2.00 |

These are worked examples, with any alcohol left out of the subtotal.

## Coupon codes, pickup and EBT

- **Coupon codes.** The terms say codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back, and to keep to codes Rakuten provides. The page describes first-order promotions such as $0 delivery fees on the first three orders; those were listed on Rakuten on November 25, 2026.
- **Pickup.** The page mentions pickup orders in its description of Instacart+. The cash back terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **EBT SNAP.** The page says participating stores may accept it. Whether the part of an order paid with EBT SNAP earns is not confirmed.
- **In stores.** There is no in-store offer; this is an online service.

## A 90-day limit on claims

The terms say missing cash back inquiries must be made within 90 days of the order, and that cash back can only be researched for up to 90 days from the order date. See [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "tomorrow". Payment follows on Rakuten's four dates a year, and a balance under $5 carries over to the next date; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Card rewards on groceries are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You order in the Instacart mobile app and do not want to switch to the website.
- You order through a grocer's own site or app that is powered by Instacart.
- Most of the order is alcohol.
- You are buying an Instacart+ membership or a gift card.
- You have a code from outside Rakuten that saves more than 1% of the order.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Instacart?**
1% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Does an order in the Instacart app earn cash back?**
No. Purchases made directly through the Instacart mobile app are excluded.

**Do delivery fees and tips count?**
No. Taxes, delivery fees and tips are on the excluded list.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Instacart store page](https://www.rakuten.com/shop/instacart)
- [Rakuten: Why didn't I earn cash back?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/why-didnt-i-earn-cash-back-360036367393)
- [Rakuten: When will I get paid?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/when-will-i-get-paid-360002117667)
