# Rakuten J.Crew cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-j-crew-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at J.Crew. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's J.Crew page showed 2% cash back, with no raised rate two days before Black Friday. Gift cards, gift wrapping, monogramming and "critters" earn nothing, and an order that uses a 6-digit numeric coupon code earns nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 25, 2026 | 2% | None |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's base rate. The J.Crew page has none, so 2% is the plain rate. No category table appears; every product and offer shown carried the same 2%.

The store's own sale was running at the same time. Rakuten's page listed 40% off for Black Friday, ending the next day, next to the unchanged 2%.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| Clothing, shoes and accessories bought online | Yes, 2% on the day checked |
| Sale items | Not listed as excluded |
| Gift cards | No |
| Gift wrapping services | No |
| Monogramming | No |
| "Critters" | No |
| Any order using a 6-digit numeric coupon code | No |

The terms do not define "critters". The word appears to refer to a J.Crew product feature, but which items or services it covers is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes: an unusual rule

Most Rakuten store pages carry a line about codes not listed on Rakuten. The J.Crew terms do not. They name one kind of code instead: cash back is not available with the use of 6-digit numeric coupon codes. The page does not say who issues such codes. Not confirmed.

Three related points from the same page:

- Rakuten's page says J.Crew allows one coupon at a time, though a coupon may combine with a sale depending on its terms.
- The page lists a 15% student and teacher discount, and separately describes a 15% discount for first responders and health-care workers after status is verified. Whether those arrive as 6-digit numeric codes is not confirmed.
- Rakuten's general help page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back at any store, because they can override tracking.

## J.Crew Passport and the store card

Rakuten's page describes J.Crew Passport, the free loyalty program, with points that can be redeemed for discounts, and the J.Crew Credit Card. The cash back terms mention neither. Whether the part of an order paid with Passport rewards earns is not confirmed. Rewards from a credit card are separate from Rakuten; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Pickup, app and stores

- **Pickup.** Not mentioned in the terms. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The terms do not mention a J.Crew app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.
- **In stores.** The J.Crew page showed an online rate only. J.Crew did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).
- **Shipping.** The page says J.Crew charges $5 flat-rate shipping and ships free on orders of $150 or more. That is the store's rule. Whether shipping and taxes count toward cash back is not stated in the J.Crew terms.

## What it comes to

Prices are those shown on Rakuten's J.Crew page on November 25, 2026.

| Purchase | Price | At 2% |
|---|---|---|
| Boyfriend jersey long-sleeve T-shirt | $29.70 | $0.59 |
| Fair Isle crewneck cardigan | $88.80 | $1.78 |
| Berkeley large shoulder bag in suede | $118.80 | $2.38 |
| Gift card, or monogramming on an item | Any | $0 |

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "today". Rakuten's help page says online cash back typically takes 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, and that a full or partial return can void it. Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If a purchase never appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You hold a 6-digit numeric code. Using it means no cash back on the order.
- You are buying a gift card.
- You are paying mainly for monogramming or gift wrap.
- You expect a raised rate for the holiday weekend. None was shown, and none is promised.
- You buy in a J.Crew store. No in-store offer was seen.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at J.Crew?**
2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Do sale items earn cash back at J.Crew?**
Sale items are not on the excluded list. Items in the 40% off sale were shown with the 2% rate.

**Which coupon codes cancel J.Crew cash back?**
The terms name 6-digit numeric coupon codes. An order using one earns nothing.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

No, not as of November 26, 2026. Rakuten still has a JCPenney page, but it is labeled "Coupons Only" and states that JCPenney does not offer cash back on Rakuten. A JCPenney order started from Rakuten earns $0; what does work is cash back at other department stores and the rewards on the card you pay with.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rakuten's listings change, so check the store page on the day you buy. For this morning's rates at stores that do pay, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## What the page shows

Because there is no cash back, there is also no exclusion list. Nothing on the page says which JCPenney products would or would not earn, since none do.

## Where the page disagrees with itself

The header says JCPenney does not offer cash back. The description further down the same page still talks about cash back through Rakuten and says members have earned more than $11 million in cash back at JCPenney to date. That figure points to a time when the store did pay. When it stopped, and whether it will pay again, is not confirmed. The header is the part Rakuten uses to tell you what a purchase earns today.

# Rakuten Kohl's cash back: does Rakuten work at Kohl's and with Kohl's Cash?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-kohls-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-27
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Kohl's: 2% on Black Friday, November 27, 2026, the same rate as on every check since November 24. Gift cards, Apple and Google products and the part of an order you pay for with Kohl's Cash earn no Rakuten cash back, and whether a Rakuten-tracked order still earns new Kohl's Cash is not confirmed by either company.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check Kohl's page on Rakuten on the day you shop. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

| Date read | Rate on Rakuten's Kohl's page |
|---|---|
| November 24, 2026 | 2% |
| November 25, 2026 | 2% |
| November 26, 2026 | 2% |
| November 27, 2026 (Black Friday) | 2% |

On Black Friday Kohl's showed a single rate of 2%, with no category rates and no "was" label, so the rate was not raised for the day. Rakuten raises some store rates during sales, and its Black Friday page names Kohl's in its list of stores; see [Black Friday on Rakuten](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/). Whether the rate changes for Cyber Monday, November 30, is not confirmed; see [Cyber Monday on Rakuten](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/). Another department store, [Macy's](/rakuten-macys-cash-back-how-it-works/), was at 15% in this site's Black Friday reading.

The listing says cash back is added to the Rakuten account the next day. No in-store offer for Kohl's was shown, so this is about online orders.

## Kohl's Cash: the two halves

"Stacking" can mean two different things here.

**Spending Kohl's Cash.** Rakuten's exclusions for Kohl's include: "Part of your order paid for with Kohl's Cash." So the two do work on the same order, but Rakuten pays only on what is left.

| $100 order | Paid with Kohl's Cash | Earns Rakuten at 2% on | Cash back |
|---|---|---|---|
| No Kohl's Cash used | $0 | $100 | $2.00 |
| $10 Kohl's Cash used | $10 | $90 | $1.80 |
| $30 Kohl's Cash used | $30 | $70 | $1.40 |

**Earning Kohl's Cash.** Rakuten's page for Kohl's says shoppers receive $10 in Kohl's Cash for every $50 spent, online or in store, during promotional periods, and that it is spent like store credit on set redemption dates. Kohl's own FAQ could not be opened on November 25, 2026, and was not re-read on November 27. Kohl's Cash is issued by Kohl's at checkout, so nothing in Rakuten's terms stops it. A third-party guide says an order tracked by Rakuten still earns it. No Kohl's or Rakuten page read for this article states that, so treat it as likely but not confirmed.

## Coupons and Kohl's Rewards

Rakuten's page for Kohl's says up to four promo codes can be used on one online order, describes using them together with cash back, and says to activate before checking out. Its exclusion list for Kohl's does not mention coupons. On November 27 the page itself listed Kohl's codes, including a Black Friday code for an extra 20% off; a code shown on Rakuten is the safe kind.

Rakuten's general terms are more careful: a coupon not provided by Rakuten can cause a purchase to be credited elsewhere. If a code came from another coupon site or extension, that is the risk. The general rules are in [stacking with coupons and card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

Whether redeeming Kohl's Rewards lowers the amount Rakuten pays on is not stated on the page.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Kohl's, unchanged on November 27, 2026, exclude:

- Gift cards
- Amazon products
- Beats, JLab and Apple products (what earns at Apple's own store is in [Rakuten at Apple](/rakuten-apple-cash-back-how-it-works/))
- Google products
- Video game systems and gaming products
- Crocs
- BISSELL
- Jewelry with an original price of $2,000 or more
- Kohl's Cares merchandise
- The part of an order paid with Kohl's Cash
- Purchases made with Masterpass, Visa Checkout or Apple Pay

The last line is easy to miss. Paying with Apple Pay at checkout puts the order on the excluded list, so enter the card number the usual way. If an eligible order still shows nothing, see [what to do about missing cash back](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

Sephora at Kohl's is not on the exclusion list, and a Sephora sale at Kohl's was listed on the page at 2% on November 27. Whether a Sephora purchase earns Kohl's Cash is a separate Kohl's rule and is not confirmed. Sephora's own site is a different listing; see [Rakuten at Sephora](/rakuten-sephora-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Kohl's gift cards

Buying a gift card at Kohl's earns nothing. Rakuten separately listed Kohl's gift cards sold by Giftcards.com at 3% (labeled "was 1%") and by CardCash at 1% on November 25; that page was not re-read on November 27. Whether paying with one affects the Kohl's cash back is not stated in Kohl's terms on Rakuten. More in [gift cards and Rakuten](/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/).

## Who should skip it

- You pay most of the order with Kohl's Cash. Little is left to earn on.
- You check out with Apple Pay and do not want to switch.
- Your cart is mostly excluded brands, such as Apple, Google, Crocs or game consoles.
- You are using a coupon code from another rewards site or extension.
- You shop in the store. No in-store Kohl's offer was listed.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten work at Kohl's?**
Yes. Kohl's showed 2% on Black Friday, November 27, 2026, the same as earlier in the week. Rates change daily.

**Can you use Kohl's Cash and still get Rakuten cash back?**
Yes, on the part not paid with Kohl's Cash. The Kohl's Cash portion is excluded.

**Does Sephora at Kohl's earn Rakuten cash back?**
It was not on the exclusion list, and a Sephora sale at Kohl's was listed at 2% on November 27, 2026.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two; [how the sign-up and referral bonuses work](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/) sets out both offers.

# Does Rakuten give cash back on a laptop from Dell, HP or Lenovo?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-laptop-cash-back-dell-hp-lenovo/
Facts checked: 2026-11-21
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, all three are listed. On November 21, 2026 Rakuten showed 2% at Dell, 2% at Lenovo and 1% on HP home laptops (3% on other HP items). Outlet stores, business stores, warranties and orders using an outside coupon code are mostly excluded.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check each store's page on Rakuten on the day you buy.

## Rates seen on November 21, 2026

| Store | Laptop rate | On a $1,000 laptop | Added to account |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dell (listed as Dell Technologies) | 2% | $20 | Same day |
| HP | 1% on home desktops and laptops | $10 | Not read |
| Lenovo | 2% | $20 | Not read |

HP's headline rate is up to 3%. The 3% applies to other non-excluded items, such as monitors and accessories. A home laptop is in the 1% line. Whether an HP business laptop falls under the 3% line is not confirmed; the page names only home desktops and laptops at 1%.

None of the three showed a "was" label, so these looked like ordinary rates. Electronics stores often get raised rates in sale weeks; see [Black Friday on Rakuten](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/).

## What each store excludes

| | Dell | HP | Lenovo |
|---|---|---|---|
| Outlet or refurbished | Dell Outlet and Dell Refurbished excluded | Not mentioned | Lenovo Outlet excluded |
| Warranties | Excluded | Not mentioned | Warranties and protection plans excluded |
| Store rewards | Orders using Dell Rewards excluded | Portion paid with rewards excluded | Portion paid with Lenovo Rewards excluded |
| Business and member stores | US consumer site only | Bulk or reseller orders excluded | Lenovo Pro, employee, education, government stores excluded |
| Outside coupon codes | Voids cash back | Not mentioned | May void cash back |
| Other | Preorders, gift cards | Ink, toner, gift cards | Legion Go, parts, non-US sites |

A few of these deserve a closer look.

**Dell Outlet.** It has its own Rakuten listing, which showed no cash back on November 21, 2026. A search summary of that listing showed 2% at some earlier point, so it changes. A separate Dell Refurbished listing at 2.5% was seen only in a search summary and is not confirmed.

**Dell Rewards.** Dell's wording excludes orders that use Dell Rewards, which reads as the whole order, not only the part paid with rewards.

**HP returns.** HP's terms say: "Partial cancellations/partial returns will void Cash Back for the entire order." Returning a $30 mouse from a laptop order can cost the laptop's cash back too.

**HP free gift cards.** If an order comes with a free gift card, the eligible amount drops by the card's value.

**HP phone and chat orders.** Orders completed by an HP call center or chat agent are voided unless tracked on the web.

**Lenovo order limits.** Cash back is limited to one order per shopping trip and three orders a month. Five or more of one unit counts as resale.

## Shorter deadlines for missing cash back

Rakuten's general terms allow 90 days to report missing cash back. Two of these stores set shorter windows:

| Store | Report missing cash back within |
|---|---|
| HP | 60 days of the order |
| Lenovo | 45 days of the order date |
| Dell | Not stated on the listing |

Check that the order shows as pending within a few days. The steps are in [what to do about missing cash back](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Comparing the whole price

Cash back of 1% to 2% is small next to the price gaps between stores. A worked comparison for the same class of laptop:

| Option | Price | Cash back | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| Store A at $1,000, 2% | $1,000 | $20 | $980 |
| Store B at $950 with an outside coupon, cash back voided | $950 | $0 | $950 |

A coupon or outlet price that beats the regular price by more than 2% is the larger saving, even with no cash back. The card you pay with adds its own rewards either way; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You are buying from an outlet or refurbished store. Dell Outlet and Lenovo Outlet did not earn on the day checked.
- You buy through an education, employee or business store. Those prices are usually excluded.
- You have a coupon code from elsewhere that saves more than 1% to 2%.
- You plan to order by phone or chat with a sales agent.
- You may return part of an HP order.

## Quick answers

**Which of the three paid the most on a laptop?**
Dell and Lenovo showed 2% and HP showed 1% on home laptops on November 21, 2026. Rates change daily.

**Does Dell Outlet earn Rakuten cash back?**
Not on November 21, 2026. Its listing showed no cash back that day.

**Do warranties earn cash back?**
Not at Dell or Lenovo. Both exclude warranties; HP's terms do not mention them.

- [Rakuten: Lenovo store page](https://www.rakuten.com/lenovo.com)

# Rakuten Levi's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-levis-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Levi's. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Levi's page showed 10% cash back, marked "was 2%". Gift cards, collaboration collections with other brands, bulk or reseller orders and the part of an order paid with rewards earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

| Item | What Rakuten's page showed |
|---|---|
| Rate | 10% |
| "Was" label | 2% |
| Category rates | None listed |
| Posting line | Added to the Rakuten account within one week |

A "was" label means the rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. Here the usual rate is 2%. The page does not say when 10% ends. Nothing on the page promises the rate for Black Friday or Cyber Monday.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Levi's list these as earning nothing:

| Earns nothing | Note |
|---|---|
| Gift cards | Both buying them and paying with them |
| The part paid with rewards | The terms do not name the rewards |
| Collaboration collections | Products made with other brands |
| Bulk and reseller orders | No quantity is given |

The terms do not list which collaborations are covered, and they do not say how many items make an order "bulk". Both are not confirmed.

The gift card line is wider than at many stores. It covers the redemption of gift cards as well as the purchase, so the part of an order paid with a Levi's gift card earns nothing.

## Coupon codes and the welcome offer

The terms say that using coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back, and to keep to codes Rakuten provides.

Rakuten's page describes several store discounts that come as codes from outside Rakuten:

- A welcome offer for new email subscribers, described as 20% off with free shipping
- 15% off for teachers, military members, first responders and students, verified through SheerID
- Member codes from Red Tab, the store's free loyalty program

Under the terms, each of these carries the risk of voiding cash back. Whether any of them is treated as safe is not confirmed.

## Red Tab

The page describes Red Tab as free to join. The cash back terms exclude the part of an order paid with rewards. They do not name Red Tab. Whether Red Tab rewards are the ones meant is not confirmed, though no other rewards program is described on the page.

## SecondHand, pickup and stores

- **Levi's SecondHand.** The page describes the resale section of the store's website. The cash back terms do not mention it. Not confirmed.
- **Pickup.** The page says some stores offer in-store pickup for online orders. The terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The page showed an online rate only. No in-store offer was shown on it. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).
- **Returns.** Rakuten's general help page says returned or canceled orders do not earn cash back.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price shown | At 10% | At the 2% "was" rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Classic Graphic T-Shirt | $12.98 | $1.30 | $0.26 |
| Cinch Baggy Women's Jeans | $50.97 | $5.10 | $1.02 |
| 501 '90s Women's Jeans | $66.00 | $6.60 | $1.32 |
| Gift card or collaboration item | Any | $0 | $0 |

Taxes and shipping do not count. The page says shipping is free on orders of $100 or more. Card rewards are separate; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added within one week. Payment follows every three months; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If nothing appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a store code that is not on Rakuten and is worth more than the cash back.
- You are paying with a gift card or with rewards.
- You are buying from a collaboration collection.
- You are placing a bulk order.
- You are counting on 10% later. The usual rate shown is 2%.

## Quick answers

10% on November 25, 2026, shown as raised from 2%. Rates change daily.

**Can you use the Levi's welcome code and still get cash back?**
Not safely. The terms say codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.

**Does paying with a Levi's gift card earn cash back?**

# How do you link a credit card to Rakuten for in-store cash back, and which cards work?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-link-card-for-in-store-cash-back/
Facts checked: 2026-11-23
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

In your Rakuten account, open Linked Cards, select Link a Card and enter the card details. Rakuten says most Visa and Mastercard credit and debit cards and most American Express cards can be linked; Discover, Apple Card and Wells Fargo Mastercards cannot.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## How to link a card

1. Sign in and go to Linked Cards in your account.
2. Select Link a Card.
3. Enter the card details.

To remove a card later, open Linked Cards, select Edit next to the card, then Remove.

Rakuten's terms say there can be a lag of about 24 hours before a newly enrolled card's purchases are reported. For the whole program, see [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Which cards can be linked

| Card | Can it be linked? |
|---|---|
| Most Visa credit and debit cards | Yes |
| Most Mastercard credit and debit cards | Yes |
| Most American Express cards | Yes |
| Discover and Diners Club | No |
| Wells Fargo Mastercards | No |
| American Express debit cards, Macy's American Express | No |
| Apple Card and other virtual cards with a different number each time | No |
| Corporate and purchasing cards | No |
| HSA and FSA cards | No |
| Government prepaid cards (including EBT), insurance prepaid cards, Visa Buxx | No |

Rakuten's in-store page names credit cards only. Its two help articles add Visa and Mastercard debit cards.

## How many cards

Rakuten's help article says "you can link more than one card to your account." It gives no maximum for in-store offers, so a limit is not confirmed. The program terms set one only for dining: up to 12 cards in the restaurant program, and a card may be enrolled in only one dining program at a time.

Whether one card can be linked to two Rakuten accounts is not confirmed.

## Add the offer before you pay

A linked card does not earn at a store until that store's offer is added.

| Rule | In-store offers | Dining offers |
|---|---|---|
| Added how | By you, on the site or in the app's In-Store tab | Automatically, once a card is linked |
| When | Before the purchase | No step needed |
| Expires | Most after 75 days, or once used | Never, per Rakuten |
| After a purchase | Add the offer again | Nothing to do |

## Paying with a phone wallet

Rakuten's pages do not agree.

| Rakuten page | What it says about wallets |
|---|---|
| In-store FAQ | Recommends the physical card. Apple Pay, Google Wallet and Samsung Pay may not always track. |
| Program terms | Payments through third-party wallets or payment apps other than Apple Pay and Samsung Wallet may not be eligible. |

Paying with the physical linked card avoids the question.

## Debit cards and PINs

A linked debit card has to be run as credit, with a signature if the terminal asks. The help article says debit purchases processed with a PIN may not qualify. The terms are firmer: do not use a PIN if you want the purchase to count.

## What Rakuten says about card data

From the help article on card linking:

- Card details are stored in a secure, encrypted environment.
- Rakuten does not sell card information.
- Rakuten will not charge the card and will not ask for the CVV.

Its in-store page adds that the storage environment is certified as compliant with the Payment Card Industry (PCI) standard.

The program terms describe what is shared. By enrolling a card you agree that the card network or processor may monitor that card's transactions at participating stores and send Rakuten the merchant name, location, date and amount. Rakuten may pass transaction data to offer networks, vendors and participating stores. After a card is removed, Rakuten keeps the past data.

## If the purchase does not show

In-store cash back usually shows as pending within a few days. Rakuten's listed causes of a miss are an offer not added first, a card not linked, and a debit card not run as credit. Next steps are in [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- Your everyday card is Discover, Apple Card, a Wells Fargo Mastercard or a store card without a network logo.
- You do not want a card network reporting your purchases at participating stores to Rakuten.
- You pay by phone tap or debit PIN and prefer not to change.
- You will not add the offer before each visit. Without it, the linked card earns nothing at that store.

## Quick answers

**Which cards can you link to Rakuten?**
Most Visa and Mastercard credit and debit cards and most American Express cards. Not Discover or Apple Card.

**How many cards can you link?**
More than one. Rakuten gives no maximum for in-store offers; its terms cap dining at 12 cards.

**Does Apple Pay work with a linked card?**
Rakuten's terms say Apple Pay is eligible. Its FAQ says phone wallets may not always track.

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Linking a card for in-store and dining cash back](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/linking-a-card-for-instore-and-dining-cash-back-360002100528)
- [Rakuten: What are linked cards?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/what-are-linked-cards-360002118187)
- [Rakuten: In-store cash back FAQ](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/in-store-cash-back-faq-15935028227987)
- [Rakuten: Card linked offers terms](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/in-store-cash-back-terms-conditions-115013738007)
- [Rakuten: In-store offers](https://www.rakuten.com/in-store)

Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 21, 2026, Rakuten's Lowe's page showed up to 2% cash back, raised from a usual 1%. Appliances earn 1%, and lumber, decking, installation orders and gift cards earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

|---|---|

# Rakuten Lululemon cash back: does it work, and what works instead?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-lululemon-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-24
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Not today. On November 24, 2026, Rakuten's lululemon page read "No Cash Back", so a purchase at lululemon.com started from Rakuten earned nothing. The same day, Rakuten showed 3% on lululemon eGift cards sold by Giftcards.com.

This page is information, not financial advice. Store pages change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## What the page showed on November 24, 2026

| Rakuten page | What it showed |
|---|---|
| lululemon store page | "No Cash Back" |
| lululemon Cyber Monday page | "No Cash Back" in the page title |
| lululemon gift cards page | 3% on eGift cards sold by Giftcards.com (was 1%) |

Two Rakuten addresses for the store led to the same page. It had no "Shop Now" button, no "was" rate and no Terms & Exclusions section. Coupons, reviews and shopping tips were still listed, so the store has a page on Rakuten but no cash back offer.

## It has paid before

The Points Guy listed lululemon at 15% on Rakuten on Black Friday 2025 (November 28, 2025). So the store has had a rate in the past. Whether a rate returns for Black Friday (November 27, 2026) or Cyber Monday (November 30, 2026) is not confirmed, and nothing on Rakuten's page promises one. Why the offer is off is not confirmed either.

## What works instead

**A lululemon eGift card bought through Rakuten.** Rakuten's own lululemon gift cards page listed eGift cards of $50, $100 and $250 sold by Giftcards.com, at 3% cash back against a usual 1%. The purchase is made at Giftcards.com, not at lululemon, and Rakuten's terms for Giftcards.com apply:

- Purchases over $2,000 earn nothing.
- The part of an order paid with rewards earns nothing.
- Coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.
- Cash back is added to the Rakuten account the next day, as pending.

| eGift card | At 3% | At the usual 1% |
|---|---|---|
| $50 | $1.50 | $0.50 |
| $100 | $3.00 | $1.00 |
| $250 | $7.50 | $2.50 |

A gift card is prepaid money. Check lululemon's own gift card terms before buying one for an order you might return. How a return is refunded on a gift card order is not confirmed here. More on this route is on [Rakuten and gift cards](/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/).

**The Platinum Card credit.** The Platinum Card from American Express has a lululemon credit of up to $75 each calendar quarter after enrollment, at US lululemon stores and lululemon.com. It needs no shopping portal. Gift cards and outlet stores are excluded from it, so it does not combine with the gift card route on the same dollars. Details are on [how the lululemon credit works](/amex-platinum-lululemon-credit-how-it-works/).

**Card rewards.** The points or cash back from the card you pay with do not depend on Rakuten. See [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

**The store's own programs.** Rakuten's page describes a free lululemon membership with early access to product drops, and a sale section called We Made Too Much. Those are the store's, not Rakuten's, and can change.

Rates at other cash back sites were not confirmed for this page.

## The sums on a $128 order

| Route | Back on November 24, 2026 |
|---|---|
| lululemon.com through Rakuten | $0 |
| $100 eGift card through Rakuten at 3%, plus $28 on a card | $3.00 |
| Platinum Card with the quarter's credit unused | Up to $75 |

Taxes and shipping are left out. The gift card row assumes the card is used in full.

## If the extension shows nothing

Rakuten's help page says that when the extension shows no Activate Cash Back button, the store may not be available for it. With "No Cash Back" on the store page there is no rate to activate, and no rate to claim afterward. For orders at stores that do have a rate, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## In stores

Lululemon did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 24, 2026. The list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- You are buying at lululemon.com today and expect Rakuten cash back. There is none.
- You may return the order. A gift card ties the money to the store.
- You hold the Platinum Card and have this quarter's credit unused. That is worth more than 3%.
- You are waiting on a rate to return. Nothing confirms that it will.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten give cash back at lululemon?**
Not on November 24, 2026. The store page read "No Cash Back". Check the page on the day you buy.

**Has Rakuten ever paid cash back at lululemon?**
Yes. The Points Guy listed 15% on Black Friday 2025. No rate is promised for 2026.

**Can you earn cash back on a lululemon gift card?**
Rakuten showed 3% on lululemon eGift cards sold by Giftcards.com on November 24, 2026, against a usual 1%.

# Rakuten Macy's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Macy's: 12% on November 26, 2026, the day before Black Friday, raised from a usual 2%. Furniture, mattresses, electronics and marketplace seller items earn 1.5%, and gift cards and a list of brands earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

| November 21, 2026 | 13% |
| November 24, 2026 | 10% (was 2%) |
| November 25, 2026 | 10% (was 2%) |
| November 26, 2026 | 12% (was 2%) |

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the store's usual rate. On November 26 the page carried a banner tying the 12% rate to Black Friday. The raised rate has moved twice since November 21, and a raised rate can end without notice. How long 12% lasts, and what the rate will be on Black Friday itself or on Cyber Monday, is not confirmed. See [Rakuten on Black Friday](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/) and [Rakuten on Cyber Monday](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/).

## What is excluded

One more term: the part of an order paid with Star Dollars does not qualify.

Leased brand items are not listed by name on the page. Which other brands fall under that term is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes, pickup and app

- **Coupon codes.** The page's FAQ says one store promo code per order can be used with Rakuten cash back. Rakuten's general page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back, so the two statements pull in different directions. A code shown on Rakuten's own page is the safer choice. The deals listed on November 26 were sale links, such as up to 70% off Black Friday deals and 50% off select Levi's denim, not codes.
- **Pickup.** The page describes free in-store and curbside pickup as ways to shop, but the terms do not say whether a pickup order earns. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the store's app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.
- **Adjustments.** These are excluded. The page does not define the term.

Taxes and shipping do not count. Cash back is figured on what you pay for the goods after discounts.

The offer is a flat $10, not a percentage, so a $100 purchase and a $400 purchase earn the same. Rakuten's in-store FAQ lists the Macy's American Express card as not eligible for linking. The listing says cash back is added to the Rakuten account the same day. Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

- You are spending under $100 at a store register. The in-store offer has a $100 minimum.

# Rakuten Marriott cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-marriott-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 26, 2026, Rakuten's Marriott.com page showed 3% cash back on bookings, with no "was" label, paid on the room rate of a completed stay and capped at $100 per order. Rooms paid with points, member-only and negotiated rates, and hotels in Asia or Australia earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you book. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 26, 2026

| Listing on Rakuten | Rate shown | "Was" label |
|---|---|---|
| Marriott.com, one tier: "Marriott.com Bookings" | 3% | None |
| Marriott Bonvoy – Points (buying points only) | 1.25% | None |

The store page sits at rakuten.com/shop/marriotthotelsandresorts. The address rakuten.com/marriott.com led to Rakuten's "page not found" screen that day. The points listing says in its terms that it does not cover hotel bookings.

## What the 3% is paid on

The terms say cash back is available on the room rate, and not on fees, taxes or VAT. Resort fees are not named one by one; the word used is "fees".

A special term limits the amount: a maximum of $100 may be earned per order. At 3%, that limit is reached at a room rate of $3,333.33.

| Room rate for the stay | 3% works out to | Paid after the cap |
|---|---|---|
| $450 (three nights at $150) | $13.50 | $13.50 |
| $1,200 | $36.00 | $36.00 |
| $3,333.33 | $100.00 | $100.00 |
| $5,000 | $150.00 | $100.00 |

On a bill of $450 in room charges plus $63 in taxes and fees, the base is $450, not $513. Whether a booking of two rooms counts as one order or two is not confirmed.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Marriott.com list these as earning nothing:

- Rooms booked and paid for with Marriott Bonvoy points
- Member Exclusive Rates, Member Flexible Rates, Bonvoy Offer discounts and packages, and Elite Exclusive Offers
- Corporate, government, group, event, employee and friends-and-family rates
- Airfare, car rentals, vacation packages and gift cards
- Properties located in Asia or Australia
- Four brands: Ritz-Carlton Destination Club, Design Hotels, Bulgari and W Hotels
- About two dozen named properties, among them Atlantis, The Cosmopolitan Las Vegas, The Ritz-Carlton London, The Westin Resort Guam, five resorts in Fiji and Four Points by Sheraton Havana

The member-rate lines matter for anyone signed in to a Bonvoy account while booking. Which rate types Marriott's site offers a signed-in member, and how each is labeled at checkout, is not confirmed here. The terms name the rate types; they do not say how Rakuten identifies them.

Rakuten's gift card FAQ also names Marriott among stores where the part of a purchase paid with a gift card earns no cash back.

## Stay rules, points and prepaid rates

- **Completed stays.** Cash back is available only on completed hotel stays. The posting line says it is added within six weeks after travel has been completed.
- **Hotel points and elite credit.** The booking is made on Marriott's own site, and Rakuten's page describes it as booking directly. The Rakuten terms say nothing about earning Bonvoy points or elite night credit on a stay that starts at Rakuten. Marriott's program terms did not load in full on November 26, 2026. Not confirmed.
- **Prepaid or pay at the hotel.** The terms do not separate the two. Not confirmed.
- **Award nights.** Not eligible.
- **Changes and outside codes.** The Marriott.com terms do not mention either. Not confirmed.

Payment follows Rakuten's schedule once the cash back is added; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Brand pages with their own terms

Rakuten also keeps separate pages for some Marriott brands. JW Marriott, Sheraton and Westin each showed 3% and the same $100 cap on November 26, 2026, but their exclusion lists differ. The Sheraton and Westin pages add bookings in Macau and properties in the Pacific Islands. The JW Marriott page names Ritz-Carlton and Edition as excluded brands, which the Marriott.com page does not. Which list governs a stay when the pages disagree is not confirmed.

## Amex points instead of cash

Members with an eligible American Express card can take Membership Rewards points in place of cash, at 1 point per cent. The $13.50 above would be 1,350 points, and the $100 cap would work out to 10,000 points. How the cap is applied to points is not confirmed. See [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/). Other booking routes are compared in [Rakuten for hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/), and another chain's rules are in [Rakuten at IHG](/rakuten-ihg-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- You are paying with Bonvoy points.
- You book a member-only, corporate, government or group rate.
- Your hotel is in Asia or Australia, or is a W, Bulgari or Design Hotels property.
- Your room rate is far above $3,333. The cash back stops at $100.
- You are booking a package with flights or a car. Those are excluded.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Marriott?**
3% on November 26, 2026, with no "was" label. Rates change daily.

**Is there a limit on Marriott cash back?**
Yes. The terms cap it at $100 per order, reached at a $3,333.33 room rate.

**Do stays booked with Bonvoy points earn cash back?**
No. Rooms booked and paid for with points are not eligible.

# Rakuten missing cash back or cash back not showing up: causes and how to submit a claim

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Rakuten cash back usually goes missing because the click from Rakuten to the store was lost, or because the item or order was excluded. If it is still not showing up after 48 hours and the store's terms say you should have earned it, submit Rakuten's Missing Cash Back form; Rakuten's terms say to report it within 90 days of the purchase.

This page is information, not financial advice. Every figure here was re-read on Rakuten's pages on November 25, 2026.

## First, give it two days

Rakuten says a new order shows as "processing" while it waits for the store, which typically takes 24 to 48 hours. Travel is slower: Rakuten says a booking may not show as pending until the trip is over, except at Expedia, where it shows within 5 days of the reservation. The usual waits by type of purchase are on [how long a purchase takes to show up](/rakuten-how-long-until-purchase-shows-up/).

| Status in your account | What Rakuten says it means |
|---|---|
| Processing | Waiting for the store to send the order details; typically 24 to 48 hours |
| Pending | The store reported the order; a wait for returns and changes follows |
| Confirmed | Added to your confirmed balance and included in the next payment |
| Ineligible | The order does not qualify: a return, an exclusion, a coupon not found on Rakuten |

Rakuten's pages give two figures for the pending wait: 3 to 14 weeks on the payment page and 3 to 17 weeks on the status page.

## Which problem do you have?

Rakuten separates two cases.

| What you see in your account | What it means | Usual cause |
|---|---|---|
| No shopping trip at all | Rakuten has no record that you clicked through | The tracking cookie was blocked or never placed |
| A shopping trip, but $0 or "ineligible" | The click was recorded; the order did not qualify | An exclusion, a return or a cancellation |

## The causes Rakuten lists

**The click was lost**

- An ad blocker, VPN or cookie blocker was on, or cookies were declined.
- Another rewards or coupon site or extension took over the click.
- You checked out in a different tab, or after the session sat idle too long.
- You activated cash back after items were already in the cart. This is covered in [forgot to activate Rakuten](/rakuten-forgot-to-activate-cash-back/).
- The order was placed by phone, chat or customer service.
- You paid with a button such as PayPal, Apple Pay, Shop Pay, Google Pay or Samsung Pay. Rakuten's blog says these open a new window or app that may interrupt tracking.
- You placed a second order without starting a new shopping trip. The blog says each order needs its own.

**The order did not qualify**

- The item, category or brand is excluded at that store.
- You used a coupon code that Rakuten did not list.
- The order was returned or canceled. A partial return is adjusted.
- It was a gift card purchase. Most are excluded, and some stores exclude orders paid with a gift card.
- For travel, the booking was changed after it was made. Rakuten says any change voids the cash back.

A preorder earns when the item ships, not when it is ordered, and an order that ships in parts may show as separate amounts, according to Rakuten's blog.

Taxes and shipping never earn cash back, and a category may pay less than the headline "up to" rate, so a smaller amount is not always an error.

## How to submit a claim, step by step

1. Wait 48 hours after the order. For travel, wait until after the trip unless you booked at Expedia.
2. Open the store's page on Rakuten and read "See all Terms & Exclusions". If your item or payment type is excluded there, there is nothing to claim.
3. Check your Rakuten account for a shopping trip on that date. In the iOS and Android apps the page is called Shopping Trips, and Rakuten says it lists every place you activated cash back, whether or not you bought.
4. Gather the order confirmation email. Rakuten's blog lists what to keep: retailer name, order number, date, items purchased and total amount, plus the full itinerary for travel.
5. Submit the Missing Cash Back form at rakuten.com/help/missing-cash-back, signed in to your account.

What the form asks for and how long a review takes are not confirmed; the form sits behind sign-in. For a purchase in a physical store, Rakuten's in-store FAQ points to its contact page instead and says Member Services uses the receipt.

## The claim window

| Source | Deadline to report missing cash back |
|---|---|
| Rakuten's terms and conditions (section 10.4) | Within 90 days of the transaction |
| Rakuten's help articles | No deadline stated |
| Best Buy's listing on Rakuten | Within 30 days from the order date |

A store can set a shorter window than the general one, so read the store's special terms. Submit soon after the 48 hours, and treat 90 days as the outer limit.

This matters for travel. A stay booked four months ahead may not show as pending until after checkout, when 90 days from the booking have passed. Ask Rakuten early.

## What a claim can and cannot do

Rakuten is paid by the store. Its terms say that if a store does not pay Rakuten for a transaction, Rakuten may cancel the cash back for it, and that Rakuten decides whether a purchase qualifies. A claim asks Rakuten to check the order with the store; it is not a guarantee. Approved cash back is still paid on the usual dates; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

To prevent a repeat: start at Rakuten with an empty cart, stay in the same tab, turn off other coupon extensions, and use only codes shown on Rakuten. Rakuten also offers a filter list for people who keep an ad blocker on. These steps matter most on busy days; see [Rakuten on Black Friday](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/).

For purchases in a physical store the causes differ. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- The amount is a few cents or the item was clearly excluded. A claim will not change that.
- A coupon code from another site saved you more than the cash back would have.
- You will not turn off a VPN or ad blocker to shop. Tracking will keep failing.

## Quick answers

**How long do you have to submit missing Rakuten cash back?**
Rakuten's terms say within 90 days of the transaction. Its help pages give no deadline, and a store can set less.

**Where do you submit missing cash back on Rakuten?**
On the Missing Cash Back form at rakuten.com/help/missing-cash-back, after you sign in.

**Why is my Rakuten cash back not showing up?**
In the first 48 hours it may still be processing. After that, the click was lost or the order did not qualify.

# Rakuten Neiman Marcus cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-neiman-marcus-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Neiman Marcus. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Neiman Marcus page showed 15% cash back, marked "was 2%". Jewelry, watches, Prada, gift cards, phone orders and orders placed through the Neiman Marcus app earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

| Rate | Category on Rakuten's list |
|---|---|
| 15% | Beauty |
| 15% | All other non-excluded items |
| 0% | Excluded items and orders (see below) |

The "was 2%" label means 2% is the base rate and 15% is a raised rate. The page gives no end date for it, so it can drop back at any time.

Rakuten's page gives one more figure: the average cash back earned per Neiman Marcus shopper was $126.19 as of the end of 2025. It does not say over what period.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Neiman Marcus list these as earning nothing:

- Gift cards, bought or redeemed
- Jewelry
- Watches
- Prada, the one brand named
- Phone orders
- Employee orders
- Orders placed by a style adviser or customer service
- Orders placed through the Neiman Marcus app

The terms do not define "jewelry". Whether fashion jewelry is treated differently from fine jewelry is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes: the firm wording

The terms say that using coupon or promo codes not listed on Rakuten "will void" cash back. Many store pages say "may void"; this one is firmer.

The page does not fully agree with itself. Its summary section says Neiman Marcus coupons can be combined with cash back. Its question-and-answer section says outside codes can void it. The terms are the stricter reading: one code from outside Rakuten is enough to lose the 15%.

## InCircle points

InCircle is the store's rewards program. Rakuten's page describes it as 2 base points per eligible dollar, and says InCircle points and cash back can be earned on the same eligible purchase. The terms name gift card redemption as excluded. Whether paying with an InCircle Point Card counts as gift card redemption is not confirmed.

## Online and in-store do not combine

The terms say online offers are not valid in store or in combination with In-Store Cash Back. The 15% is for orders on the website after a Rakuten click. Neiman Marcus did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so whether an in-store offer exists is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | At 15% | At the 2% base |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beauty order | $200 | $30.00 | $4.00 |
| Handbag | $1,500 | $225.00 | $30.00 |
| Watch | $1,500 | $0 | $0 |
| Prada item | $1,500 | $0 | $0 |

Taxes and shipping are not mentioned in the Neiman Marcus terms.

## Returns, and when it shows up

Rakuten's page says most items can be returned within 30 days of receipt, and that final sale and personalized items cannot be returned. What happens to cash back on a returned item is not stated on this page.

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "in a few days", after the order is confirmed and out of pending status. The page says payment is every three months; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). For another department store's terms, see [Rakuten at Nordstrom](/rakuten-nordstrom-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- You are buying jewelry, a watch, Prada or a gift card. They earn nothing.
- You order by phone, through a style adviser or in the Neiman Marcus app.
- You have a promo code from the store's emails that is not on Rakuten. Using it voids cash back.
- You shop in a Neiman Marcus store. The online rate does not apply there.
- You are counting on 15% next week. The base rate is 2%, and the raised rate has no stated end date.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Neiman Marcus?**
15% on November 25, 2026, raised from a 2% base. Rates change daily.

**Does jewelry earn cash back at Neiman Marcus?**
No. Jewelry, watches, gift cards and Prada are excluded in the terms.

**Can you use a Neiman Marcus promo code and still get cash back?**
Only a code listed on Rakuten. The terms say other codes will void cash back.

# Rakuten New Balance cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-new-balance-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's New Balance page showed 9% cash back, with a "was 3%" label. Limited releases and collaborations earn nothing, and neither do gift card purchases, gift card redemptions or orders judged to be for reselling.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

The page showed 9% with a "was 3%" label and no rate by category. A "was" label means the rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. The page does not say when 9% ends, and nothing on it promises the rate for Black Friday (November 27, 2026) or Cyber Monday (November 30, 2026).

The terms do not define "Limited Releases" or "Collaborations", and the page does not list which shoes fall under them. Which products count is not confirmed.

The gift card line covers "purchase or redemption". Whether an order paid partly with a gift card loses all of its cash back or only that part is not confirmed.

The terms say coupons or promotional codes not listed on Rakuten "may void" cash back. On November 25, 2026, the offers on the page were sale links, not codes.

# Rakuten Newegg cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-newegg-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Newegg. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Newegg page showed 1% cash back, with no raised rate. Gift cards earn nothing, and orders using coupon codes that begin with any of seven named prefixes, such as EMC, earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

| Item | What the page showed |
|---|---|
| Headline rate | 1% |
| Rakuten's "was" label | None |
| Rate by category | No category list |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's base rate. Newegg's page has none, so 1% is the plain rate. The page listed Newegg's Black Friday sale at the same 1%. Nothing on the page promises a higher rate on Black Friday (November 27, 2026).

## What is excluded

The exclusions for Newegg are short. Cash back is not available on:

- Gift cards
- Coupon codes that begin with these prefixes: EMC, EMP, NAF, DYN, MBLN, B2BEMC, BTE

No product category is excluded in the terms. Computer parts, laptops, monitors and TVs are not named as earning nothing. That is different from some other electronics stores on Rakuten; see [Rakuten at Best Buy](/rakuten-best-buy-cash-back-how-it-works/) for a longer list.

## Coupon codes: check the first letters

The terms treat codes in two ways.

| Code used at checkout | What the terms say |
|---|---|
| A code listed on Rakuten | Allowed |
| A code beginning EMC, EMP, NAF, DYN, MBLN, B2BEMC or BTE | Cash back is not available |
| Any other code not listed on Rakuten | May void cash back |

The terms do not say where the prefixed codes come from. The page does say that signing up for Newegg's emails brings email-only coupons. Whether those are the EMC codes is not confirmed. The safe reading is to look at the first letters of any code before using it.

On November 25, 2026, the Newegg offers shown on Rakuten were sales and free shipping, with no code listed.

## Marketplace sellers

Rakuten's page says third-party sellers offer items through Newegg Marketplace, and that some of those items may be used. The cash back terms do not mention Marketplace sellers. Whether an item sold by a third party earns the 1% is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | At 1% |
|---|---|---|
| Solid-state drive | $90 | $0.90 |
| Graphics card | $600 | $6.00 |
| Gaming desktop | $1,500 | $15.00 |
| Gift card | Any | $0 |

Taxes and shipping are not mentioned in the Newegg terms. The page's question-and-answer section says orders over $25 ship free.

At 1%, a discount code can be worth more than the cash back. As an example of the sums, a code worth 5% on a $600 part takes off $30; the cash back on the same part is $6. If the code starts with one of the listed prefixes, the two cannot be combined.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **App.** The terms do not mention the Newegg app. Not confirmed.
- **Pickup and stores.** The page showed an online rate only and the terms do not mention pickup. Newegg did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "in a few days". Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/). For laptops bought from the makers, see [laptop cash back at Dell, HP and Lenovo](/rakuten-laptop-cash-back-dell-hp-lenovo/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a Newegg code that starts with EMC, EMP, NAF, DYN, MBLN, B2BEMC or BTE and it saves more than 1%.
- You are buying a gift card.
- Your order is small. On $50, the cash back is $0.50.
- You are buying from a Marketplace seller and need certainty. That case is not confirmed.
- You are waiting for a raised rate. None was shown, and none is promised.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Newegg?**
1% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Which Newegg promo codes cancel cash back?**
Codes that begin with EMC, EMP, NAF, DYN, MBLN, B2BEMC or BTE. Other outside codes may void it.

**Do computer parts earn cash back at Newegg?**
The terms exclude no product category. Only gift cards are named.

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-nike-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-21
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 21, 2026, Rakuten's Nike page showed 4% cash back, raised from a usual 2%. New releases, select Jordans, purchases in the SNKRS app, gift cards and orders paid with gift cards are excluded.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Nike list these as earning nothing:

- New releases
- Select Jordans
- Purchases made in the SNKRS app, and items that nike.com/launch shows as SNKRS-only
- Refurbished shoes
- HyperIce products
- Gift cards, and purchases paid for with gift cards

- Orders Nike judges to be for reselling
- After Dark marathon tickets
- Orders from outside the US

The terms do not define "new releases" or say which Jordans are excluded. How long a shoe counts as a new release is not confirmed.

## Three terms that are stricter than usual

Taxes and shipping do not count.

## In stores

## When you get the money

Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You buy launch-day shoes or limited Jordans. Those are excluded.
- You buy through the SNKRS app.
- You order several sizes and return what does not fit. One return voids the whole order.
- You pay with Nike gift cards.
- You buy for a team or to resell.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Nike?**
4% on November 21, 2026, against a usual 2%. Rates change daily.

**Do new releases and Jordans earn cash back?**
New releases and select Jordans are excluded. The terms do not list which ones.

**What happens if I return one item?**
The terms say cash back for the entire order is void if any part is returned, exchanged or canceled.

Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You are shopping at Nordstrom itself while its page shows no cash back. The Rakuten step earns nothing.
- You are a new member counting on a Nordstrom order for [the sign-up bonus](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/). A purchase has to earn cash back to qualify.
- You are buying Coach, Chanel, Birkenstock, Rainbow or Free People at the Rack.
- You are buying gift cards.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten give cash back at Nordstrom?**
Not on November 21, 2026. Rakuten's Nordstrom page showed no cash back that day.

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Nordstrom Rack?**
2% on November 21, 2026, with no "was" rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Which brands are excluded at Nordstrom Rack?**
Free People, Free People Movement, Coach, Rainbow, Chanel and Birkenstock. Gift cards are excluded too.

Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Office Depot and OfficeMax, which share one store page. On November 25, 2026, that page showed 2% cash back with no raised rate. Gift cards, postage stamps and Business Services Division orders earn nothing, and the store's cookie consent must be accepted on its site.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## Rates seen on November 25, 2026

The page has a category list. Every line was at the same rate that day.

| Category on Rakuten's list | Rate shown |
|---|---|
| Accessories | 2% |
| Computers | 2% |
| Electronics | 2% |
| Furniture | 2% |
| All other non-excluded items | 2% |

No "was" label was shown, so 2% is the plain rate. The page's Black Friday product list carried the same 2%. Nothing on the page promises a higher rate later in the week.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for the store list three things that earn nothing:

| Earns nothing | Note |
|---|---|
| Gift card purchases | Buying gift cards |
| Postage stamps | No further detail |
| Business Services Division orders | The terms do not define which accounts this covers |

Print, copy and shipping services are not named in the exclusions or in the category list. Whether they earn under "all other non-excluded items" is not confirmed.

## The cookie consent rule

The terms carry a special condition: cash back is not available unless the store's cookie consent policy is accepted on its site. Rakuten's general help page says cookies are how it knows where a member is shopping. A shopper who declines the cookie banner on the store's site should expect no cash back on that order.

## Coupon codes and free gift offers

The terms say that using coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's page listed several codes of its own, each at 2% cash back. Examples: a free $25 gift card with a $150 purchase, and a free $20 gas card with a $100 purchase.

Those are codes Rakuten lists, so they fit the rule. Whether a free gift card received with a qualifying order changes the amount that earns is not confirmed.

## The store's own rewards

Rakuten's page describes the store's rewards program in two places, and the two do not match. One passage says members get 10% back in points on ink, toner, paper and copy, print and ship services. Another says 2% back in rewards on supplies, furniture and tech. Which is current is not confirmed; the store's own site is the place to look.

The cash back terms do not mention the rewards program. Whether the part of an order paid with a rewards certificate earns cash back is not confirmed.

## Pickup, stores and returns

- **Pickup.** The page says the store offers free in-store and curbside pickup. The cash back terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The page says cash back is for online purchases at OfficeDepot.com or OfficeMax.com. No in-store offer was shown on it. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).
- **Returns.** The page says unopened products can be returned within 90 days. Rakuten's help page says returned or canceled orders do not earn cash back.

| Gift card or postage stamps | Any | $0 |

Taxes and shipping do not count. Card rewards are separate; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "tomorrow". Payment follows every three months; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If nothing appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You buy through a Business Services Division account. Those orders are excluded.
- You are buying gift cards or postage stamps.
- You decline cookie banners. This store's terms require the consent.
- You have a code from the store's emails or flyers that is not on Rakuten and is worth more than 2%.
- You buy in a store. The rate shown is for online orders.

2% on November 25, 2026, in every listed category. Rates change daily.

- You pay mostly with reward points or gift cards. That part earns nothing.

# Rakuten and Petco: how the cash back works and what is excluded

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-petco-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Petco page showed 2% cash back online and 2% in stores. Grooming, training, pharmacy items, Vital Care, gift cards, donations and every repeat delivery after the first earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate, and how it moves

| Date checked | Where seen | Rate shown |
|---|---|---|
| November 21, 2026 | Rakuten's Black Friday page | 10% (was 2%) |
| November 25, 2026 | Petco store page | 2% online, 2% in-store |
| November 25, 2026 | Petco Black Friday page | 2% |

The raised rate seen on November 21 was not on the page four days later. No category table appears, so the one rate covers all eligible items. Black Friday is November 27, 2026. Nothing on the page says whether a raised rate returns.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Petco list these as earning nothing:

- Grooming services
- Training
- Pharmacy items
- Petco Vital Care
- Gift cards
- Donations
- The part of an order paid with Vital Care Rewards
- Repeat delivery subscriptions after the first delivery

Veterinary services are not named in the terms. Not confirmed. A separate Rakuten help page names Petco among stores that pay no cash back on the part of an order paid with a gift card.

The services rule differs by store. PetSmart's terms on Rakuten pay cash back on grooming; Petco's exclude it. See [Rakuten at PetSmart](/rakuten-petsmart-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Repeat Delivery

Repeat Delivery is the store's subscription for regular orders. The first delivery earns cash back and later ones do not. Rakuten's page says the first qualifying Repeat Delivery order gets 30% off; that is the store's discount and can change. [Chewy's terms](/rakuten-chewy-cash-back-how-it-works/) have a similar rule for repeat orders.

## Vital Care

Rakuten's page describes the Vital Care Core level as earning 5 Reward Dollars for every $100 spent. Two rules touch it:

- Buying Petco Vital Care itself earns no cash back.
- The part of an order paid with Vital Care Rewards earns no cash back.

Earning rewards on an order is not named as a problem.

## In stores: a linked card, not a click

Petco is one of the stores with an in-store rate on its Rakuten page. It works through a card linked to the Rakuten account and an offer added before paying. The in-store terms on the page say:

- US stores only, not locations in US territories.
- Gift card purchases do not count.
- A debit card must be run as credit, without a PIN.
- Once the offer is added and first used, further purchases count for up to 1 hour. After that it must be added again.
- An added offer that is not used expires 45 days after it is added, or when the offer ends if sooner.
- If the same store is added on more than one rewards site, only the most recently added offer pays.
- In-store offers are not valid for online purchases and cannot be combined with other offers.

Whether the online exclusions, such as grooming and training, also apply to a linked-card payment in a store is not confirmed; the in-store terms name gift cards only. Setup is covered in [how to link a card for in-store cash back](/rakuten-link-card-for-in-store-cash-back/).

| Arm & Hammer cat litter, 38 lb | $30.99 | $0.62 |
| Grooming or training | Any | $0 |
| Second and later repeat deliveries | Any | $0 |

Taxes and shipping do not count. Rakuten's page says Petco ships free on orders of $49 or more, with exclusions.

## Pickup, app and returns

- **Pickup.** Rakuten's page listed a store deal for 10% off pickup orders of $50 or more, shown with the 2% rate beside it. The terms themselves do not mention pickup. Because in-store offers are "not valid for online purchases", an order placed online for pickup falls under the online offer, if it earns. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the Petco app. An online purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.
- **Returns.** No store rule is listed. Rakuten's general help page says returned or canceled orders do not earn cash back.

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "tomorrow". That is the pending entry. Payment follows on Rakuten's four dates a year; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Who should skip it

- Your orders are repeat deliveries. Only the first one earns.
- You are paying for grooming, training or pharmacy items.
- You pay with Vital Care Rewards or a gift card.
- You shop at a Petco in a US territory and planned on the in-store rate.
- You have a discount elsewhere worth more than 2% on the same item.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Petco?**
2% online and 2% in stores on November 25, 2026. Rates change daily.

**Do Petco Repeat Delivery orders earn cash back?**
The first delivery does. Later deliveries do not.

- Canceled orders
- Orders placed using a coupon code
- Bookings completed by phone, through another travel website or through a search engine

The order must be placed on the priceline.com website.

## Coupon codes: stricter than most stores

Many Rakuten store pages say codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. The Priceline terms go further. They say orders placed using a coupon code are not eligible, and that use of coupon or promotional codes "will void" cash back. No exception is written for codes shown on Rakuten. On November 25, 2026, the offers listed on Rakuten's Priceline page were sale links, not codes.

## The app

Rakuten's page describes app-only deals in the Priceline mobile app. The terms say all orders must be placed on the priceline.com website. They do not name the app. Whether a booking finished in the Priceline app earns is not confirmed.

## When it shows up

This is slower than a store purchase. The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account within 3 months after travel has been completed. Rakuten's general help page says travel cash back is typically confirmed 6 to 17 weeks after travel is complete.

So the clock starts at the end of the trip, not at booking. A stay booked in November for the following July would not show as confirmed until after July. Payment then follows Rakuten's usual schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). For how this compares with other travel sites, see [Rakuten on hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/) and [Rakuten at Expedia and Booking.com](/rakuten-expedia-booking-com-cash-back/).

## What it comes to

These are worked examples at the rates seen, not prices from the page.

| Booking | Price before taxes and fees | Rate seen | Cash back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hotel stay | $600 | 8% | $48.00 |
| Rental car | $300 | 4% | $12.00 |
| Cruise | $1,500 | 2% | $30.00 |
| Flight | Any | $2 flat | $2.00 |
| Any booking made with a coupon code | Any | Excluded | $0 |

Whether the $2 on flights is per ticket or per order is not stated on the page. Not confirmed.

## In stores

Priceline is an online booking site, and the page showed an online offer only. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/) for the stores that have one.

## Who should skip it

- You have a Priceline coupon code worth more than the cash back. Using it voids the cash back.
- You are booking only a flight. The return is $2.
- You book by phone, or you reach Priceline from a search engine or another travel site.
- A large share of the bill is taxes and resort fees. They do not count.
- You may cancel. Canceled orders earn nothing.
- You need the money soon. It posts after the trip, not after booking.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Priceline?**
Up to 8% on November 25, 2026: 8% on hotels, 4% on rental cars, 2% on cruises and $2 on flights. Rates change daily.

**Can you use a Priceline coupon code and still get cash back?**
No. The terms say orders placed using a coupon code are not eligible for cash back.

**When does Priceline cash back post?**
Within 3 months after travel is completed, according to the posting line on Rakuten's page.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).
