# Rakuten Sam's Club cash back: what earns 9%, what earns 3%, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-sams-club-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-24
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 24, 2026, Rakuten's Sam's Club page showed up to 9% cash back: 9% on new memberships, raised from a usual 4%, and 3% on all other eligible items, raised from a usual 1%. Groceries, household essentials, membership renewals, Scan & Go purchases, cell phones and iPads earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The two tiers seen on November 24, 2026

| Category | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| New memberships | 9% | 4% |
| All other eligible items | 3% | 1% |

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the store's usual rate. The "up to 9%" in the headline is the membership rate only. Merchandise earns 3%.

The page names 17 departments at 3%, among them appliances, electronics, mattresses, home, kitchen and dining, outdoor and patio, toys, jewelry, clothing, office, and savings and clearance. Pickup orders and Delivery from Club are listed at 3% too, each marked "eligible items only". How long the raised rates last is not confirmed.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Sam's Club list these as earning nothing:

- Consumables: groceries, household essentials and select personal care
- Membership renewals
- Scan & Go purchases
- Cell phones and iPads
- Tires, fuel, pharmacy, travel and Sam's Services
- Alcohol, tobacco and stamps
- Gift cards
- My Pillow products
- Orders deemed for reselling purposes, and high volume orders
- The portion of an order paid with a gift card or Sam's Cash

Three of these matter more than the rest. Groceries and household essentials are a large share of a typical club order, and they earn 0%. Electronics earn 3%, but cell phones and iPads are carved out. Scan & Go, the store's phone checkout inside the club, does not earn.

The terms do not say which personal care items are "select", or how large an order must be to count as high volume. Both are not confirmed. Whether tablets other than iPads earn is not stated.

## The membership tier

Sam's Club's own membership page listed two plans on November 24, 2026:

| Plan | Price a year | 9% cash back | At the usual 4% |
|---|---|---|---|
| Club | $60 | $5.40 | $2.40 |
| Plus (now includes Walmart+) | $120 | $10.80 | $4.80 |

Rakuten's terms say new memberships and do not name a plan. Whether both plans earn 9%, whether an upgrade from Club to Plus counts as new, and whether a discounted membership offer earns on the reduced price are not confirmed. Renewals are excluded by name.

A membership bought at the club counter is an in-person purchase. Rakuten's cash back here is for orders that start from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.

## Sam's Cash is separate

Sam's Club's page lists up to 2% back in Sam's Cash as a Plus benefit. That is the store's own reward, not Rakuten's. Rakuten's terms exclude the part of an order paid with Sam's Cash, so spending Sam's Cash lowers the amount that earns.

## Other terms

- **Posting.** The page says cash back is added to the Rakuten account within one week. That is longer than the next-day posting on many store pages.
- **Missing cash back.** The page gives no store deadline. Rakuten's general terms allow 90 days from the transaction. See [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).
- **Coupon codes.** No code rule is listed for Sam's Club. Rakuten's general page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the Sam's Club app, apart from Scan & Go. Not confirmed.
- **In stores.** Sam's Club did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 24, 2026. The list did not load in full, so this is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | Rate | Cash back |
|---|---|---|---|
| New Club membership | $60 | 9% | $5.40 |
| Television | $500 | 3% | $15.00 |
| Patio set | $900 | 3% | $27.00 |
| Same patio set at the usual 1% | $900 | 1% | $9.00 |
| Groceries and paper goods | $200 | 0% | $0 |
| iPad or cell phone | Any | 0% | $0 |
| Membership renewal | Any | 0% | $0 |

Taxes and shipping do not count. On an order of $500 for a television and $200 in groceries, only the television earns: $15. Whether an excluded item in the cart affects the rest of the order is not stated in the terms.

## Costco and Walmart

Rakuten's Costco page showed no cash back on the same day. See [Rakuten at Costco](/rakuten-costco-cash-back-how-it-works/). Walmart, which owns Sam's Club, has a different kind of offer: see [Rakuten at Walmart](/rakuten-walmart-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When you get the money

Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- Your order is mostly groceries and household essentials. Those are excluded.
- You are renewing a membership. Only new memberships earn.
- You check out in the club with Scan & Go.
- You are buying a cell phone, an iPad or tires.
- You pay mostly with Sam's Cash or a gift card.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Sam's Club?**
On November 24, 2026: 9% on new memberships and 3% on other eligible items. The usual rates shown were 4% and 1%.

**Do groceries earn cash back at Sam's Club?**
No. Groceries, household essentials and select personal care items are excluded.

**Does a membership renewal earn cash back?**
No. Renewals are excluded. New memberships earned 9% on November 24, 2026.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two. [Welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus](/rakuten-welcome-bonus-vs-referral-bonus/) compares the two offers as read on November 26, 2026.

The other large beauty listing is [Rakuten at Ulta](/rakuten-ulta-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## The rate, and how it moves

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 21, 2026 | 4% | 2% |

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the store's usual rate. The page does not say when the rate was raised or when it ends. No category table was seen in the part of the page that loaded, so one rate appears to cover all eligible items. Rakuten's terms say rates can vary by member.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Sephora list these as earning nothing:

- Gift cards and e-gift cards
- The portion of an order paid with rewards
- Auto-ship (subscription) orders
- Orders placed with the store's sites for Canada, Hong Kong or Singapore
- Orders the store judges to be for reselling

No brands or product categories are listed as excluded. That is less common. Many department stores on Rakuten exclude a list of brands.

## Coupon codes

The terms say: "Using coupon codes that are not listed on Rakuten may void Cash Back." The page advises using only codes Rakuten provides.

A sale code that is not on Rakuten's page puts the cash back at risk. The sums decide it, using a 20% code as an example:

| Order | A 20% code, no cash back | 4% cash back, no code | 2% cash back, no code |
|---|---|---|---|
| $100 | $20.00 off | $4.00 back | $2.00 back |
| $250 | $50.00 off | $10.00 back | $5.00 back |

If the code is also listed on Rakuten's store page that day, both may apply.

## Pickup, app and loyalty points

- **Pickup.** The terms do not mention in-store pickup. The page describes it only as a shopping option. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the store's app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension. An order started directly in a store app is not expected to track.
- **Loyalty points.** The terms do not say that Rakuten cash back affects the store's own loyalty points. Paying with rewards is different: that part of the order does not earn.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | At 2% | At 4% |
|---|---|---|---|
| Moisturizer | $60 | $1.20 | $2.40 |
| Fragrance | $150 | $3.00 | $6.00 |
| Hair tool | $400 | $8.00 | $16.00 |

Taxes and shipping do not count. Returned items lose their cash back.

## In stores

This store did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 21, 2026. The list was cut off, so an in-store offer is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When you get the money

Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a sale-event code that is not on Rakuten and it is worth more than 2% to 4%.
- You use auto-ship for regular orders. Those are excluded.
- You pay mostly with rewards or gift cards.
- You order in the store's own app and do not want to start from Rakuten.
- You buy beauty products a few times a year and nothing else through Rakuten. A payment needs about $5 confirmed.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Sephora?**
4% on November 21, 2026, against a usual 2%. Rates change daily.

**Can I use a promo code and still get cash back?**
Only safely with a code listed on Rakuten. The terms say other codes may void it.

**Do gift cards earn cash back?**
No. Gift cards and e-gift cards are excluded.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two. [Welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus](/rakuten-welcome-bonus-vs-referral-bonus/) compares the two offers as read on November 26, 2026.

# Rakuten and SHEIN: how the cash back works and what is excluded

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-shein-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's SHEIN page showed 6% cash back, raised from a usual 2%. Buying or redeeming gift cards, subscriptions and the redemption of SHEIN reward points earn nothing, and a coupon code not listed on Rakuten may void the cash back.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## Where the store page is

Rakuten files SHEIN under an older store name. On November 25, 2026:

| Rakuten address | What it returned |
|---|---|
| rakuten.com/shein.com | "Page Not Found" |
| rakuten.com/shop/shein | A general Rakuten page with no store rate |
| rakuten.com/shop/sheinside | The SHEIN store page, 6% (was 2%) |
| rakuten.com/sheinside.com | The same SHEIN store page |

A missing page at the first two addresses does not mean the store has no offer. Searching for SHEIN on Rakuten leads to the working page.

## The rate, and how it moves

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 25, 2026 | 6% | 2% |

"Was" is Rakuten's own label for the store's base rate. No category table appears, so the one rate covers all eligible items. Rakuten's Black Friday page for the store showed the same 6% on the same day. Black Friday is November 27, 2026. Nothing on the page says how long 6% lasts.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for SHEIN list these as earning nothing:

- The purchase of gift cards
- The redemption of gift cards
- Subscriptions
- The redemption of reward points
- Orders that originate outside a list of 28 countries

The terms do not say which subscriptions they mean. Not confirmed.

## The country rule

This term is unusual among store pages on Rakuten. Cash back is paid only on orders that originate from the United States or one of 27 other listed countries, among them Canada, Mexico, the United Kingdom, Australia, France, Germany, Italy and Spain. The terms say orders from anywhere else "will void" cash back. The terms do not say how the origin of an order is judged, such as by shipping address or by the country version of the site. Not confirmed.

## Coupon codes and points

**Coupon codes.** The terms say codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. Rakuten's page adds that SHEIN accepts a single coupon code per order.

**SHEIN points.** Rakuten's page describes the store's loyalty program as 1 point per $1 spent, with 100 points worth $1 off, and points covering up to 70% of an order before tax and shipping. Earning points is not named as a problem. Redeeming them is: the terms say cash back is not available on the redemption of reward points. Whether the rest of an order paid partly with points still earns is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

| Order, before tax and shipping | At the base 2% | At 6% |
|---|---|---|
| $29 | $0.58 | $1.74 |
| $60 | $1.20 | $3.60 |
| $100 | $2.00 | $6.00 |
| Gift card, bought or redeemed | $0 | $0 |

The $29 row is the free standard shipping threshold shown on Rakuten's page.

## App, pickup and returns

- **App.** The terms do not mention the SHEIN app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension. Whether an order finished in the SHEIN app tracks is not confirmed. The gap between the app and the extension is covered in [Rakuten app or browser extension](/rakuten-app-vs-browser-extension/).
- **Pickup and stores.** The page shows an online rate only, with no in-store rate.
- **Returns.** Rakuten's page describes free returns for up to 45 days, with free return shipping on the first return from an order only. No cash back rule for returns is listed for this store. Rakuten's general help page says returned or canceled orders do not earn cash back.

## When it shows up

The posting line on the page says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "today". That is the pending entry, not the payment. See [how long until a purchase shows up](/rakuten-how-long-until-purchase-shows-up/) and [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

Temu, a similar marketplace, has different terms; see [Rakuten at Temu](/rakuten-temu-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a coupon code from another site that saves more than 6%. Only one code applies per order.
- You plan to pay with SHEIN points or a gift card.
- You are ordering from a country outside the list.
- You are buying a gift card.
- The order is small. At $29, the gap between 2% and 6% is $1.16.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at SHEIN?**
6% on November 25, 2026, against a base rate of 2%. Rates change daily.

**Why does Rakuten's SHEIN address show "Page Not Found"?**
The store page sits under the name sheinside. The shein.com address on Rakuten returned an error page on November 25, 2026.

**Do SHEIN points and Rakuten cash back work together?**
Earning points is not excluded. Redeeming points is: the terms pay no cash back on it.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). The steps from first click to payment are in [how Rakuten works, step by step](/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/).

# Can you take the Rakuten sign-up bonus as Amex points instead of cash?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-sign-up-bonus-as-amex-points/
Facts checked: 2026-11-23
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Rakuten's own pages say yes for its standard welcome bonus: it is added to your next cash back payment or points transfer, and Rakuten's American Express page states the bonus in points. For the bonus that comes with a friend's referral link, Rakuten's pages are silent and travel sites disagree, so that part is not confirmed.

This page is information, not financial advice. Bonus offers change, and the amount shown on the day you join is the one that applies to you.

## Two different bonuses

Rakuten has two new-member bonuses, and its terms say they cannot be combined.

| | Welcome bonus | Bonus through a friend's link |
|---|---|---|
| Purchases needed | At least $25 | At least $50 |
| Time limit | 90 days from joining | 90 days from joining |
| Paid as points, per Rakuten | Yes: terms say "Cash Back payment or points transfer" | Not stated |
| Paid as points, per travel sites | Not addressed separately | Two say yes, two say no |

How the friend's-link bonus works in cash is covered in [the sign-up bonus through a friend's link](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

## What Rakuten says

- The welcome bonus terms say the bonus is added to the next payment "or points transfer", and that a qualifying purchase is one that earns cash back or points.
- Rakuten's American Express page, read on November 23, 2026, showed a welcome bonus of 5,000 points for new members who spend $25 on purchases eligible for points within 90 days. That figure is what the page showed that day, not a fixed amount.
- The Membership Rewards FAQ says confirmed points earned on purchases, bonuses and other rewards are transferred to Amex.
- The referral page and the referral terms do not mention points at all.

## What travel sites say about a friend's link

| Source | Bonus as points? | Date |
|---|---|---|
| AwardWallet | Yes, when the account is set to points | November 20, 2026 |
| Upgraded Points | Yes, by updating profile settings | Updated October 1, 2026 (offer since expired) |
| One Mile at a Time | No; points apply only to spending after the bonus | November 22, 2026 |
| The Points Guy | No; the enrollment bonus stays cash | Bylined August 2025 |

The sources disagree, and Rakuten's referral pages do not settle it. Treat points on a friend's-link bonus as possible but not confirmed.

## The ratio

Rakuten pays 1 Membership Rewards point per cent of cash back. Its example is 10% cash back becoming 10 points per dollar. On that basis $1 of bonus is 100 points. Rakuten does not print a separate ratio for bonuses; the sites that say the bonus converts use the same 100 points per dollar.

Whether points are worth more to you than the cash is a separate sum. See [whether the points are worth more than the cash](/rakuten-amex-points-worth-more-than-cash/).

## When the switch has to be made

Rakuten gives no deadline. What its pages say:

- A new member can link Membership Rewards while signing up through Rakuten's American Express page.
- An existing member changes the payment method in Account Settings.
- Confirmed cash back earned before the switch is converted to points and sent by the next transfer date.

Two travel sites say otherwise: the setting applies only to purchases made after the switch. Given that disagreement, the order with the fewest open questions is to link Membership Rewards at sign-up, or before the first purchase. Whether a bonus earned first and switched later still becomes points is not confirmed. The steps are in [how to switch to Amex points](/rakuten-how-to-switch-to-amex-points/).

Points move to Amex on February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15, once the store has confirmed your purchase and you have at least 501 confirmed points.

## Which Amex cards qualify

| Card | Qualifies? |
|---|---|
| US cards enrolled in Membership Rewards (Rakuten names Gold, Green and Platinum) | Yes |
| Corporate cards | No |
| Rakuten American Express Card | No |
| Amex cards that earn cash back or an airline's or hotel's points | No; they are outside Membership Rewards |

The card must be open and not past due. You do not have to pay with it; it only decides where the reward goes. More in [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/).

## Who should skip it

- You redeem Amex points for statement credits or gift cards. That is 1 cent a point or less, so the cash bonus is equal or more.
- You have no Membership Rewards card open. The link cannot be made without one.
- You want certainty about a friend's-link bonus. Cash is the form every source agrees on.
- You use promotions tied to other card issuers on Rakuten. Its terms say those are not available while you are set to Amex points.

## Quick answers

**Does the Rakuten welcome bonus convert to Amex points?**
Rakuten's welcome bonus terms say it is added to your next cash back payment or points transfer.

**How many points is the bonus worth?**
Rakuten's rate is 1 point per cent, so 100 points per dollar. Bonus amounts change.

**Do I have to switch to points before my first purchase?**
Rakuten sets no deadline, but sources disagree on later switches. Linking at sign-up avoids the question.

- [Rakuten: Membership Rewards points FAQ](https://rakuten.com/help/article/american-express-membership-rewards-points-faq-360017609253)
- [Rakuten: Membership Rewards points terms](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/american-express-membership-rewards-points-at-rakuten-terms-360017609913)

# Rakuten Skechers cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-skechers-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Skechers. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Skechers page showed 3% cash back, with no raised rate. Orders greater than $500, orders with five or more of the same item, gift cards and the part of an order paid with loyalty rewards earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

| Item | What the page showed |
|---|---|
| Headline rate | 3% |
| Rakuten's "was" label | None |
| Rate by category | No category list |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's base rate. This page has none, so 3% is the plain rate. The page listed the store's Black Friday sale at the same 3%. Nothing on the page promises a higher rate on Black Friday (November 27, 2026).

Rakuten's page gives one more figure: the average cash back earned per Skechers shopper was $11.37 as of the end of 2025. It does not say over what period.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Skechers list these as earning nothing:

- Orders greater than $500
- Orders with 5 or more of the same item
- Orders that do not originate in the U.S.
- Gift cards, bought or redeemed
- The part of an order paid with loyalty rewards
- Orders deemed to be for reselling

No shoe line or product category is excluded.

## The $500 line

The wording is "orders greater than $500", so the whole order loses cash back, not only the amount above $500. The terms do not say whether $500 is measured before or after discounts, tax and shipping; not confirmed.

| Order | Earns cash back? | At 3% |
|---|---|---|
| One pair at $90 | Yes | $2.70 |
| Four pairs, different styles, $360 total | Yes | $10.80 |
| Five pairs of the same shoe | No | $0 |
| A $540 family order | No | $0 |
| Two separate orders of $270 | Not confirmed | Not confirmed |

## Where the page disagrees with itself

The terms say "5 or more of the same item". The page's question-and-answer section describes the exclusion as orders with five or more items. Those are different rules: five different pairs pass the first and fail the second. The terms are the formal text. Which reading is applied is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes

The terms say that use of coupons or promotional codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. The page says Skechers advertises 20% off a next purchase for joining its email list. A code from that email comes from outside Rakuten, so it falls under the "may void" rule. On November 25, 2026, the offers Rakuten listed were sales, with no code shown.

## Skechers Plus

Skechers Plus is the store's free rewards program. Rakuten's page says 1,000 points are worth a $5 reward and that members get free standard shipping and 90-day returns.

- **Earning points.** The page says Skechers Plus rewards and cash back can be earned on the same eligible purchase.
- **Spending rewards.** The part of an order paid with loyalty rewards earns no cash back.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **Pickup.** The page mentions buying online and picking up in store. The cash back terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The page says the Skechers app gives new users bonus points. The terms do not mention the app. Whether an order finished in the app tracks is not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The page showed an online rate only. Skechers did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## When it shows up

The page says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "tomorrow", after the order is confirmed and out of pending status, and is paid every three months. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). For another shoe brand's terms, see [Rakuten at Nike](/rakuten-nike-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- Your order is over $500. It earns nothing.
- You are buying five or more of the same item, for a team or a workplace.
- You are ordering from outside the U.S.
- You plan to use the 20% email code. It may void the 3%, and 20% is the larger number.
- You are paying mostly with Skechers Plus rewards or a gift card.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Skechers?**
3% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Is there an order size limit?**
Yes. Orders greater than $500 and orders with five or more of the same item earn nothing.

**Do Skechers Plus points and Rakuten cash back stack?**
Earning both on one purchase is allowed. The part paid with loyalty rewards earns no cash back.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

- [Rakuten: In-store offers](https://www.rakuten.com/in-store)

Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Sonos. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Sonos page showed 2% cash back, with no raised rate. Gift cards, dealer orders and orders deemed for reselling earn nothing, and a coupon code not listed on Rakuten voids the cash back.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

| Item | What the page showed |
|---|---|
| Headline rate | 2% |
| Rakuten's "was" label | None |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's base rate. This page has none, so 2% is the plain rate. The page listed the store's Black Friday offer, up to 25% off, at the same 2%. Nothing on the page promises a higher rate on Black Friday (November 27, 2026).

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Sonos are short. Cash back is not available on:

- Dealer orders
- Orders placed through the dealer portal
- Orders deemed to be for reselling
- Gift cards

No product is excluded. Speakers, soundbars, headphones and accessories are not named as earning nothing.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| Speaker or soundbar ordered on the store's site after a Rakuten click | Yes, 2% |
| Sale-priced or bundled set | Not excluded in the terms |
| Gift card | No |

The terms say that using coupon codes not listed on Rakuten "will void" cash back, and to keep to codes Rakuten provides. Many store pages say "may void"; this one is firmer. On November 25, 2026, the offers Rakuten listed for this store were a sale, free shipping and a bundle price, with no code shown.

## Upgrade credits and status discounts

The page's question-and-answer section describes two of the store's own discounts:

- An upgrade program, with a credit of up to 30% for owners of an existing product, activated in the store account.
- Status discounts of 15% for students and frontline workers who qualify.

The cash back terms do not mention either one. Whether an upgrade credit or a status discount counts as a code "not listed on Rakuten" is not confirmed. Both are far larger than 2%, so the question matters: if one of them voids cash back, the discount is still the bigger number.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | At 2% |
|---|---|---|
| Portable speaker set (price on Rakuten's page, November 25, 2026) | $179.00 | $3.58 |

Taxes are not mentioned in the terms for this store. The page says shipping is free on any order.

The 2% is for orders on the brand's own site. The same products sold by other retailers fall under those retailers' Rakuten terms and rates. For one example, with a rate list by brand, see [Rakuten at Best Buy](/rakuten-best-buy-cash-back-how-it-works/). Rates on both pages change daily.

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "within one week". That is slower than the "tomorrow" shown on many store pages. Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You qualify for the 15% status discount or an upgrade credit. Either is worth more than 2%, and whether they combine with cash back is not confirmed.
- You have a code that is not on Rakuten. Using it voids the 2%.
- You are buying a gift card.

2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

No product is named. The exclusions are gift cards, dealer orders and reselling.

Only a code listed on Rakuten. The terms say other codes will void cash back.

# Can you stack Rakuten cash back with credit card points and store coupons?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/
Facts checked: 2026-11-24
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, you can stack Rakuten cash back with credit card rewards. The two come from different companies, so one purchase can earn both. Store coupons often work as well, but Rakuten says a code it did not list can void the cash back, and a second cash back site cannot be added on top.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## Why the layers are separate

Rakuten is paid by the store for sending you there, and shares part of that with you. Your card issuer pays rewards for the charge on the card. Rakuten does not require a particular card for online orders; any card works at checkout.

## What stacks and what does not

| Layer | Stacks with Rakuten? | Source and limits |
|---|---|---|
| Points or cash back from the credit card you pay with | Yes | The Points Guy: you still earn points or miles on the card you use |
| Card-linked offers such as Amex Offers and Chase Offers | Generally yes | The Points Guy; most depend only on the purchase total. Offers are targeted and have their own terms |
| The store's own sale prices | Yes | Rakuten's Black Friday and Cyber Monday pages |
| The store's loyalty program | Often | Rakuten says cash back can be layered on loyalty rewards; some stores exclude the part of an order paid with rewards |
| Coupon codes listed on Rakuten | Often | Rakuten: "Many coupons and promo codes can be used together with Rakuten Cash Back" |
| Coupon codes from other sites | Risky | Rakuten says codes not listed with it may void cash back |
| A second cash back site or extension | No | Rakuten says a click from another rewards site disables its cash back |
| Paying with a store gift card | Depends on the store | Some stores exclude purchases made with gift cards |

## A worked example

The rates below are made up to show the arithmetic. Real rates change daily and differ by store.

| Step | Amount |
|---|---|
| Order after the store's sale price and a coupon listed on Rakuten | $200.00 |
| Rakuten at an assumed 5% | $10.00 |
| Credit card at an assumed 2% | $4.00 |
| Total back | $14.00, or 7% |

Rakuten does not pay on tax or shipping, and its part arrives months later, on one of four payment dates; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## The coupon catch

This is the part most likely to go wrong. Rakuten's terms say that if you use coupons it did not provide, the purchase might be associated with another service, and you might not earn. Many store pages on Rakuten carry a line that codes not found on Rakuten may void cash back.

Each store's rules are behind "See all Terms & Exclusions" on its Rakuten page, and they differ. As read on November 24, 2026:

| Store | What its Rakuten page says |
|---|---|
| [Target](/rakuten-target-cash-back-how-it-works/) | A code not listed on Rakuten will void cash back |
| [Ulta](/rakuten-ulta-cash-back-how-it-works/) | A code not listed on Rakuten may void cash back; the part paid with Ulta rewards does not earn |
| [Kohl's](/rakuten-kohls-cash-back-how-it-works/) | The part paid with Kohl's Cash does not earn; orders paid with Apple Pay are excluded |
| [Macy's](/rakuten-macys-cash-back-how-it-works/) | One store promo code per order can be combined; the part paid with Star Dollars does not earn |

## Card offers

Amex Offers, Chase Offers and similar deals are added to a card in the issuer's app. They trigger on the charge itself, so they do not interfere with Rakuten's click tracking. The Points Guy reports that these can generally be combined with portal earnings.

One limit from Rakuten's side: if you choose Amex Membership Rewards points as your Rakuten payout, its terms say promotions with certain other US card issuers offered through Rakuten will not be available to you. See [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/).

## Steps that keep tracking intact

1. Start at Rakuten, or activate in the extension, before adding items to the cart.
2. Use only codes shown on Rakuten for that store.
3. Do not open another coupon or rewards site in between.
4. Check out in the same tab, with any card.
5. Look for the order in your Rakuten account within a couple of days. If it is missing, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a coupon from elsewhere that is worth more than the cash back. Take the larger one; trying for both can lose the smaller.
- You are paying with a store gift card at a store that excludes gift card purchases.
- You would buy something only because the stack looks large. A percentage back on a purchase you did not need is still a cost.

## Quick answers

**Do I need a special credit card to use Rakuten online?**
No. Any card works at checkout, and it earns its usual rewards.

**Will a coupon code cancel my Rakuten cash back?**
It can, if the code is not one listed on Rakuten for that store.

**Can I use Rakuten and another cash back site on one order?**
No. Rakuten says a click from another rewards site disables its cash back.

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Terms and conditions](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/terms-conditions)
- [Rakuten: Why didn't I earn cash back?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/why-didnt-i-earn-cash-back-360036367393)
- [Rakuten: Using the extension with other similar browser extensions](https://rakuten.com/help/article/using-the-cash-back-button-with-other-similar-browser-extensions-360001446948)
- [Rakuten: Black Friday](https://www.rakuten.com/black-friday)
- [Rakuten: Cyber Monday](https://www.rakuten.com/cyber-monday)
- [Rakuten: Membership Rewards points terms](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/american-express-membership-rewards-points-at-rakuten-terms-360017609913)
- [The Points Guy: Maximizing online shopping portals](https://thepointsguy.com/loyalty-programs/maximizing-online-shopping-portals)
- Rakuten store pages for [Target](https://www.rakuten.com/target.com), [Ulta](https://www.rakuten.com/ulta.com), [Kohl's](https://www.rakuten.com/kohls.com) and [Macy's](https://www.rakuten.com/macys.com)

# Rakuten Staples cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-staples-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Staples. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Staples page showed up to 6% cash back, marked "was 2%". Ink, toner and tech earn 2%, and computers, laptops, desktops, tablets, HP printers, e-readers and gift cards earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## Rates seen on November 25, 2026

| Rate | Category on Rakuten's list |
|---|---|
| 6% | All other non-excluded items |
| 2% | Ink and toner |
| 2% | Tech |
| 0% | Excluded items (see below) |

The headline carried a "was 2%" label. That label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's base rate, so 6% is a raised rate and can drop back. The page gives no end date. Which products Staples files under "Tech" is not defined on the page; not confirmed.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Staples list these as earning nothing:

- Gift cards
- Computers, laptops and desktops
- HP printers
- Tablets and iPads
- E-readers
- Furniture services
- Staples Business Advantage orders
- The part of a purchase paid with a gift card or Staples Rewards
- Orders Staples deems to be for reselling

Other printer brands are not named in the exclusions. Whether they earn 2% as tech or 6% as "all other" is not confirmed.

## Two rules that are easy to miss

- **Empty cart first.** The terms say cash back is not available on items placed in the Staples cart before clicking through from Rakuten. Items added earlier and left in the cart do not earn.
- **One order per trip.** Cash back is only available on one order per shopping trip. A second order after the same click does not earn. The terms do not say what starts a new trip; not confirmed.

## Coupon codes

The Staples terms on Rakuten have no rule about coupon codes. Rakuten's page listed several Staples codes on November 25, 2026, including offers on chairs, stamps and signs. Whether a code from outside Rakuten affects cash back at this store is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

| Purchase | Price | Rate seen | Cash back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Copy paper and office supplies | $100 | 6% | $6.00 |
| Ink or toner | $100 | 2% | $2.00 |
| Laptop | $700 | Excluded | $0 |
| Supplies paid half with Staples Rewards | $100 | 6% on $50 | $3.00 |

Taxes and shipping are not mentioned in the Staples terms.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **Pickup.** The terms do not mention store pickup. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the Staples app. Not confirmed.
- **In stores.** The Staples page showed an online rate only. Staples did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

Rakuten's page describes Staples Rewards as paying 5% back in rewards on in-store purchases. That is the store's own program. Spending those rewards cuts the amount that earns cash back.

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "in a few days". Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If an order does not appear, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/). For computers and tablets, other stores' rules are in [Rakuten at Best Buy](/rakuten-best-buy-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- You are buying a computer, tablet, e-reader, HP printer or gift card. They earn nothing.
- Your items were already in the Staples cart before the click from Rakuten.
- You order through Staples Business Advantage.
- You are paying most of the order with Staples Rewards or a gift card.
- You are buying only ink or toner and expect 6%. Those earn 2%.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Staples?**
Up to 6% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%. Ink, toner and tech earn 2%. Rates change daily.

**Do laptops and tablets earn cash back at Staples?**
No. Computers, laptops, desktops, tablets, iPads, e-readers and HP printers are on the excluded list.

**Does it matter when items go in the cart?**
Yes. The terms say items placed in the Staples cart before clicking through from Rakuten do not earn.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Staples store page](https://www.rakuten.com/staples.com)
- [Rakuten: In-store offers](https://www.rakuten.com/in-store)

# Rakuten StubHub cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-stubhub-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at StubHub. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's StubHub page showed 7% cash back, marked "was 2%". Buying or redeeming gift cards and orders completed by ticket brokers earn nothing, and the terms say a coupon code not listed on Rakuten will void cash back.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 25, 2026 | 7% | Was 2% |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. Here it points to 2% as the usual figure. The page does not say when the 7% ends. No category table appears, so sports, concerts, theater and festivals are not given separate rates.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| Tickets bought on StubHub after a Rakuten click | Yes, 7% on the day checked |
| Buying a StubHub gift card | No |
| An order paid by redeeming a gift card | No |
| Orders completed by ticket brokers | No |
| An order using a code not listed on Rakuten | No; the terms say it will void cash back |

The terms do not say how a buyer is judged to be a ticket broker. Not confirmed.

The terms also do not say whether cash back is figured on the ticket price alone or on the total including StubHub's fees. Not confirmed.

## Coupon codes: the firm wording

Many store pages say outside codes "may void" cash back. StubHub's terms say use of codes not listed on Rakuten "will void" it. On November 25, 2026, the offers on Rakuten's StubHub page were links to ticket categories, such as music festivals, MLS and Formula 1. No code was listed.

## You wait until after the event

This is the main difference from a store purchase. The special terms say cash back is added to the Rakuten account within a week after the event.

The posting line on the same page reads slightly differently: within a week after "travel" has been completed. StubHub sells tickets, not travel, so the two lines appear to mean the same thing: the clock starts at the event date, not the purchase date.

| Ticket bought | Event date | Earliest cash back would show |
|---|---|---|
| November 25, 2026 | December 5, 2026 | Within a week after December 5 |
| November 25, 2026 | June 15, 2027 | Within a week after June 15, 2027 |

After that, payment follows Rakuten's usual schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Canceled events and resold tickets

Rakuten's page describes StubHub's FanProtect Guarantee: if an event is canceled and not rescheduled, StubHub gives a refund or a credit toward a later purchase. The cash back terms do not cover that case. Rakuten's help page says a canceled or returned order is no longer eligible. Whether an order paid with a StubHub credit earns is not confirmed.

Whether cash back stays in place when the buyer later resells the ticket on StubHub is not stated. Not confirmed.

## App and stores

- **App.** The terms do not mention the StubHub app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension. Whether an order finished in the StubHub app tracks is not confirmed.
- **In stores.** StubHub is an online marketplace, and the page showed an online rate only.

## What it comes to

Worked examples at the rates seen, not prices from the page.

| Order | Amount that counts | At 7% | At the 2% "was" rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two tickets | $200 | $14.00 | $4.00 |
| Four tickets | $600 | $42.00 | $12.00 |
| A gift card | Any | $0 | $0 |

Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/). One card carries its own StubHub credit, covered in [the Sapphire Reserve StubHub credit](/chase-sapphire-reserve-stubhub-credit-how-it-works/). Whether that credit and Rakuten cash back apply to the same order is not confirmed.

## Who should skip it

- You have a StubHub code from outside Rakuten. Using it voids the cash back.
- You are buying or paying with a gift card.
- You buy tickets as a broker.
- The event is many months away and you want the money soon.
- You tend to finish the purchase in another tab or app. Tracking is tied to the tab Rakuten opened.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at StubHub?**
7% on November 25, 2026, marked "was 2%". Rates change daily.

**When does StubHub cash back show up?**
Within a week after the event, according to the terms. Not at purchase.

**Can you use a StubHub promo code and still get cash back?**
Only a code listed on Rakuten. The terms say other codes will void cash back.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

# Can you stack Rakuten cash back with Target Circle offers and the Target Circle Card 5%?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-target-circle-card-stack/
Facts checked: 2026-11-23
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, in most cases. Rakuten's terms for Target do not exclude paying with a Target Circle Card, and Rakuten's own Target page describes combining Target Circle offers, a rewards card and cash back on one order. The limits are that only some categories earn the 1% seen on November 23, 2026, a coupon code not listed on Rakuten voids the cash back, and Drive Up orders earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily. Which categories earn is covered in [Rakuten cash back at Target](/rakuten-target-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## What stacks and what does not

| Piece | Stacks with Rakuten cash back? | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Card 5% discount | Yes; not excluded | Rakuten's Target terms and page text; Target's Circle Card page |
| Automatic Target Circle deals | Described by Rakuten as combinable | Rakuten's Target page; not addressed in its terms |
| Coupon or promo code not listed on Rakuten | No; voids the cash back | Rakuten's Target terms |
| Target Circle 360 membership fee | Earns nothing | Rakuten's Target terms |
| Buying gift cards | Earns nothing | Rakuten's Target terms |
| Paying with a Target gift card | Not confirmed | Terms are silent |
| Drive Up | Earns nothing | Rakuten's Target terms |
| Order Pickup inside the store | Not confirmed | Terms are silent |

## The Circle Card 5%

Target says the card takes 5% off at checkout in stores and on Target.com, and that it comes "on top of your Target Circle deals" (Target's Circle Card page). Target's help page adds three rules:

- The 5% is worked out after other discounts are taken off.
- If you split payment, it applies only to the amount put on the Circle Card.
- It does not apply to Target gift cards, prescriptions, Circle 360 fees, taxes or shipping.

Rakuten's terms for Target do not mention the card. Rakuten's page text says paying with a rewards card can be combined with cash back, and its shopping tips say the card discount still applies alongside coupons.

**Not confirmed:** whether Rakuten counts its 1% on the price before or after the 5% comes off.

## Target Circle deals

Target's help pages say most Circle deals apply automatically at checkout when you are signed in. Each item can take one item-level deal and one category-level deal. Circle Bonuses are different: they must be activated first.

Rakuten's rule is about coupon codes: one not listed on Rakuten voids the cash back. An automatic Circle deal is not typed in as a code, and Rakuten's page describes using Target's offers together with cash back. Its terms do not say this in so many words, so treat it as likely rather than guaranteed.

"Target Circle Earnings" is on Rakuten's excluded list. Target's name for what members earn is Target Circle Rewards. Whether the exclusion means the part of an order paid with those rewards is not confirmed.

## Circle 360

Circle 360 is Target's paid membership: $99 a year, or $49 a year with a Circle Card saved to the account. Rakuten's terms list it as excluded, so the fee earns no cash back. Target excludes the fee from the 5% as well. Whether an order sent by Circle 360 same-day delivery earns is not confirmed; the terms name Drive Up only.

## Gift cards as payment

- Buying a Target gift card through Rakuten earns nothing.
- If an order comes with a free Target gift card, Rakuten reduces the amount that earns by the card's value.
- Rakuten's terms for some other stores exclude purchases paid with gift cards. The Target terms do not say either way.
- The Circle Card 5% covers only the part charged to the card, so a part paid by gift card gets no 5%.

More in [gift cards and Rakuten](/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/).

## Pickup, Drive Up and the app

Drive Up items and orders are excluded. Order Pickup at the counter is not mentioned. The Target app is not mentioned either; Rakuten's general rule is that an order earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, its app or its extension. See [app or browser extension](/rakuten-app-vs-browser-extension/).

## What it comes to

A $200 order of furniture or apparel, no coupon code, paid on a Circle Card:

| Piece | Amount |
|---|---|
| Circle Card 5% | $10.00 off |
| Rakuten at 1% | $1.90 to $2.00, paid later |
| Total | About $12 |

The range reflects the open question of which price Rakuten counts. The same $200 spent on groceries or electronics gets the $10 and no cash back. A coupon code worth more than 1% saves more than the cash back it voids. Bank card rewards do not come on top here, because the 5% needs the Circle Card as payment; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You buy mostly groceries, household goods, toys or electronics at Target. Those earn nothing through Rakuten.
- You rely on Drive Up. Those orders are excluded.
- You have a promo code not listed on Rakuten that is worth more than 1%.
- You mainly pay with Target gift cards. Whether that part earns is not confirmed, and it gets no 5%.

## Quick answers

**Does the Circle Card 5% cancel Rakuten cash back?**
No. Rakuten's Target terms do not exclude it, and Rakuten's page describes paying by card alongside cash back.

**Do Target Circle deals void Rakuten cash back?**
Rakuten's terms void cash back for coupon codes not listed on Rakuten. Automatic Circle deals are not named.

**Does a Circle 360 membership earn cash back?**
No. Target Circle 360 is on Rakuten's excluded list for Target.

Yes, on Temu's website only. On November 24, 2026, Rakuten's Temu page showed 2% cash back, paid on orders up to a maximum cart size of $250. Orders placed in the Temu app, phones, tablets, laptops and any order with items put in the cart before clicking through Rakuten are excluded.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate and the limits seen on November 24, 2026

| Point | What Rakuten's Temu page showed |
|---|---|
| Rate | 2% |
| "Was" label (the usual rate) | None shown |
| Category tiers | None |
| Maximum cart size | $250 |
| Maximum cash back on a single purchase | $50 |
| Delivery address | United States only, not U.S. territories |
| Posting | Added to the Rakuten account "today" |

Rakuten's Temu Black Friday page showed the same 2% on the same day. A Rakuten blog post dated March 5, 2026 says the Temu rate varies. What it will be later this week is not confirmed.

## The two caps

The terms say cash back is paid "on orders up to a maximum cart size of $250 USD" with at most $50 on a single purchase.

At 2%, a $250 cart earns $5.00. So at this rate the cart limit is the one that binds, and the $50 limit is out of reach. The $50 limit would only matter at a rate above 20%.

What happens to a cart over $250 is not spelled out. Whether it earns on the first $250 or earns nothing is not confirmed.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Temu list these as earning nothing:

- Phones, tablets and laptops
- Orders placed using the Temu app
- Orders that start from clicking through a promotional email
- Any items in the shopping cart before clicking through Rakuten
- Orders where items are added after checkout
- Purchases made on a mobile device using Cash App Pay
- Items bought using One Click Pay
- The portion of an order paid with store credit
- Price adjusted orders
- Purchases made for resale or wholesale

Several of these are about how the order is placed, not what is in it. The page's FAQ repeats two of them: app orders do not earn, and items cannot be in the cart before the click.

## The order of steps the terms require

1. Start with an empty Temu cart.
2. Click through from Rakuten to Temu's website, not the app.
3. Add items, then check out in the same visit, without One Click Pay.
4. Do not add items to the order after checkout.

A Temu marketing email opened between steps 2 and 3 starts a different visit. The terms exclude orders that originate from a promotional email.

## Coupon codes and new-user offers

The Temu page has its own rule here: codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. On most store pages that warning appears only on Rakuten's general help page. Rakuten's Temu page listed several codes on November 24, 2026, and the page says its listed codes can be combined with cash back.

The terms add that each user may take part in only one new-user promotion, and that the offer cannot be combined with other new-user offers. Which offer "this offer" refers to is not clear from the page. Not confirmed.

## Other terms

- **Store credit.** The part of an order paid with Temu credit does not earn. Rakuten's page notes that Temu gives credit for some late deliveries and as a faster refund choice on returns.
- **Returns.** No store rule is listed. Rakuten's general help page says returned and canceled items lose their cash back.
- **Missing cash back.** No store deadline is given. Rakuten's general terms allow 90 days from the transaction. See [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).
- **Shipping.** Rakuten's page says Temu offers free shipping on orders shipped from Temu.
- **Rakuten app.** The terms exclude the Temu app. Whether a click from the Rakuten app that opens Temu's mobile website counts is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

| Order | Price | Rate | Cash back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kitchen and storage items | $35 | 2% | $0.70 |
| Office chair | $52 | 2% | $1.04 |
| Mixed cart at the limit | $250 | 2% | $5.00 |
| Cart over the limit | $400 | Not confirmed | Not confirmed |
| Same $35 cart, placed in the Temu app | $35 | 0% | $0 |
| Tablet or laptop | Any | 0% | $0 |

Taxes and shipping do not count.

## Other marketplaces on the same day

Rakuten's Etsy page showed 1% with almost no exclusions: see [Rakuten at Etsy](/rakuten-etsy-cash-back-how-it-works/). For a marketplace with a different kind of offer, see [whether Rakuten works on Amazon](/does-rakuten-work-on-amazon/).

## When you get the money

Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You shop in the Temu app. App orders do not earn.
- You are buying a phone, tablet or laptop.
- Your cart is well over $250.
- You have a code from outside Rakuten that saves more than 2%.
- You pay mostly with Temu credit, or with Cash App Pay on a phone.
- The order ships to a U.S. territory or outside the United States.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Temu?**
2% on November 24, 2026, on orders up to a $250 cart. Rates change daily.

**Do Temu app orders earn Rakuten cash back?**
No. Rakuten's terms exclude orders placed using the Temu app. The order must be completed on Temu's website.

**Can a Temu coupon code be used with Rakuten?**
Codes listed on Rakuten can. Rakuten's terms say codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two. [Welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus](/rakuten-welcome-bonus-vs-referral-bonus/) compares the two offers as read on November 26, 2026.

# Rakuten TurboTax cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-turbotax-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, but only on paid online federal filings. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's TurboTax page showed 5% cash back on three kinds of online federal filing. State filings, free filings and downloadable or CD software earn nothing, and the return must be filed within 7 days of the click.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## Rates seen on November 25, 2026

| Rate | Product on Rakuten's list |
|---|---|
| 5% | Do It Yourself Deluxe and Premium online federal filings |
| 5% | Experts online federal filings (Assisted and Full Service) |
| 5% | Experts for Business online federal filings |
| 0% | Everything in the exclusions below |

No "was" label appeared, so 5% was not marked as a raised rate. This was read in November, outside the main filing season. The page does not say what the rate will be in early 2027; not confirmed.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for TurboTax list these as earning nothing:

- Free filings
- State filings
- Audit defense
- E-filing directly to the IRS
- Bank products
- The refund transfer fee
- Max benefits
- CDs and downloadable software

The terms add that "rebates are not offered on any other products or services", and that cash back is only for orders completed through the U.S. site.

## The 7-day rule

Three conditions in the special terms set the timing:

- Click through Rakuten before paying.
- After the click, there are 7 days to file to receive cash back.
- Cash back is processed once a federal tax return is filed.

A return started through Rakuten in January and filed in April is outside the 7 days. The terms do not say whether a second click through Rakuten shortly before paying and filing restarts the 7 days. The first condition points that way, but it is not confirmed.

## What it comes to

The federal filing fee is the only part that earns. TurboTax prices change through the season, so the fees below are placeholders for the sums, not quoted prices.

| Part of the bill | Example fee | Cash back |
|---|---|---|
| Online federal filing, paid tier | $80 | $4.00 |
| State filing | $60 | $0 |
| Audit defense add-on | $50 | $0 |
| Fee to pay from the refund | Any | $0 |
| **Total** | **$190** | **$4.00** |

On that example, 5% of the federal fee comes to about 2% of the whole bill.

## Paying from the refund

The exclusions name bank products and the refund transfer fee. Those are tied to paying the filing fees out of the refund. The terms say the fee itself earns nothing. Whether choosing that payment method also affects cash back on the federal filing is not confirmed.

## Coupon codes and other discounts

The TurboTax terms on Rakuten have no rule about coupon codes. On November 25, 2026, the page listed two offers, neither with a code. Whether a discount from a bank, employer or another partner link can be combined with a Rakuten click is not confirmed.

## App, desktop and stores

- **Mobile app.** Rakuten's page describes the TurboTax mobile app. The terms do not mention it. Whether a return filed in the app tracks is not confirmed.
- **Desktop software.** CDs and downloads are excluded, wherever they are bought.
- **In stores.** There is no in-store offer on the page.

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "within one week". Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If it does not appear, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/). How cash back is treated for tax is in [is Rakuten cash back taxable](/is-rakuten-cash-back-taxable/).

## Who should skip it

- Your return qualifies for the free edition. Free filings earn nothing.
- You use the downloaded or CD version.
- You start early and file weeks later. The 7 days will have passed.
- You have a discount through another link that takes more than 5% off the federal fee.
- Most of your bill is state filings and add-ons. Those earn nothing.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at TurboTax?**
5% on November 25, 2026, on paid online federal filings. Rates change daily.

**Does the state return earn cash back?**
No. State filings are excluded, along with free filings and audit defense.

**How long after the click can the return be filed?**
The terms give 7 days from the click. Cash back is processed once the federal return is filed.

Menu prices and fees differ between apps, so $1.20 back does not make one app cheaper than the other. No ride service was found with a live Rakuten rate that day; a full search of Rakuten's store list was not possible, so this is not confirmed.

## What works instead: Uber Cash from a card

Two American Express cards put Uber Cash into the cardholder's Uber account. It can be spent on rides and Uber Eats orders in the US.

| Card | Uber Cash | How it arrives | Yearly total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Amex Platinum | $15 a month, plus $20 more in December | Monthly, in the Uber app | $200 |
| Amex Gold | $10 a month | Monthly, in the Uber app | $120 |

The limits, from Uber's terms for the Platinum benefit:

- Unused Uber Cash expires at the end of each calendar month. Nothing rolls over.
- An American Express card must be the selected payment method on the ride or order.
- It works only in the United States.
- A card added through Apple Pay or PayPal does not qualify.

Used in 6 months of the year, not counting December, the Platinum benefit comes to $90, not $200. The full sums are in [the Amex Platinum Uber credit](/amex-platinum-uber-credit-worth-it/).

The Platinum Card also refunds up to $120 a calendar year of Uber One membership fees. Uber One is priced at $9.99 a month or $96 a year, according to The Points Guy.

## Other routes

- **Card rewards.** A card pays its usual travel, dining or everyday rate on an Uber charge with or without Rakuten. See [stacking Rakuten with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).
- **Gift cards.** Giftcards.com showed 3% on Rakuten on November 26, 2026, marked "was 1%". Its terms exclude the Giftcards.com eGift card, Mastercard gift cards and purchases over $2,000. Whether it sells Uber gift cards, and whether they earn the 3%, is not confirmed. More in [Rakuten and gift cards](/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/).
- **Rakuten Dining.** This card-linked program pays when a linked card is used at a participating restaurant. Whether an Uber Eats order from one of those restaurants counts is not confirmed.

## Who should skip it

- You are opening Rakuten or its extension before booking a ride. There is no Uber offer to activate.
- You hold neither Amex card. The Uber Cash is a card benefit and cannot be bought into through Rakuten.
- You use Uber only a few times a year. Monthly Uber Cash that expires is worth little in months with no ride or order.
- You are outside the US. The Amex Uber Cash works only in the United States.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten pay cash back on Uber rides?**
No. On November 26, 2026, Rakuten's Uber address said the store is no longer available.

**Does Rakuten pay cash back on Uber Eats?**
No. The Uber Eats address showed the same notice and no rate.

**What can lower an Uber bill instead?**
Card benefits. The Amex Platinum adds $15 of Uber Cash a month, which expires monthly.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

# Rakuten Ulta cash back: does Rakuten work at Ulta, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-ulta-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten works at Ulta Beauty: 12% cash back on November 26, 2026, the day before Black Friday, raised from a usual 2%. Dior products, Marketplace items, gift cards and the part of an order paid with Ulta rewards earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check Ulta's page on Rakuten on the day you shop. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

| Date read | Rate shown on Rakuten's Ulta page |
|---|---|
| November 24, 2026 | 2% |
| November 25, 2026 | 2% |
| November 26, 2026 | 12% (was 2%) |

Ulta showed one rate across the store, with no category rates. "Was" is Rakuten's own label for the usual rate, and the page carried a banner tying the 12% rate to Black Friday. A raised rate can end without notice. How long 12% lasts, and what the rate will be on Black Friday itself or on Cyber Monday, is not confirmed; see [Black Friday on Rakuten](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/) and [Cyber Monday on Rakuten](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/).

| Order | At the usual 2% | At 12% |
|---|---|---|
| $40 | $0.80 | $4.80 |
| $75 | $1.50 | $9.00 |
| $150 | $3.00 | $18.00 |

The other large beauty listing is covered in [Rakuten at Sephora](/rakuten-sephora-cash-back-how-it-works/), and Sephora shops inside another chain in [Rakuten at Kohl's](/rakuten-kohls-cash-back-how-it-works/).

The listing says cash back is added to the Rakuten account in a few days.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Ulta, as read on November 26, 2026:

| Excluded | What it means in practice |
|---|---|
| Dior products | A Dior item in the cart earns nothing; the other items still count |
| Marketplace items | Items sold through Ulta's Marketplace by other sellers |
| Part paid with Rewards or Rewards Discount | Ulta points used at checkout reduce the amount that earns |
| Gift cards, including e-gift cards | Buying one earns nothing; see [gift cards and Rakuten](/rakuten-gift-cards-cash-back/) |
| Coupon codes not listed on Rakuten | May void the cash back |

The gift card line is firm. Rakuten's terms say: "Purchases of any gift card including e-gift cards are not eligible for Cash Back."

Salon and other services are not mentioned in the terms read. Services are booked and paid in the store, and the page showed no in-store Ulta offer on November 26, so cash back on them is not confirmed. How linked-card offers work at other stores is in [in-store cash back](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Paying with Ulta points

Redeeming Ulta rewards does not cancel the cash back. It shrinks the base.

| $100 order | Paid with Ulta rewards | Earns Rakuten on | At 2% | At 12% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| No rewards used | $0 | $100 | $2.00 | $12.00 |
| $17.50 in rewards used | $17.50 | $82.50 | $1.65 | $9.90 |

Rakuten's page describes Ulta's program as one point for every $1 spent, with Platinum status at $450 and Diamond at $1,200 in a calendar year. Whether an order tracked by Rakuten still earns those points is not stated there. Ulta issues the points itself, so nothing in Rakuten's terms prevents it. It is not confirmed.

## Coupons

Ulta's terms on Rakuten say codes not listed on Rakuten may void it, and Rakuten's advice is to use the codes it provides. The page's FAQ adds that Ulta allows one store coupon per order, and that this one coupon can be combined with cash back, sale prices and redeemed points. The deals listed on November 26 were brand sales, such as 30% off Urban Decay and 50% off select Origins skincare, not codes.

So there is a choice to weigh, and the raised rate changes the sums:

| $60 order | Saving at the usual 2% | Saving at 12% |
|---|---|---|
| Outside coupon for $10 off, cash back at risk | $10.00 | $10.00 |
| No outside coupon, cash back kept | $1.20 | $7.20 |

At 2% the $10 coupon is worth far more. At 12% the gap is smaller, and on a $90 order the cash back, $10.80, passes the coupon.

## How to keep the order eligible

Rakuten's help pages give the same steps for every store, set out in full in [how Rakuten works, step by step](/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/):

- Activate cash back before adding anything to the cart.
- Check out in the same window that opened from Rakuten.
- Turn off ad blockers and other coupon or rewards extensions while you shop.

If nothing shows up after a couple of days, see [what to do about missing cash back](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/). On a phone, the choice between the app and the Safari extension is covered in [app versus extension](/rakuten-app-vs-browser-extension/).

Cash back also comes on top of what your credit card earns; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You have a coupon from another source that beats the cash back rate that day.
- Your order is mostly Dior or Marketplace items.
- You are paying mostly with Ulta rewards.
- You are buying a gift card.
- You shop at the counter in the store. This listing is for online orders.

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten work at Ulta?**
Yes. Ulta showed 12% on November 26, 2026, against a usual 2%. Rates change daily.

**Which brands are excluded at Ulta?**
Dior was the only brand named in the terms read. Marketplace items are also excluded.

**Do Ulta gift cards earn cash back?**
No. The terms exclude any gift card, including e-gift cards.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two; [how the sign-up and referral bonuses work](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/) sets out both offers.

Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Under Armour page showed 10% cash back, raised from a base of 2%. The biggest exclusion is coupon codes: an order using any code not listed on Rakuten earns nothing, and gift cards and orders shipped outside the United States are excluded too.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Under Armour list these as earning nothing:

# Rakuten Verizon cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-verizon-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, but only for certain orders. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Verizon page showed up to $150 cash back, marked "was $75", paid as a flat amount per order for new phone service. Upgrades, bring-your-own-device orders, prepaid service, accessories and orders placed by phone or chat earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## Amounts seen on November 25, 2026

Verizon pays flat dollar amounts on Rakuten, not a percentage.

| Order type | Cash back shown |
|---|---|
| New service (phone plans) | $150 |
| VerizonONE (new mobile plus home activation) | $75 |
| Add-a-line activations | $50 |
| 5G Home | $45 |

The headline carried a "was $75" label, which Rakuten shows when an offer has been raised. The page does not say which lines were raised or when the raised amount ends. Not confirmed.

The terms say cash back amounts are per order. Read plainly, an order that opens several new lines earns the amount once, not once per line. How Verizon counts an order with more than one type of activation is not confirmed.

One oddity in the table: a new phone plan alone is shown at $150, and VerizonONE, which the terms describe as new mobile plus home, is shown at $75. The page does not explain the difference.

## Who qualifies

The special terms say cash back is available to:

- New customers
- Add-a-line orders
- 5G Home
- VerizonONE, described as a new mobile plus home activation

An existing customer can earn on an added line or on 5G Home. An existing customer replacing a phone on the same line cannot; that is a contract renewal, which is excluded.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Verizon list these as earning nothing:

- Business orders made through Verizon Business Markets
- Bring Your Own Device
- Contract renewals (upgrades)
- Prepaid services
- Accessories
- Gaming products, such as controllers, consoles and gaming headsets
- Subscription services
- Orders placed by phone or chat
- Gift cards

Because the amounts are flat and tied to activations, buying a phone case or a pair of earbuds through the link earns nothing, whatever the price.

## Payment must be processed first

The terms add a condition: cash back is earned only after the merchant has confirmed that the order payment has been processed. The page does not say what counts as processed for a phone paid in monthly installments. Not confirmed.

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "within a few weeks", which is slower than the same-day or next-day posting shown for many stores. Payment then follows Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Coupon codes, trade-ins and Verizon's own offers

The Verizon terms have no line about coupon codes. Rakuten's general help page says codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back at any store. On November 25, 2026, the offers on Rakuten's Verizon page were links to Verizon promotions, such as a phone offered with a watch and tablet, and four lines at $25 a line on one plan. No code was listed.

The page also describes Verizon's trade-in program and switching offers. The terms do not say whether a trade-in or a switching credit affects cash back. Not confirmed.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **Pickup.** The page says Verizon offers free in-store pickup. The cash back terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The page describes the Verizon app for managing an account. The terms do not mention it. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension.
- **Phone or chat.** Excluded by name. An order started online and finished with a Verizon agent by chat would fall under this line.
- **In stores.** The Verizon page showed an online offer only. Verizon did not appear in the part of Rakuten's in-store offer list that loaded on November 25, 2026; the list does not load in full, so this is not confirmed. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## Who should skip it

- You are upgrading a phone on a line you already have. Upgrades earn nothing.
- You are bringing your own phone to Verizon.
- You want prepaid service.
- You are buying only accessories or gaming gear.
- You expect to finish the order by phone or chat with an agent.
- You are buying for a business through Verizon Business Markets.

## Quick answers

**How much does Rakuten pay at Verizon?**
Up to $150 per order on November 25, 2026, for new phone service. Add-a-line was $50 and 5G Home $45.

**Do phone upgrades earn Rakuten cash back at Verizon?**
No. Contract renewals, which the terms call upgrades, are on the excluded list.

**Do accessories earn cash back at Verizon?**
No. Accessories and gaming products are excluded, and the offer pays flat amounts for activations.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).
