# Rakuten Viator cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-viator-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Viator page showed 11% cash back, with a "was 2%" label. Cash back is paid on completed tours only, and theme park purchases, virtual tours, gift vouchers and bookings made with a discount code or card-linked offer earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

The page showed 11% with a "was 2%" label and no rate by category. A "was" label means the rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. The page does not say how long 11% lasts, and nothing on it promises this rate on Black Friday (November 27, 2026) or after.

The exclusions say cash back is not available if discount codes are used. The special terms say codes not listed on Rakuten "may void" cash back, which reads as if a code listed on Rakuten is allowed. ## In stores

## Who should skip it

- You book in the Viator app. App-to-app sales are not eligible.
- You have a discount code, a student or staff code, or a card-linked offer that saves more than the cash back.
- You are buying theme park tickets, a virtual tour or a gift voucher.
- You tend to cancel and rebook the same tour. A canceled tour earns nothing, and the rebooking rule can void the new booking too.
- You want the money soon. Nothing posts until after the travel date.

## Quick answers

11% on November 25, 2026, with a "was 2%" label. Rates change daily.

**When does Viator cash back post?**
Within a couple of weeks after the travel is completed, not after booking.

**Do bookings in the Viator app earn cash back?**
The terms say purchases must be made through viator.com and that app-to-app sales are not eligible.

- **Returns.** Rakuten's general help page says returned or canceled orders do not earn cash back.

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "today". Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule of four dates a year; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Who should skip it

- You have an app-only deal or an emailed code that is not on Rakuten and it saves more than 2%.
- You are buying gift cards.
- You are ordering from outside the US site.
- The item is sold by a third party.
- You are waiting for a raised rate. None was shown, and none is promised.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Victoria's Secret?**
2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Do Pink items earn cash back?**
The Pink offers on the page carried the 2% rate. The terms do not exclude Pink.

**Do gift cards earn cash back at Victoria's Secret?**
No. The terms list gift cards as earning nothing.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

# Rakuten Vrbo cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-vrbo-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back on Vrbo bookings. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Vrbo page showed 3% cash back, marked "was 1%". Bookings below $20, listing renewals and refer-a-friend coupon codes that start with "RAF" are excluded, and the cash back is added only after the trip has been completed.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate seen on November 25, 2026

| Item | What Rakuten's Vrbo page showed |
|---|---|
| Rate | 3% |
| "Was" label | 1% |
| Category rates | None listed |
| Coupon listings | Six deals, all at the same 3% |

A "was" label means the rate has been raised above the store's usual rate. The page does not say how long 3% will last. One of the listed deals is for Black Friday, but nothing on the page promises a different rate on that day.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's terms for Vrbo are short. They list three things that earn nothing:

| Earns nothing | Note |
|---|---|
| Bookings below $20 | A minimum booking size |
| Listing renewals | This is a fee owners pay, not a guest booking |
| Refer-a-friend coupon codes that start with "RAF" | A booking made with one of these codes |

The terms do not mention gift cards, taxes or the Vrbo app. Rakuten's general help page says taxes and shipping fees never earn cash back. Whether cleaning fees, service fees or a damage deposit count toward the 3% is not confirmed.

## The stay has to be completed first

The posting line on the page says cash back will be added to the Rakuten account within a month after travel has been completed. Other store pages read the same day gave a posting time of a day or a week.

In practice this means:

- A stay booked in November for July shows nothing as earned until after the July trip.
- Rakuten's general help page says canceled orders do not earn cash back. A canceled booking would be treated the same way.
- Whether a pending amount shows in the account between booking and travel is not confirmed.

Payment then follows Rakuten's normal schedule, every three months; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## One Key and OneKeyCash

Rakuten's page describes One Key, the rewards program shared by Vrbo, Expedia and Hotels.com, where members earn and redeem OneKeyCash on eligible bookings. The cash back terms do not mention One Key. Whether the part of a booking paid with OneKeyCash earns cash back is not confirmed.

For the two other brands in that program, see [Rakuten at Expedia and Booking.com](/rakuten-expedia-booking-com-cash-back/) and [cash back on hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/).

## Coupon codes and the app

- **Coupon codes.** The only code rule in the Vrbo terms is the "RAF" one. Rakuten's general help page says coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the Vrbo app. Rakuten's help page says a purchase is tracked from a click through Rakuten and should be finished in the tab that opened. Whether a booking finished in the Vrbo app tracks is not confirmed.
- **Other reward sites.** The help page says visiting other reward or coupon sites during the session can void cash back.

## What it comes to

These are sums at the rate seen, not prices from the page.

| Booking | Amount that earns | At 3% | At the 1% "was" rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Weekend cabin | $600 | $18.00 | $6.00 |
| Week at a beach house | $2,500 | $75.00 | $25.00 |
| Booking below $20 | Any | $0 | $0 |

Card rewards are earned separately from the card issuer; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You are booking with a refer-a-friend code that starts with "RAF". That booking earns nothing.
- You are a property owner paying for a listing renewal.
- You need the money soon. Nothing is added until after the stay, and payment comes after that.
- Your plans may change. A canceled booking does not earn.
- You plan to book inside the Vrbo app. Tracking there is not confirmed.

If cash back did not appear a month after the trip, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Vrbo?**
3% on November 25, 2026, shown as raised from 1%. Rates change daily.

**When does Vrbo cash back show up?**
The page says within a month after travel has been completed, not at booking.

**Does a Vrbo refer-a-friend code earn cash back?**
No. Codes that start with "RAF" are on the excluded list.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

# Rakuten or Capital One Shopping: how do they differ, and can you use both?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-vs-capital-one-shopping/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Rakuten pays cash back by check or PayPal (or as points) four times a year, while Capital One Shopping pays Shopping Rewards that you redeem for e-gift cards. You can hold both accounts, but only one of them can track a given purchase, and both companies say to turn off other rewards extensions.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## The main differences

| | Rakuten | Capital One Shopping |
|---|---|---|
| Cost to join | Free | Free |
| Card or bank account needed | No | No; a Capital One account may be asked for to verify a redemption |
| What you earn | Cash back, or Amex or Bilt points | Shopping Rewards, which have no cash value |
| How you are paid | Check, PayPal or points on four set dates | E-gift cards from select stores, on request |
| Minimum | About $5 confirmed | Not confirmed |
| Typical wait | 3 to 14 weeks to confirm, then the next payment date | 30 to 90 days to post, by two travel sites' accounts |
| Extra tools | Coupons, in-store offers | Coupon search, price comparison, price-drop alerts |

Capital One Shopping's rewards are separate from any Capital One card rewards.

## How each one pays

Rakuten sends confirmed cash back on February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). Members with an eligible American Express card can take Membership Rewards points in place of cash; see [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/).

Capital One Shopping's help page describes its rewards this way: they are "not equivalent to money and do not have a cash value." You spend them on e-gift cards on its redemption page. The cards arrive by email within 24 to 72 business hours and cannot be refunded or exchanged. The help page lists no PayPal or bank payout. AwardWallet reports that the rewards do not expire while the account is open and in good standing.

So the question is partly what form of payment is useful to you. A gift card to a store you already use is close to cash. A gift card to a store you do not use is not.

## Which pays more?

Neither does at every store. Rates at both change often, and both personalize them. Rakuten's terms say the rate one member sees may differ from another's. AwardWallet's writer saw one store listed at up to 1% on Capital One Shopping when logged out and up to 8% in a logged-in promotion.

The only reliable method is to compare the two on the day you buy, for the exact store.

## Can you use both?

You can have both accounts. You cannot be credited by both for one order.

- Rakuten's help center says that clicking a link from another coupon or rewards site after you activate Rakuten will disable its cash back. It asks members to disable or uninstall competing extensions.
- Capital One Shopping's help page says to disable other shopping extensions before activating. It adds that if another program interferes, it cannot confirm the purchase or adjust rewards afterward.

In affiliate tracking a store generally credits one referrer per order. Exactly which of these two extensions wins when both are active is not confirmed, so running both at checkout risks earning from neither.

A practical way to hold both:

1. Compare the two rates before you shop.
2. Activate only the one you chose, before adding items to the cart.
3. Leave the other switched off in your browser until the order is placed.

## Data

Both extensions watch your shopping activity. Capital One Shopping says its extension monitors products you view and buy and promo codes that worked, and shares price updates and working codes with other users. For Rakuten, see [what its extension collects](/rakuten-browser-extension-safe-privacy/).

## Who should skip it

- Skip Capital One Shopping if you want money in a bank account. Its rewards are redeemed as gift cards.
- Skip Rakuten if you want to redeem a small balance right away. It pays on four fixed dates.
- Skip running both extensions together. One order, one tracker.
- Skip both if you do not want a browser extension recording which products you look at.

## Quick answers

**Does Capital One Shopping pay cash?**
No. Its help page says rewards have no cash value and are redeemed for e-gift cards.

**Do you need a Capital One card to use Capital One Shopping?**
No. Its help page says no Capital One bank account or card is needed.

**Can one purchase earn from both Rakuten and Capital One Shopping?**
No. Both companies say another rewards extension can stop their tracking.

## Sources

- [Rakuten: Using the extension with other similar browser extensions](https://rakuten.com/help/article/using-the-cash-back-button-with-other-similar-browser-extensions-360001446948)
- [Rakuten: When will I get paid?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/when-will-i-get-paid-360002117667)

# Rakuten or Ibotta: how do they differ, and can you use both?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-vs-ibotta/
Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Rakuten is mainly an online shopping portal: you click through to a store and earn a percentage of the order, paid four times a year. Ibotta is mainly an app for item-by-item offers on groceries and everyday goods, claimed with a receipt or a linked store loyalty account and withdrawn once you have $20. You can hold both accounts; they overlap only on online shopping, where one click-through gets the credit.

This page is information, not financial advice. Every figure below was read on each company's own pages on November 26, 2026.

## Side by side

| | Rakuten | Ibotta |
|---|---|---|
| Main use | Cash back on online orders at stores, travel sites and services | Cash back on named products, mostly groceries and everyday items |
| How a purchase is matched | A "shopping trip" started from the site, app or extension | A paper receipt photo, a linked loyalty account, or an online click-through |
| Stores | More than 3,500 | Over 2,000 retail chains |
| Cost | Free to join | Free to use |
| Minimum to get money out | $5 on the help page; $5.01 in the terms | $20 |
| When money moves | February 15, May 15, August 15, November 15 | When you ask, once qualified |
| Ways to be paid | PayPal, check, Bilt Points, Samsung Cash; Amex points for eligible card members | Bank account, PayPal, digital gift cards |
| Inactive account fee | $5.00 a month after more than 12 months without a shopping trip | $3.99 per 30 days after 180 days without activity |

Both fees come out of the rewards balance only. Ibotta says its fee is never taken from a personal bank account, and Rakuten's terms say its fee cannot make a balance negative.

## What each one is for

**Rakuten.** A store pays Rakuten a commission for sending a shopper, and Rakuten passes part to the member. The reward is a percentage of the order, whatever the items are, subject to each store's exclusions. It also has card-linked offers in physical stores. The full sequence is on [how Rakuten works, step by step](/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/).

**Ibotta.** Its help center describes offers tied to specific products. You add an offer to your list before shopping, buy the item, then prove the purchase in one of three ways:

- **Loyalty account.** At retailers that support it, a linked store account matches purchases to offers with no receipt.
- **Paper receipt.** For in-store purchases, a photo of the register receipt, submitted within 7 days. Digital and emailed receipts do not count.
- **Online shopping.** A click-through from Ibotta's app, website or browser extension to the retailer, which works much like Rakuten.

## How each one pays

Rakuten sends confirmed cash back on four fixed dates. Online and in-store cash back typically takes 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, and a balance under the minimum carries to the next date. Dates are worked through on [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

Ibotta has no payment dates. Its help center lists three conditions before a first withdrawal: at least $20 in earnings, at least one redeemed offer, and 7 days since the first redeemed offer or gift card purchase. Funds then take 0 to 5 days depending on the method.

| Ibotta method | Detail from Ibotta's help center |
|---|---|
| Bank account | Only banks that have opted in; linked in the app or on Ibotta.com |
| PayPal | App only; usually within 2 hours, 1 to 3 business days in busy periods |
| Gift card | Emailed within the hour; some cards have a $25 minimum purchase |

Ibotta's online shopping offers also wait before they pay: 7 days after the transaction at qualifying retailers, with other retailers setting their own pending periods. Any withdrawal fee is not mentioned on the pages read.

## Can you use both?

Holding both accounts breaks neither company's rules on the pages read. Where they meet depends on the purchase.

- **Groceries in a store.** This is where Ibotta's product offers apply. Rakuten's cash back is set per store, not per grocery item.
- **Online orders at a store both list.** Both work by a tracked click. Rakuten's help page says clicking a link from another coupon or rewards site after activating Rakuten "will disable Rakuten Cash Back." Plan on one program per order and compare the two rates first.
- **A linked card at a physical store plus an Ibotta receipt.** Whether both pay on the same purchase is not confirmed; neither company's pages address it.

Minimum age and residency rules for Ibotta are not confirmed here, because its terms page did not load. Rakuten requires members to be 18 and to live in the 50 states or Washington D.C.

## Who should skip it

- Skip Ibotta if you will not add offers before shopping or keep paper receipts for a week. Its offers need both steps, or a linked loyalty account.
- Skip Rakuten if you rarely order online. Its rewards come from store click-throughs and linked cards.
- Skip both if a small balance would sit unused. Each has an inactivity fee that draws the balance down.
- Skip both if you would buy items you did not plan to buy. An offer on an unneeded item is a cost.

## Quick answers

**Is Ibotta the same kind of service as Rakuten?**
Partly. Both pay cash back, but Ibotta centers on product offers and receipts; Rakuten centers on store click-throughs.

**Which has the lower payout minimum?**
Rakuten, at about $5 on set dates. Ibotta requires $20 and pays when you ask.

**Can both pay on the same online order?**
Do not count on it. Rakuten says a later click from another rewards site disables its cash back.

# Rakuten or PayPal Honey: which one fits, and can you use both?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-vs-paypal-honey/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Rakuten pays cash back by check or PayPal, or as American Express points, on four set dates a year. PayPal Honey is mainly a coupon-code search that also pays PayPal Rewards points at some stores. You can hold both accounts, but both companies say only one rewards program is credited for a given purchase.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## Side by side

| | Rakuten | PayPal Honey |
|---|---|---|
| Cost | Free | Free |
| Main job | Cash back at stores | Tests coupon codes at checkout; points at participating stores |
| What you earn | Cash back, or Amex or Bilt points | PayPal Rewards points; 100 points = $1 at PayPal checkout |
| How you are paid | Check, PayPal, Samsung Cash or points | Points used at PayPal checkout, store e-gift cards, or a donation |
| Minimum | $5 on the help page; $5.01 in the terms | 1,000 points ($10) for a gift card; for PayPal checkout, any minimum is shown when you redeem |
| Wait | Typically 3 to 14 weeks to confirm, then the next of four payment dates | Pending in 2 to 14 days; stays pending about 60 to 90 days; then redeem on request |
| Sign-up | Email and password, or Facebook, Google or Apple | Google, PayPal or Apple |
| Do rewards expire | Idle 12 months: a $5 monthly fee may come out of the balance | Points expire unless you earn 10 points every 365 days, or meet PayPal's activity rule |

## How each one pays

**Rakuten.** Confirmed cash back is sent by February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15. Eligible American Express card members can take Membership Rewards points in place of cash. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and [Amex points instead of cash](/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/).

**Honey.** Honey's help center describes a free browser extension that tests coupon codes at checkout on more than 30,000 sites. Points are a second feature. Honey says they are not offered at every store it supports, and you turn them on with a button in the extension.

Points are redeemed on request, not on a schedule. Honey's and PayPal's help pages list three ways: toward a purchase at PayPal checkout, as a store e-gift card (emailed within 24 hours), or as a donation. Redeeming through PayPal needs a US personal PayPal account in good standing, linked to the Honey account by the same email address.

Sources disagree on one thing. PayPal's program terms, last updated March 17, 2025, also describe redeeming points as cash sent to a PayPal account. PayPal's current help page does not list that option, so whether cash redemption is still open is not confirmed.

## Can you use both on one purchase?

Not for rewards. Each company's own help page says so.

- Rakuten: clicking a link from another coupon or rewards site after activating Rakuten will disable its cash back. It asks members to disable or uninstall competing extensions.
- Honey: when two or more rewards programs are active, the credit goes to only one, and Honey says it has no way of knowing which. It suggests disabling other rewards programs and ad blockers.

Coupon codes are a second issue. Rakuten's help center says codes not listed on Rakuten "may void Cash Back." So a code that Honey finds can cost you the Rakuten cash back on that order. Neither company's pages say what happens when Honey only tests codes and no points are activated; that case is not confirmed.

To hold both, compare the two before you buy, activate only one for that order, and keep the other switched off until the order is placed.

## Which fits

Neither pays more at every store, and rates at both change. Rakuten suits someone who wants a check or a PayPal payment and can wait for a payment date. Honey suits someone who mostly wants a coupon code tried at checkout and already pays with PayPal. See also [Rakuten or Capital One Shopping](/rakuten-vs-capital-one-shopping/).

## Who should skip it

- Skip Honey's points if you do not use PayPal checkout and do not want store gift cards.
- Skip Rakuten if you want a small balance paid out right away. It pays on four fixed dates.
- Skip running both extensions at checkout. One order, one credit.
- Skip both if you do not want a browser extension active while you shop.

## Quick answers

**Does PayPal Honey pay cash like Rakuten?**
Honey pays PayPal Rewards points. Its help pages list PayPal checkout, gift cards and donations; cash redemption is not confirmed.

**Can one order earn from both Rakuten and Honey?**
No. Both companies say only one rewards program is credited for a purchase.

**Do you need a PayPal account to use Honey?**
Not to join; Google or Apple sign-in works. Redeeming points through PayPal needs a linked PayPal account.

# Rakuten or TopCashback: which pays more, and how do payouts differ?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-vs-topcashback/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Neither site pays more at every store; rates on both change often, so the higher one depends on the store and the day. The clearer difference is the payout: Rakuten pays on four fixed dates once you have about $5 confirmed, while TopCashback lets you cash out on request once cash back is marked available.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## Payouts side by side

| | Rakuten | TopCashback |
|---|---|---|
| Cost to join | Free | Free |
| When you are paid | February 15, May 15, August 15, November 15 | Any time, once cash back is "available" |
| Minimum | About $5 confirmed ($5 on one Rakuten page, $5.01 in its terms) | None, per The Points Guy; some gift cards may have one |
| Cash methods | Check, PayPal | Bank transfer, Venmo, PayPal |
| Other methods | Amex Membership Rewards points, Bilt points, Samsung Cash, gift cards | Gift cards; prepaid cards |
| Wait before money is yours | Typically 3 to 14 weeks to confirm, then the next date | Set by each store; up to 90 days, per The Points Guy |

TopCashback's own help page says each store has a different period before cash back becomes available. Travel becomes available only after the stay is complete.

How many days a TopCashback transfer takes after you request it is not confirmed; its help pages do not give a figure.

For Rakuten's schedule in detail, see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Which pays more?

There is no fixed answer. Three things are known:

- NerdWallet's comparison says TopCashback's rates are often higher than Rakuten's.
- One personal finance blog tracked 15 stores during 2025. It found TopCashback higher at 10, Rakuten higher at 4, and one tie. That is one writer's unverified test.
- Rakuten often raises a store's rate for a short time. In early November 2026 it ran ten one-day offers at rates from 12% to 30%, according to Upgraded Points.

Rakuten's terms also say rates are personalized and may differ between members. The practical step is to look at both sites on the day you buy.

## TopCashback's rate guarantee

TopCashback has a Highest Cash Back Guarantee. Its help page describes the steps: buy through TopCashback, file a claim once the cash back has tracked, and it will beat the other offer after approving the claim.

The Points Guy lists the conditions, as of its November 2025 article:

- It covers higher rates from eight named competitors, Rakuten among them.
- The higher rate must have been on offer the same day as your purchase.
- The claim must be filed within seven days.
- It matches cash rates only, not points or miles.

The full terms sit behind a sign-in and were not read for this page.

## Where Rakuten differs

Rakuten can pay in American Express Membership Rewards points at 1 point per cent, if you hold an eligible card. A reader who gets more than 1 cent of value from a point comes out ahead of the same rate paid in cash. TopCashback's guarantee does not match points. See [whether Amex points are worth more than cash](/rakuten-amex-points-worth-more-than-cash/).

## Where TopCashback differs

- No fixed payment dates.
- Bank transfer and Venmo are payout choices.
- The Points Guy says some payouts taken as store credit or a prepaid card usually come with a bonus of up to 5%, at certain merchants.

## Can you use both?

You can hold both accounts. One order can be tracked by only one of them. Rakuten's help center says a click from another rewards site disables its cash back, and it asks members to turn off competing extensions. Pick one before you add items to the cart.

## Where sources disagree

- **Payout methods.** TopCashback's help page lists bank, Venmo, PayPal and gift cards. One blog also lists a paper check, which TopCashback's page does not mention.
- **Minimums.** The Points Guy says TopCashback has none. Other summaries say some gift card options start at a few dollars.

## Who should skip it

- Skip Rakuten for a given order if TopCashback's rate is clearly higher that day and you want cash.
- Skip TopCashback if you collect Amex points; it pays cash and gift cards.

## Quick answers

**Does TopCashback have a minimum payout?**
The Points Guy says no. Some gift card options may have their own minimum.

**How often does Rakuten pay?**
Four times a year: February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15.

**Can I get cash back from both on one order?**
No. Only one site can track a purchase. Choose one before you shop.

More on TopCashback: [how its 110% rate match works](/topcashback-highest-cash-back-guarantee/), [how and when it pays](/topcashback-how-to-cash-out-and-when/), and [how it makes money](/is-topcashback-legit-how-it-makes-money/).

# Rakuten Walgreens cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Walgreens. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Walgreens page showed 2% cash back, with no raised rate two days before Black Friday. Pharmacy, prescription drugs, gift cards and the part of an order paid with Walgreens rewards earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

|---|---|---|

Rakuten's page describes myWalgreens as a free program that turns points into dollars off future purchases, with rewards of $5 to $50.

- **Pickup.** The page describes same-day pickup for photo orders. The cash back terms do not mention pickup. Not confirmed.
- **App.** The terms do not mention the Walgreens app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension. Whether an order finished in the Walgreens app tracks is not confirmed.

# Rakuten Walmart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-walmart-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-27
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Sometimes, and not today. On Black Friday, November 27, 2026, Rakuten's Walmart page showed no cash back, as it did on November 25 and 26. On November 24 the same page showed a flat $5 cash back on each of up to three eligible orders of $25 or more, not a percentage of the order. Under that offer, groceries, pharmacy items and orders placed in the Walmart app were excluded.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate here and at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## What the page showed, by date

| Date read | Rakuten's Walmart page |
|---|---|
| November 24, 2026 | $5 per eligible order, up to three orders |
| November 25, 2026 | No cash back |
| November 26, 2026 | No cash back |
| November 27, 2026 (Black Friday) | No cash back |

On Black Friday the page carried no terms or exclusions section and no in-store offer. Whether an offer returns for Cyber Monday, November 30, is not confirmed. Rates at other stores that day are in [Rakuten on Black Friday](/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/) and [Rakuten on Cyber Monday](/rakuten-cyber-monday-cash-back-2026/).

## How the Walmart offer differs from other stores

Most stores on Rakuten pay a percentage and fund it with a commission. Walmart is different. On November 24 Rakuten's page said "Walmart is not a partner of Rakuten" and that the offer was provided by Rakuten only. The rest of this section describes that offer as it read that day.

| Point | What Rakuten's Walmart page said on November 24, 2026 |
|---|---|
| Amount | $5 per eligible order |
| Number of orders | 3 (so $15 at most) |
| Order minimum | $25 or more |
| How to order | Rakuten browser extension, Rakuten app, or Samsung Wallet Perks |
| Members for 60 days or more | Orders from November 12 to November 25, 2026 (Pacific Time) |
| Members in their first 60 days | Orders within 60 days of signing up |
| Posting | Added to the Rakuten account within a few days |

The terms name the extension, the Rakuten app and Samsung Wallet Perks. A click from the Rakuten website is not named, so whether that route counts is not confirmed.

Rakuten said the offer was for eligible members and could be changed or ended at any time. The dated window for longer-standing members closed at 11:59 PM Pacific Time on November 25, 2026, and no new window was shown on November 27. Whether a member in the first 60 days can still earn the $5 while the page shows no cash back is not confirmed.

## What is excluded

Rakuten's page listed these on November 24 as earning nothing:

- Groceries
- Pharmacy and prescriptions. A pharmacy item in the cart voids cash back for the whole order
- Optical and vision
- Financial services: Walmart MoneyCard, credit cards, money transfers, bill pay
- Alcohol, firearms and ammunition, tobacco and vape products
- Walmart+ memberships and renewals
- Subscription and auto-reorder purchases
- Express checkout, Reorder and Buy it again purchases
- Purchases made directly in the Walmart app

The page did not address gift cards, pickup orders or marketplace seller items. Those are not confirmed either way. Rakuten's general rule is that most gift card purchases earn nothing.

On coupon codes, the page's FAQ still said on November 27 that cash back generally stacks with Walmart promo codes and sales.

## What $5 comes to

Because the amount is flat, the return shrinks as the order grows.

| Order size | Cash back | As a share of the order |
|---|---|---|
| $25 | $5 | 20% |
| $50 | $5 | 10% |
| $100 | $5 | 5% |
| $400 | $5 | 1.25% |

Three small eligible orders earn more than one large one: $15 against $5.

## Other big-box and club stores

The flat-dollar setup is particular to this store. The warehouse clubs and the other big-box chain are each handled differently on Rakuten: see [Sam's Club](/rakuten-sams-club-cash-back-how-it-works/), [Costco](/rakuten-costco-cash-back-how-it-works/) and [Target](/rakuten-target-cash-back-how-it-works/).

## What does not carry over

Walmart orders do not count toward other Rakuten bonuses. The terms read on November 24 named the welcome bonus and the referral bonus. A new member cannot use a Walmart order to meet the spending for the sign-up bonus.

## Where sources differ

- On November 27 the page's header showed no cash back, while its FAQ still said $5 on each of the first three Walmart purchases, $15 in all, with no minimum. The header is the rate that applies on the day.
- The terms read on November 24 said the next three eligible orders of $25 or more through the named channels, and excluded groceries. General text on the page on November 27 mentioned groceries as earning and described Walmart as a store Rakuten partners with. Neither matches the November 24 terms, which were more specific.

## When you get the money

Online purchases typically take 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, then are paid on the next of four dates a year. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/) and [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/). Card rewards are separate and come on top; see [stacking with card rewards](/rakuten-stack-with-credit-card-rewards/).

## Who should skip it

- You mainly buy groceries or pharmacy items at Walmart. Neither earns.
- You order in the Walmart app or use Buy it again. Both are excluded.
- You are shopping on a day the page shows no cash back, as on Black Friday 2026, or you have already used the three orders.
- You are counting on a Walmart order to trigger a welcome or referral bonus. It will not.
- You do not want the browser extension. See [what the extension collects](/rakuten-browser-extension-safe-privacy/).

## Quick answers

**Does Rakuten pay a percentage at Walmart?**
No. On Black Friday, November 27, 2026, the page showed no cash back; on November 24 it was a flat $5 on each of up to three orders of $25 or more.

**Do Walmart groceries earn Rakuten cash back?**
No. Groceries were on the excluded list of the $5 offer, along with pharmacy, optical and Walmart+ memberships.

**Can I order in the Walmart app?**
No. Under the $5 offer, purchases made directly in the Walmart app were excluded. The terms named the Rakuten extension, the Rakuten app and Samsung Wallet Perks.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). A new member gets one joining bonus, not two; [how the sign-up and referral bonuses work](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/) sets out both offers.

# Rakuten welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus: which one do you get, and which is bigger?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-welcome-bonus-vs-referral-bonus/
Facts checked: 2026-11-26
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

You get whichever bonus was on the page you joined from, and never both. On November 26, 2026, Rakuten's own store pages advertised a $10 welcome bonus, while a member's referral link showed $50 after $50 of purchases, so the referral bonus was the larger one that day.

This page is information, not financial advice. Both amounts change, and the page you land on shows the amount that applies to you.

## The two bonuses side by side

| | Standard welcome bonus | Referral sign-up bonus |
|---|---|---|
| How you join | From Rakuten's own site or app | Through a member's link, or by entering the member's email on the join form |
| Amount seen November 26, 2026 | $10 | $50 |
| Other amounts in Rakuten's page text | $20; an extra 10% cash back in place of a fixed bonus | $30 |
| Purchases needed | At least $25 | $50 for the $50 offer ($30 for the $30 version) |
| Time limit | 90 days from signing up | 90 days from signing up |
| What counts | Purchases that earn cash back or points through Rakuten | Purchases that earn cash back through Rakuten |
| Amazon.com orders | Do not count | Do not count |
| Paid | With the next cash back payment or points transfer | With the next cash back payment |

## What each one requires

The welcome bonus terms set the same test whatever the amount: join as a new member from a page where the welcome bonus was offered, then make qualifying purchases of at least $25 within 90 days. You also need to choose a payment method and have a mailing address on file.

The referral bonus follows the offer shown on the referral page. The current one runs from October 1 to December 31, 2026 and asks for qualifying purchases of at least $50 within 90 days. The new member must pay for the purchase and must live in the 50 states or D.C. A purchase that is returned, canceled or exchanged does not count. The full list of ways it fails is on [how the referral bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

Neither bonus is instant. The store must confirm the purchase first, and the bonus then goes out on a quarterly payment date. See [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/).

## Why the amounts differ from page to page

Rakuten's pages did not all show the same welcome offer on November 26, 2026. Store pages such as Best Buy's said $10. The home page description offered an extra 10% cash back for new members and named no fixed dollar bonus. Text built into the same pages also carried a line about a $20 welcome bonus after $25 of purchases. Rakuten's separate boost bonus terms describe the 10% version: it applies to purchases in the first seven days and has a cap. The cap amount is not confirmed.

Referral amounts move too. The referral page showed $50 after $50, and its sharing text also carried a $30 after $30 message. Rakuten's referral FAQ says the new member gets "the bonus that was available on day of sign up."

## Can you get both?

No. The welcome bonus terms say it is not combinable with other offers, and they name the referral sign-up bonus. The boost terms say the same. Each is limited to one per new member.

## If you already have an account

Both bonuses are for new members only, and Rakuten's terms limit each person to one account. An existing member cannot earn either one by joining again.

Whether a member who joined from Rakuten's own site can add a friend's email afterward is not confirmed. Rakuten's join article describes entering it only on the join form.

## Who should skip it

- You would be buying $50 of things you do not need to reach the larger bonus. The welcome bonus asks for $25.
- Your first purchases will be on Amazon.com. They count toward neither bonus.
- You already have a Rakuten account. Neither bonus applies.
- You live outside the 50 states and D.C.

## Quick answers

**Which Rakuten bonus is bigger?**
On November 26, 2026 the referral bonus was: $50 against $10. Both change, so compare the pages on the day you join.

**Can you get the welcome bonus and the referral bonus?**
No. Rakuten's terms say the two cannot be combined, and each is one per new member.

**Does an existing Rakuten member get either bonus?**
No. Both are for new members, and the terms allow one account per person.

# When does Rakuten pay you, and when is the next payout?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/
Facts checked: 2026-11-23
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Rakuten pays four times a year, on February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15, as long as you have about $5 in confirmed cash back. The next payout after November 15, 2026 is February 15, 2027. A purchase can take months to be paid because the store must confirm it first, and only then does it wait for the next date.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## The four dates

| Payment date | Next one |
|---|---|
| February 15 | February 15, 2027 |
| May 15 | May 15, 2027 |
| August 15 | August 15, 2027 |
| November 15 | November 15, 2027 |

Rakuten's help page says only that each payment includes the cash back confirmed before that date. Rakuten's blog ties each date to a calendar quarter: the February 15 payment is for cash back earned October 1 to December 31, and the other three dates follow the same pattern. Rakuten's terms say it may change the schedule.

No Rakuten page names the next date for you. Its account FAQ says your confirmed balance is the amount in your next payment, and the payment page links to a "Track My Big Fat Check" tool behind sign-in. What that tool shows is not confirmed.

## The minimum

Rakuten's own pages disagree by one cent. The help page says you need $5 or more in confirmed cash back. The terms say the minimum payout is $5.01. Either way, a smaller balance is not lost. It carries over to the next date.

## Three stages before money moves

A new order is "processing" for 24 to 48 hours while Rakuten waits for the store to report it (see [how long a purchase takes to show up](/rakuten-how-long-until-purchase-shows-up/)). It is then "pending" while the store's return period runs. Once "confirmed", it is included in the next payment.

| Type of purchase | Typical time from pending to confirmed |
|---|---|
| Online and in-store shopping | 3 to 14 weeks |
| Dining | 3 to 5 days after you dine |
| Travel | 6 to 17 weeks after the trip ends |
| Travel booked at Expedia | Within one week after the trip ends |

Rakuten's payment page gives a different travel figure: 45 to 120 days after booking. Its travel article and its confirmation article both say 6 to 17 weeks after the trip is complete. More on this in [cash back on hotels and flights](/rakuten-hotels-flights-cash-back/).

## Why a purchase can take months

Two waits stack. First the store confirms, then the calendar decides.

| Example | Confirmed | Paid |
|---|---|---|
| Online order on November 20, 2026, confirmed in 3 weeks | About December 11, 2026 | February 15, 2027 |
| Same order, confirmed in 14 weeks | About February 26, 2027 | May 15, 2027 |
| Hotel booked today for a stay ending March 15, 2027, confirmed 6 weeks after | About April 26, 2027 | May 15, 2027 |
| Same stay, confirmed 17 weeks after | About July 12, 2027 | August 15, 2027 |

These dates are worked out from Rakuten's typical ranges; a store can be faster or slower. An ordinary online order takes roughly 3 to 6 months from checkout to payment. A trip booked well ahead can take most of a year.

## How you are paid

You can be paid by PayPal, check, Bilt points, Samsung Cash or American Express Membership Rewards points. PayPal and check need a mailing address on file; Bilt and Membership Rewards do not.

Rakuten says the address is used to verify identity. You add it in Account Settings.

How many days a check or PayPal transfer takes to arrive after the payment date is not confirmed; Rakuten's page does not say.

Rakuten also says a confirmed balance of at least $5 can be redeemed for a gift card that arrives within minutes, subject to limits.

If you hold an eligible Amex card you can take points in place of cash on the same four dates. See [whether Amex points are worth more than the cash](/rakuten-amex-points-worth-more-than-cash/).

## Things that reduce or delay a payment

- A return, exchange or cancellation. Rakuten deducts the cash back for it.
- A purchase that never tracked. Rakuten's terms give 90 days from the purchase to report it. See [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).
- Long inactivity. After 12 months with no shopping trip, the terms allow a $5 monthly maintenance fee taken from the balance.

## Who should skip it

- You need the rebate now. A lower price or a coupon at checkout is money today; Rakuten is money in a few months.
- You shop online once or twice a year for small amounts. You may sit under the minimum for a long time.
- You do not want to give a mailing address or link a PayPal account.

## Quick answers

**What dates does Rakuten pay?**
February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15.

**What is the minimum to be paid?**
About $5 confirmed. One Rakuten page says $5, its terms say $5.01. Less carries over.

**Why is my cash back still pending?**
The store's return period is running. Shopping typically takes 3 to 14 weeks; travel takes longer.

# Rakuten Zappos cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-zappos-cash-back-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

Yes, Rakuten pays cash back at Zappos. On November 25, 2026, Rakuten's Zappos page showed 2% cash back, with no raised rate. Birkenstock and VRSNL purchases, gift cards, orders where a gift card is used to pay and Final Sale items more than 50% off earn nothing.

This page is information, not financial advice. Rates change daily, so check the store page on Rakuten on the day you buy. For this morning's headline rate at other stores, see [Rakuten rates today, by store](/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/).

## The rate

| Date checked | Rate shown | Rakuten's "was" label |
|---|---|---|
| November 25, 2026 | 2% | None |

A "was" label appears when a rate has been raised above the store's base rate. The Zappos page has none, so 2% is the plain rate. No category table appears.

## What earns and what does not

| Purchase | Earns cash back? |
|---|---|
| Shoes, clothing and bags not on the excluded list | Yes, 2% on the day checked |
| Sale items that are not Final Sale | Not listed as excluded |
| Final Sale items more than 50% off | No |
| Birkenstock | No |
| VRSNL | No |
| Gift cards | No |
| Orders where a gift card is used to pay | No |
| Orders deemed for reselling purposes | No |
| Orders using codes related to "ZAW" or "EMPLOYEE" | No |

Some notes on that list:

- **Gift card payments.** The wording covers the order, not only the part paid by gift card. Read plainly, a small gift card balance applied to a large order would cost the cash back on all of it. Whether Zappos applies it that way is not confirmed.
- **Final Sale.** The exclusion is for Final Sale items discounted by more than 50%. A Final Sale item at a smaller discount is not named.
- **Reselling.** The terms do not say how an order is deemed to be for reselling. Not confirmed.
- **ZAW.** The terms do not explain the term. Not confirmed.

## Discounts and VIP points lower the base

The terms say that if Zappos VIP points or other discounts are applied, the subtotal after the discount is used to figure cash back. Rakuten's page describes Zappos VIP as a free program paying one point per dollar, with a $1 coupon for every 100 points.

| Order | Discount applied | Amount that counts | At 2% |
|---|---|---|---|
| $160 pair of boots | None | $160.00 | $3.20 |
| $160 pair of boots | 10% status discount | $144.00 | $2.88 |
| $160 pair of boots | $10 in VIP rewards | $150.00 | $3.00 |

The 10% line uses the student, teacher and military discount described on Rakuten's page, which is verified through SheerID. The terms treat discounts as lowering the base, and do not say that this discount voids cash back.

## Coupon codes

The terms say using coupon codes not listed on Rakuten may void cash back. Rakuten's page also says Zappos does not offer general promo codes, only individual ones, and no code was listed on November 25, 2026. The offers shown were sale links, including up to 50% off selected brands.

## Pickup, app and stores

- **App.** Rakuten's page says the Zappos app offers free expedited shipping. The cash back terms do not mention the app. A purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link, the Rakuten app or the extension. Whether an order finished in the Zappos app tracks is not confirmed.
- **Pickup.** Not mentioned on the page.
- **In stores.** Zappos is listed as an online store, and the page showed an online rate only. See [how in-store cash back works](/rakuten-in-store-cash-back-how-it-works/) for stores that have an offer.
- **Shipping.** The page says Zappos ships all orders free by standard shipping. Whether taxes count toward cash back is not stated in the Zappos terms.

## When it shows up

The posting line says cash back is added to the Rakuten account "tomorrow". Rakuten's help page says online cash back typically takes 3 to 14 weeks to be confirmed, and that a full or partial return can void it. Payment follows on Rakuten's schedule; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). If a purchase never appears, see [what to do when cash back did not track](/rakuten-missing-cash-back-what-to-do/).

## Who should skip it

- You are buying Birkenstock or VRSNL. Those brands earn nothing.
- You plan to pay with a Zappos gift card, even in part.
- The item is Final Sale at more than 50% off.
- You order many pairs to try and send most back. Returned items lose their cash back.
- You are buying in quantity to resell.

## Quick answers

**What rate does Rakuten pay at Zappos?**
2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate shown. Rates change daily.

**Do Birkenstock sandals earn cash back at Zappos?**
No. Birkenstock purchases are on the excluded list, along with VRSNL.

**Does paying with a Zappos gift card affect cash back?**
Yes. The terms exclude orders where a customer uses a gift card to make a purchase.

## Not a Rakuten member yet

Joining costs nothing; the one fee in the terms is covered in [is Rakuten free](/is-rakuten-free/). How the joining bonus is earned is laid out in [how the Rakuten bonus works](/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/).

- [Rakuten: Why didn't I earn cash back?](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/why-didnt-i-earn-cash-back-360036367393)

# Sapphire Preferred or Sapphire Reserve for someone who travels two or three times a year?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/sapphire-preferred-vs-reserve-light-traveler/
Facts checked: 2026-11-20
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

For two or three trips a year, the Sapphire Preferred is the safer fit for most people. The Sapphire Reserve costs $700 more each year, and a light traveler has to use several of its credits, not only the travel one, to get that back.

This page is information, not financial advice. Terms change, so check the issuer's pages before deciding.

## Side by side

| | Sapphire Preferred | Sapphire Reserve |
|---|---|---|
| Annual fee | $95 | $795 |
| Authorized user | Free | $195 each |
| Public welcome offer today | 75,000 points after $5,000 in 3 months | 100,000 points after $6,000 in 3 months |
| Chase Travel bookings | 5x | 8x |
| Flights and hotels booked direct | 2x | 4x |
| Dining | 3x | 3x |
| Everything else | 1x | 1x |
| Hotel credit | Up to $100 a year, Chase Travel hotels | Up to $500 a year at The Edit hotels, $250 per prepaid stay, two-night minimum |
| General travel credit | None | Up to $300 a year |
| Airport lounges | None | Sapphire Lounges and 1,300+ Priority Pass lounges, two guests free |
| Hyatt transfer | 4 Chase points to 3 Hyatt | 1 to 1 |
| Top Points Boost value in Chase Travel | Up to 1.5 cents a point (some sources report 1.75 on premium-cabin fares) | Up to 2 cents a point |

Welcome offers change and vary by person. The Preferred also earns 3x on gas stations, EV charging, selected streaming and online grocery, which the Reserve does not.

## The Reserve's sums for a light traveler

Start with the fee gap: $795 minus $95 is $700.

The $300 travel credit is easy. It applies to travel purchases in general, and two or three trips will use it. That leaves $400 to find.

The rest of the Reserve's credits are narrower:

- **The Edit hotels:** up to $250 per prepaid stay, $500 a calendar year. It needs two stays of two nights or more at hotels in Chase's own collection.
- **Dining:** up to $150 in each half of the year, only at restaurants in the Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables list on OpenTable.
- **StubHub:** up to $150 in each half of the year, through the end of 2027.
- **Lyft:** $10 a month. **Peloton:** $10 a month. **DoorDash:** DashPass and monthly promos. **Apple TV and Apple Music:** free with activation.

If you would pay for these things anyway, they are worth close to face value. If you would be changing where you eat or stay to use them, they are worth much less. Be strict when you count.

A simple test: write down only the credits you would have spent cash on last year. If the total, on top of the $300 travel credit, does not clear $400, the Preferred costs you less.

## Lounges on two or three trips

Lounge access is the Reserve benefit people picture most. Two or three round trips is roughly four to six airport visits a year. The Reserve gives you and two guests entry, and extra guests are $27 each per visit. Lounges can refuse entry when full.

On so few visits that rarely fills a $400 gap. Check that your home airport has a lounge in the network before you count it.

## When the Reserve does make sense at this travel level

- Your two or three trips are expensive ones, with hotels booked direct, so 4x matters.
- You stay at Hyatt on points. The Reserve keeps the 1:1 Hyatt rate; the Preferred gives 3 Hyatt points for every 4.
- You already use Lyft, DoorDash, StubHub and Apple's services every month.
- You travel with a partner or family and would use the lounge guest allowance.

## Who should get neither

- Anyone who carries a balance month to month.
- Anyone who has opened five or more personal cards in 24 months. Chase generally declines them for both cards.
- Anyone who wants simple cash back with no tracking of credits.

Under Chase's current rule you can earn each Sapphire card's bonus once, and holding one does not block the other. So starting with the Preferred does not close the door on the Reserve later.

## Quick answers

**Is the Reserve worth $795 for three trips a year?**
Only if you use well over the $300 travel credit in other credits you would have paid for anyway. Many light travelers do not.

**Does the Preferred get me into lounges?**
No. Lounge access comes with the Reserve only.

**Can I have both cards?**
Yes. Since January 2026 Chase allows each card's bonus once per person, even if you hold the other.

## Sources

- [Chase: Sapphire Preferred card page](https://creditcards.chase.com/rewards-credit-cards/sapphire/preferred)
- [Chase: Sapphire Reserve card page](https://creditcards.chase.com/rewards-credit-cards/sapphire/reserve)
- [The Points Guy: Chase Sapphire Preferred review](https://thepointsguy.com/credit-cards/chase-sapphire-preferred-review)
- [One Mile at a Time: Sapphire Preferred review and 2026 changes](https://onemileatatime.com/chase-sapphire-card-limited-time-perks/)
- [AwardWallet: Chase to Hyatt transfer ratios](https://awardwallet.com/credit-cards/chase-ultimate-rewards/chase-to-hyatt-transfer/)
- [The Points Guy: Sapphire bonus eligibility changes 2026](https://thepointsguy.com/news/chase-sapphire-bonus-eligibility-changes-2026)
- [The Points Guy: Chase's 5/24 rule](https://thepointsguy.com/credit-cards/chase/ultimate-guide-chase-5-24-rule/)

# TopCashback app: how does it work on iPhone and Android?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-app-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

The TopCashback app is a free app for iPhone, iPad and Android that does on a phone what the website does on a computer: you pick a store in the app, buy as usual, and the cash back is recorded in the same account. TopCashback's app page says a purchase made this way can take up to 6 weeks to show in your account.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## What the app does

TopCashback's app page, read on November 25, 2026, lists three things:

- **Shop.** Find a store or service and start the purchase from the app. The page says more than 7,000 stores pay cash back, and that new ones are added weekly.
- **Check your account.** See how much cash back you have earned and follow each transaction.
- **Cash out.** Send available cash back by bank transfer, Venmo or PayPal, or take a gift card.

You log in with the same details as on the website. There is one account, not a separate one for the phone.

## The facts in one table

| Question | What TopCashback's app page says |
|---|---|
| Cost | Free to download and use |
| Other charges | Your carrier's data rates can apply when you are off Wi-Fi |
| iPhone and iPad | Compatible |
| Android | Phones and tablets with access to the Google Play Store |
| Operating system | Needs to be up to date; no version number is given |
| Time for a purchase to show | Up to 6 weeks |
| Offer alerts | Optional push notifications, switched on or off in the phone's settings |

## How long cash back takes on the app

The app page says "It can take up to 6 weeks for the cash back to show in your account."

TopCashback's Getting Started page, which describes the website, gives a shorter figure: up to seven days for a purchase to appear as "In Progress," then one to three months on average before the store confirms it and it becomes "Available." The two pages do not explain the difference. A fair reading is that a week is typical and 6 weeks is the outer limit for the app, but that reading is not confirmed by TopCashback.

Either way, showing in the account is only the first stage. You cannot cash out until the store has confirmed the sale. The stages are set out on [how TopCashback pays](/topcashback-how-to-cash-out-and-when/).

If a purchase does not show, the app page says to send a support ticket from your account.

## App, website or extension

| | App | Website | Browser extension |
|---|---|---|---|
| Where it runs | Phone or tablet | Any browser | Desktop browser only |
| How you start | Pick the store in the app | Click "Get Cash Back" on the store's page | Click the pop-up on the store's own site |
| Covers every store | Not confirmed | Yes | No; stores must opt in |
| Cash out | Yes | Yes | Not stated |

The [browser extension](/topcashback-browser-extension-how-it-works/) does not work on phones, by TopCashback's own help page. On a phone, the app or the mobile website is the way in.

Whether the app pays cash back on purchases made inside a store's own app, as opposed to the store's mobile website, is not stated on the pages read for this page.

## What can stop a phone purchase from tracking

TopCashback's help page on missing cash back lists reasons that apply on any device: a coupon code that TopCashback did not list, an ad blocker, finishing the purchase in a different tab or window from the one TopCashback opened, or clicking another cash back or coupon site afterward. On a phone, the third is the easy one to trip over: if the store's link opens in one place and you check out in another, the store may not know TopCashback sent you.

## Who should skip it

- You buy on a computer. The website or the extension does the same job there.
- You do not want another shopping app sending alerts. Notifications are optional, but the app is still one more thing on the phone.
- You do most phone shopping inside store apps. Whether those purchases track is not confirmed.
- You want the money quickly. The wait for a store to confirm a sale is the same on every device.

If you are still deciding between sites, see [Rakuten or TopCashback](/rakuten-vs-topcashback/) and, for the larger site's phone tools, [Rakuten's app and extension](/rakuten-app-vs-browser-extension/).

## Quick answers

**Is the TopCashback app free?**
Yes. The app page says it is free to download and use; your carrier's data charges can still apply.

**Does the TopCashback app work on iPad and Android tablets?**
Yes. The page lists iPhone and iPad, and Android phones and tablets with the Google Play Store.

**How long does cash back take to show in the TopCashback app?**
Up to 6 weeks, by the app page. It then has to be confirmed by the store before you can cash out.

- [TopCashback: Getting Started](https://www.topcashback.com/getting-started/)
- [TopCashback: Why is my Cash Back missing?](https://www.topcashback.com/help/cash-back-missing/)

# TopCashback browser extension: how does it work and what does it see?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-browser-extension-how-it-works/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

The TopCashback browser extension is a free desktop add-on that shows a pop-up when the store you are on pays cash back, so you can turn cash back on with one click without going to TopCashback first. Its privacy notice says it reads the addresses of the sites you visit to check for stores, and does not record or store your searches or browsing history.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## What it does, step by step

TopCashback's help page gives three steps once the extension is installed:

1. Go to the store's own website.
2. Click to activate cash back in the pop-up.
3. Use any coupon the pop-up lists, then check out as usual.

You have to be a TopCashback member and logged in for a purchase to earn. If you are logged out, the pop-up still appears; clicking it sends you to the login page and then back to the store.

The help pages also say that after a Google search the extension shows which stores in the results pay cash back and at what rate.

## The facts in one table

| Question | What TopCashback's own pages say (read November 25, 2026) |
|---|---|
| Cost | Free to download and use |
| Browsers | Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge, per the help page |
| Phones and tablets | Not supported; desktop only |
| Stores | "Over 7,000" on the site, but not all are in the extension |
| Need an account? | Yes, and you must be logged in to earn |
| Where exclusions are shown | Under "More details" in the pop-up |

One point where TopCashback's own pages differ: the help page lists four browsers including Safari, while the title of the extension page names Chrome, Edge and Firefox only. Whether the Safari version is current is not confirmed.

## Why a store may show no pop-up

The extension does not cover every store on the site. The help page says stores have to "opt-in" before they can be featured. When no pop-up appears, the store may still pay cash back if you start from TopCashback's website instead.

## What it sees

These points come from the extension's privacy notice:

- It uses a unique identifier to learn how you interact with the extension.
- It identifies the address of each website you visit, to check whether that site is a TopCashback store.
- On search engines and some AI chat sites, it reads store addresses shown on the page so it can show cash back offers. The notice says it does not have access to, record or store your search queries, prompts or conversations.
- It keeps a list of the stores you clicked through that are eligible for cash back.
- It uses cookies. When you activate cash back, it places a tracking cookie through its affiliate network. The notice says this replaces any existing tracking from other affiliate companies, so the purchase is credited to TopCashback.
- "On occasion" it may capture an order number and transaction amount from a store's site to help credit your cash back.

A separate help page says the extension installs no spyware, malware or adware. These are the company's statements about its own product; no outside audit was found for this page.

The cookie point matters if you use more than one cash back tool. Only one of them is credited for a purchase, and the last one activated is normally the one that counts. The same is true of [Rakuten's extension](/rakuten-browser-extension-safe-privacy/).

## Removing it

For Chrome, Firefox and Edge, the help page says to open the extension's page in that browser's web store and click "Remove." The privacy notice says you can remove it in your browser at any time.

## Who should skip it

- You shop mostly on a phone. The extension is desktop only; TopCashback has a [separate app](/topcashback-app-how-it-works/).
- You do not want an add-on that checks the address of every site you open.
- You already run another cash back extension and do not want two pop-ups competing on the same store.
- You are happy to start each purchase from TopCashback's website. The extension is a reminder, not a requirement.

For how the site itself works and how it earns, see [is TopCashback legit](/is-topcashback-legit-how-it-makes-money/).

## Quick answers

**Is the TopCashback browser extension free?**
Yes. TopCashback's page says it is free to download and free to use.

**Does the TopCashback extension work on a phone?**
No. The help page says it is designed for desktop use only and is not compatible with mobile devices.

**Does the TopCashback extension record my searches?**
Its privacy notice says no. It reads website addresses to find stores, and does not record or store search queries or browsing history.

- [TopCashback: Browser Extension Privacy Notice](https://www.topcashback.com/dyn/browser-ex-privacy)

# TopCashback Highest Cash Back Guarantee: how does the 110% match work?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-highest-cash-back-guarantee/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

TopCashback says that if another cash back site shows a higher rate on the day you buy, it will pay 110% of that higher rate on a purchase made through TopCashback. The match is not automatic: it covers seven named sites, and you have to file a claim with proof within seven days of the cash back tracking.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## The rule in one example

TopCashback's help page gives the sum itself: if another site offers $10 of cash back, it pays $11. So the claim is worth the gap between the two sites plus 10% of the higher amount.

| Your order | TopCashback rate | Other site's rate | Without a claim | With an approved claim |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $200 | 4% | 6% | $8.00 | $13.20 |
| $200 | 6% | 6% | $12.00 | $13.20 |
| $200 | 8% | 6% | $16.00 | No claim: TopCashback is already higher |

The figures in the table are worked examples of the 110% rule, not rates seen at any store.

## Which sites count

The help page names the US cash back sites it will match, as read on November 25, 2026:

- BeFrugal
- GoCashBack
- Honey
- Max Rebates
- Mr. Rebates
- Rakuten
- Tada

It says it does not match closed group sites or non-paid platforms. Capital One Shopping is not on the list.

## The six conditions

1. **Eligible sites only.** One of the seven above.
2. **A direct purchase that tracked.** The order has to show in your TopCashback account first.
3. **Same-day rate.** The higher rate has to be live on the exact day of your purchase. A rate that appears later does not count.
4. **Proof.** A working URL to the higher rate. The page adds that a screenshot showing date and time helps.
5. **Paid transactions only.** The cash back has to be worth at least 1 cent. Free cash back offers and reward points, such as Discover Card and MyPoints, do not qualify.
6. **Seven days.** The claim has to go in within seven days of the cash back tracking, with the amount shown in your account.

The page ends by saying that if you are not sure a claim qualifies, you can submit it anyway.

## What this means in practice

Rakuten is on the list, so a short Rakuten rate rise can be claimed if you bought through TopCashback that day and saved proof. Two limits follow from the conditions:

- **The proof has to be taken on the day.** Rates change daily, and Rakuten's terms say rates can differ between members. A screenshot with the date and time is the safer record.
- **Points do not count.** A Rakuten member paid in Amex points is on a cash back rate that converts to points, so the cash rate shown on Rakuten is what you would cite. Whether TopCashback accepts that in every case is not confirmed.

How long TopCashback takes to decide a claim is not confirmed; the help page gives no figure.

For the two sites side by side, see [Rakuten or TopCashback](/rakuten-vs-topcashback/). For how payment works once cash back is approved, see [how TopCashback pays](/topcashback-how-to-cash-out-and-when/).

## Who should skip it

- The gap is small. On a $40 order, 2 points of difference is 80 cents plus the 10%; a claim may not be worth the time.
- You did not record the other site's rate on the day. Without proof the claim has little to stand on.
- You would rather buy through the site with the higher rate and be done. That gets you the higher rate with no claim, less the extra 10%.
- The other site is not one of the seven.

## Quick answers

**Does TopCashback match Rakuten's rates?**
Its help page says yes: Rakuten is one of seven sites it will beat by 10%, after a claim with proof.

**How long do you have to claim?**
Seven days from when the cash back tracks in your TopCashback account.

**Is the match automatic?**
No. You submit a claim with a link to the higher rate from the day you bought.

# How does TopCashback pay you, and when can you cash out?

Source: https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-how-to-cash-out-and-when/
Facts checked: 2026-11-25
Publisher: Worth the Fee (independent; some pages end with a disclosed referral link)

TopCashback pays on request, not on fixed dates: once cash back is marked "available" you can send it to a bank account, Venmo or PayPal, or take a gift card. How long a purchase takes to become available is set by each store, and travel is not available until the stay is finished.

This page is information, not financial advice.

## The stages a purchase goes through

| Stage | What it means | What TopCashback's help pages say |
|---|---|---|
| Not showing yet | The store has not reported the sale | Can take a week or longer |
| Tracked | The purchase appears on your Earnings page | An estimated date is shown; it is only an estimate |
| Available | The store has validated the sale | You can cash out at any time |
| Paid | You asked for the money | You get one email to confirm and another when the payment is available |

The wait between tracked and available is the long part. The help page says every purchase goes through a validation period, and that each store has a different one. Returns and cancellations are the reason stores wait.

## Ways to be paid

As listed on TopCashback's help page on November 25, 2026:

- Transfer to a bank account
- Venmo
- PayPal
- A gift card. The page names Amazon, Starbucks, Target and Sephora as examples.

A minimum to cash out is not stated on the help pages read for this page. The Points Guy reports there is none for cash methods. How many days a bank or PayPal transfer takes after you request it is not confirmed.

## How to cash out

The help page gives these steps:

1. Open the Cash Out page.
2. Choose a payment method.
3. On the Payment Breakdown screen, choose how much to cash out. You can give part of it to a charity here.
4. Confirm by answering your security question.

## When a purchase is missing

TopCashback lists five common reasons a purchase did not track:

1. A coupon code that was not listed on TopCashback.
2. An ad blocker.
3. Buying in a different tab from the one TopCashback opened.
4. Clicking another cash back or coupon site afterward, so TopCashback was not the last click.
5. Not enough time has passed.

If none of those apply and enough time has gone by, the help page says to submit a Missing Cash Back Claim so it can investigate. If cash back has tracked but has stayed short of available for longer than the estimate, it says to open a support ticket. How long either takes is not confirmed.

## How this differs from Rakuten

Rakuten sends payments on four set dates a year and needs about $5 confirmed first; see [when Rakuten pays](/rakuten-when-do-you-get-paid/). TopCashback has no payment dates: the money moves when you ask, once the store has validated the sale. Neither site lets you skip the store's validation wait. The full comparison is on [Rakuten or TopCashback](/rakuten-vs-topcashback/).

## Who should skip it

- You want money quickly after a purchase. On any cash back site the store's validation period comes first, and for travel it starts after the trip.
- You use coupon codes found elsewhere. A code not listed on TopCashback is the first reason on its list for cash back not tracking.
- You will not turn off an ad blocker for a purchase.
- You shop rarely and for small amounts, so the sums stay small.

Whether the site itself can be trusted is covered on [is TopCashback legit](/is-topcashback-legit-how-it-makes-money/).

## Quick answers

**Does TopCashback have a payout schedule?**
No. Once cash back is marked available you can cash out at any time.

**Can TopCashback pay to PayPal or Venmo?**
Yes. Its help page lists bank transfer, Venmo, PayPal and gift cards.

**Why is my TopCashback not available yet?**
Each store has its own validation period. Travel becomes available only after the stay is complete.
